summary.technical_approach: 论文综合后训练适配文献，构造六个维度来区分常被混用的概念，例如 fine-tuning、retrieval augmentation、prompting、model editing 和 unlearning，并将传统 ML、深度学习、foundation model、LLM、MLLM 的适配方式放到同一描述框架中。
summary.experiments: 作为 taxonomy/survey，摘要未描述实验、模型规模或定量 baseline。主要产出应是分类表、概念边界和治理场景映射。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses fragmentation in post-training adaptation terminology across fine-tuning, PEFT, alignment, RAG, model editing, unlearning, calibration, and multimodal instruction tuning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a survey and taxonomy. It proposes six dimensions—mechanism, goal, data requirement, persistence, structural scope, and model type—to describe adaptation methods. Its value is conceptual organization rather than a new training technique.
summary_en.technical_approach: The survey synthesizes adaptation literature and uses the six-dimensional framework to separate commonly conflated methods such as fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation, prompting, model editing, and unlearning. It also maps how adaptation changes from classical ML to foundation models, LLMs, and multimodal LLMs.
summary_en.experiments: No experiments, model sizes, or quantitative baselines are described in the abstract. The main outputs are likely taxonomy tables, definitions, and governance-oriented mappings.

recommendation.zh: 适合作术语索引，不适合找训练 insight；扫 taxonomy 表即可，治理部分对 pretrain 决策帮助有限。
recommendation.en: Useful as a terminology index, not a source of training insight; skim the taxonomy table and skip most governance framing.

paper.title: Safe Evolution with Circuit Anchors
paper.abstract: In biological evolution, unconstrained mutation can lead to catastrophic outcomes: organisms may evolve enhanced capabilities while losing essential functions for survival. Nature's solution is \textit{developmental constraints}, where core regulatory genes remain anchored while peripheral genes adapt freely. We observe that current self-evolution algorithms for large language models lack analogous constraints. They optimize purely for capability, implicitly assuming safety will be preserved. Ou

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 自进化或自我改写过程中只追求能力提升、却可能破坏安全行为的问题。
summary.importance: 价值主要在两个接口：一是 mechanistic interpretability 是否能找到可因果干预的“安全电路”，二是这些局部特征能否作为后训练/自进化的约束。对预训练研究员不是主线，但对理解能力-安全耦合、以及 feature-level regularization 有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Circuit-Anchored Evolution（CAE）。作者先用机制可解释性识别一个占模型特征不到 2% 的 safety circuit，声称其因果介导安全行为；随后在 self-evolution 过程中对该电路施加锚定约束，让外围能力相关特征继续适配，而核心安全特征保持稳定，以避免 capability gain 伴随 safety collapse。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调一个关键现象：现有 self-evolution 算法会让模型“misevolve”为更强但更危险的系统；CAE 在保持能力增长的同时维持安全行为。摘要未给出模型规模、任务集、具体安全指标和对照算法，因此当前更像概念验证，需看正文确认电路识别是否稳健、因果证据是否充分。
summary.authors_note: 香港中文大学与 IQuest Research。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the problem that LLM self-evolution can optimize for capability while silently degrading safety behavior.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at two interfaces: whether mechanistic interpretability can identify causally actionable 'safety circuits', and whether such local features can serve as constraints during model evolution. This is not core pretraining work, but it is relevant to capability-safety coupling and feature-level regularization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Circuit-Anchored Evolution (CAE). It first uses mechanistic interpretability to identify a safety circuit, claimed to be less than 2% of model features and causally responsible for safety behavior. During self-evolution, this circuit is anchored while other features remain adaptable, aiming to preserve safety while allowing capability gains.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights a central empirical claim: existing self-evolution methods can produce models that are more capable yet more dangerous, whereas CAE preserves safety while improving capability. The abstract does not provide model sizes, task suites, safety metrics, or baseline details, so this currently reads as a proof-of-concept pending closer inspection of the causal evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: From the Chinese University of Hong Kong and IQuest Research.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 feature-level 约束能否替代部分对齐数据，这篇可看；但“<2% 特征就是安全电路”这个说法很重，先审因果干预实验再决定信不信。
recommendation.en: Read it if you care whether feature-level constraints can substitute for some alignment data, but the '<2% features define safety' claim is strong—check the causal intervention section before buying it.

paper.title: CircuitSteer: Geometrically Aligned Multi-Layer Steering via Sparse Autoencoder Circuits
paper.abstract: Controlling the behavior of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge for AI alignment. Existing steering methods, such as Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), typically rely on fixed single-layer interventions derived from aggregate activation differences. These methods impose a single intervention across semantically diverse inputs and often fail to sustain consistent behavioral changes across layers, limiting the effectiveness of the steering. In this work, we introduce Circ

summary.core_problem: 改进 LLM 行为 steering，使干预不再依赖单层、固定、输入无关的 activation vector。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制解释和对齐控制方法；它把 Sparse Autoencoder 特征用于多层语义 circuit 识别，再把稀疏特征合成为 dense steering vectors。对 pretrain 的直接帮助不大，但对理解表示可控性和 SAE 特征组织有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CircuitSteer。方法先用 SAE 抽取稀疏特征，再基于特征共激活和 decoder direction 的几何对齐构建 feature flow circuit，定位与目标行为相关的多层子电路；随后从这些稀疏特征合成密集 steering 向量，并在多个层位置施加干预。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 数字或提升幅度。主要对比对象是 Contrastive Activation Addition 这类单层 steering 方法，并声称多层 circuit 干预能更稳定地改变目标行为。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to make LLM behavior steering more reliable than fixed, single-layer, input-agnostic activation interventions.
summary_en.importance: It contributes an interpretability-driven alignment control method. Sparse Autoencoder features are used to identify distributed semantic circuits and synthesize dense steering vectors. The direct pretraining value is limited, but it is relevant to representation controllability and SAE-based model analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: CircuitSteer first extracts sparse features with SAEs, then builds a feature-flow circuit using feature co-activation and geometric alignment of decoder directions. It isolates multi-layer subcircuits associated with a target behavior, synthesizes dense steering vectors from those sparse features, and applies interventions at multiple layers.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, numerical gains, or full baselines. The main comparison is against single-layer steering methods such as Contrastive Activation Addition, with the claim that multi-layer circuit interventions yield more consistent behavioral control.

recommendation.zh: SAE steering 又一篇；若正文没有跨模型稳健性，只把 circuit 构造当候选工具。
recommendation.en: Another SAE-steering paper; unless the full text shows cross-model robustness, treat the circuit construction as a candidate tool only.

paper.title: Learning Sexism Detection Using Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: When people label text for sexism, they often disagree, and not because some of them are wrong: they genuinely perceive sexism differently. Most NLP systems discard this disagreement by collapsing it into a majority vote. We propose the Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization (MAP-PO) framework to keep these different perspectives. On the EXIST 2024 dataset of labeled English and Spanish tweets, we first cluster annotators by their labeling behavior rather than their demographic attrib

summary.core_problem: 在性别歧视检测中保留标注者之间的真实分歧，而不是把分歧压成多数票标签。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练和偏好优化的任务化改造。它对 alignment 的一个小问题有参考意义：偏好数据中的 disagreement 可能不是噪声，而是需要显式建模的多视角信号；但任务范围较窄，离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MAP-PO，即先按标注行为聚类标注者，而不是按人口统计属性分组；再为每个聚类微调一个 LLM agent 来复现该群体标注模式；最后用结合个体奖励和团队奖励的 preference optimization 协调多个 agent。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 EXIST 2024 英语和西班牙语推文数据，在两种语言和两种 backbone LLM 上形成四个设置；评估每个 agent 是否复现自身 cluster 的标注，以及多 agent 集体是否复现多数标签。摘要未给出具体模型名称、参数量和数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Utrecht University；未见与 LLM 基座预训练相关的代表性团队信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to preserve genuine annotator disagreement in sexism detection instead of collapsing it into a majority-vote label.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a task-specific adaptation of preference optimization. It is mildly relevant to alignment because it treats disagreement in preference data as structured signal rather than noise, but the setup remains narrow and far from foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAP-PO first clusters annotators by labeling behavior rather than demographic attributes. It then fine-tunes one LLM agent per cluster to reproduce that cluster’s annotation pattern, and coordinates agents through preference optimization with both individual and team-level rewards.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use the EXIST 2024 English and Spanish tweet dataset, with four settings from two languages and two backbone LLMs. The evaluation checks cluster-level reproduction and majority-label reproduction. The abstract does not provide exact backbone sizes or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Utrecht University; no foundation-model pretraining track record is identifiable from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法框架即可；它把偏好分歧当训练信号，但 sexism 数据集太窄，别外推到通用对齐。
recommendation.en: Skim the framework only: it treats preference disagreement as signal, but the sexism-detection setting is too narrow to generalize.

paper.title: Looking in the Mirror: Introspecting Side-Effect Misalignments Induced by Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning enables a source model to acquire desired capabilities and behaviors in a target domain while retaining much of its general-purpose competence. However, this adaptation process can also degrade alignment properties that were present in the source model. Recent work has shown that large language models can be trained using LoRA-based modules known as introspection adapters (IAs) to describe behavioral changes induced by fine-tuning. However, existing studies primarily consider setting

summary.core_problem: 研究模型经过任务微调后，如何让模型识别并描述意外产生的对齐能力退化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练安全分析问题定义和方法扩展：把已有 introspection adapter 从“显式植入行为”的场景推进到更接近部署风险的 side-effect misalignment。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 side-effect introspection 设定：源模型经过目标任务微调后，可能在安全或对齐属性上出现非预期变化；再训练 LoRA 形式的 introspection adapters，让模型描述这些由微调引入的行为变化。方法是在已有 IA 框架上改变问题设定和评测关注点，而不是新的预训练方法。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出实验细节、模型规模、微调数据集、对齐评测集或量化结果。可确认的是，论文对比了既有“植入特定行为后让模型解释”的设定，并转向普通任务微调导致的副作用失配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a fine-tuned model can identify and describe unintended alignment degradation caused by task adaptation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training safety analysis setting and an extension of introspection-adapter work. It moves from explicit behavior implantation to side-effect misalignment, which is closer to deployment-time fine-tuning risk.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate side-effect introspection: after a source model is fine-tuned for a target task, unintended changes may appear in safety or alignment behavior. LoRA-style introspection adapters are then trained to make the model describe behavioral changes induced by fine-tuning. The method mainly reframes and extends the IA setup rather than proposing a new pretraining method.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full details on model scale, fine-tuning datasets, alignment benchmarks, or quantitative gains. It states that prior work focused on deliberately implanted behaviors, while this work studies unintended misalignment from ordinary task fine-tuning.

recommendation.zh: 问题设定比“植入后自述”更贴近真实微调风险；预训练侧只需看任务构造，别把自省结果当强证据。
recommendation.en: The setup is closer to real fine-tuning risk than implanted-behavior introspection; read the task construction, but do not overtrust model self-reports.

paper.title: Moving the Safety Barrier: Dynamic Routing Adaptive Alignment Against White-Box Attacks
paper.abstract: With the widespread deployment of large foundation models (LFMs) in open environments, safety threats are shifting from black-box jailbreaks toward white-box attacks that directly identify and disrupt internal safety neurons or routes. However, existing safety defenses often rely on static safety units or fixed refusal pathways, leaving models highly vulnerable to targeted route-level white-box attacks. For that, we propose dynamic routing adaptive alignment (DRAA), a framework that introduces d

summary.core_problem: 如何防御针对大语言模型内部安全神经元或路由的白盒越狱攻击？
summary.importance: 提出了一种动态路由自适应对齐框架，将安全防御从静态路径转变为动态补偿，提高了模型在白盒攻击下的鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DRAA 框架。首先通过对比安全和不安全校准样本的内部激活，定位模型的安全路由。然后掩码该路由以诱导因果失效，并挖掘防御失败案例，构建感知失效的偏好对。最后利用这些偏好对进行对齐训练，建立动态补偿路由。
summary.experiments: 未提供具体模型参数量和数据集细节。摘要宣称 DRAA 有效重构了底层模型（摘要截断，未提供完整结果）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学、新加坡国立大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: How to defend against white-box jailbreak attacks targeting internal safety neurons or routes in large language models?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a dynamic routing adaptive alignment framework, shifting safety defense from static pathways to dynamic compensation, improving model robustness under white-box attacks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the DRAA framework. It first locates the model's safety route by contrasting internal activations between safe and unsafe calibration samples. It then masks this route to induce causal failures and mines defense failure cases to construct failure-aware preference pairs. Finally, it uses these pairs for alignment training to establish dynamic compensatory routes.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model sizes and datasets are not provided in the abstract. The abstract claims DRAA effectively restructures the underlying model (abstract truncated, full results not provided).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Tsinghua University, National University of Singapore, etc.

recommendation.zh: 关注白盒攻击防御和内部表示干预的可以扫一眼，作为 literature 备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Glance if interested in white-box attack defense and internal representation intervention; keep as literature reference, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: Style Wins, Substance Loses: A Diagnosis of LLM-as-Judge in Idea Generation
paper.abstract: However, whether these judges truly evaluate the scientific substance of ideas or are influenced by superficial stylistic presentation remains an open question. To address this question, we propose SciStyleBench, a unified three-component benchmark for diagnosing and mitigating stylistic bias in LLM-based idea evaluation: (i) First, SciStyleStage, a three-stage evaluation environment that applies controlled stylistic perturbations to fixed scientific content across three settings no context, fix

summary.core_problem: 诊断 LLM-as-Judge 在科学创意评估中是否真正评价内容实质，还是被表面文风所左右。
summary.importance: Benchmark 贡献与评测方法创新：构建了可控文风扰动的科学创意评估基准，并给出风格偏倚、实质识别率、对抗胜率等量化指标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SciStyleBench 三件套：1) SciStyleStage 在三种上下文设置下对固定科学内容施加 15 种文风扰动，覆盖 600 个科学创意、每设置 9000 条评估样本；2) SciStyleMetrics 用 SBI/SRR/AWR 量化风格偏倚、实质区分能力和排序鲁棒性；3) SciStyleExtractor 作为即插即用的去偏评估模块。
summary.experiments: 在无上下文、固定领域上下文、开放检索上下文三种设置下评测主流 judge 模型，系统暴露 LLM judge 对文风的偏好强于对科学实质的区分能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Diagnoses whether LLM-as-Judge in scientific idea generation evaluates substantive merit or is primarily driven by superficial stylistic presentation.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark and evaluation methodology contribution: introduces a controlled stylistic-perturbation benchmark for scientific idea evaluation with dedicated bias-metrics and a debiasing module.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SciStyleBench with three components: SciStyleStage applies 15 style variants to fixed scientific content across three context settings (600 ideas, 9,000 instances per setting); SciStyleMetrics defines Style Bias Index, Substance Recognition Rate, and Adversarial Win Rate; SciStyleExtractor is a plug-and-play debiasing evaluator.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates mainstream judge models under no-context, fixed-domain-context, and open-retrieval-context settings; results systematically show LLM judges favor style over scientific substance.

recommendation.zh: 做对齐或自动评测的人重点看 §3 的指标定义和 §5 的偏倚模式，可直接迁移到内部 judge 质检流程。
recommendation.en: For alignment or auto-eval work, focus on §3 metric definitions and §5 bias patterns; they are directly portable to internal judge quality-control pipelines.

paper.title: Learning Latent Reasoning Traces for Scalar Reward Models End-to-End
paper.abstract: Reward models (RMs) are central to aligning large language models with human preferences via reinforcement learning. Although traditional scalar RMs enable efficient and probabilistic reward modeling, they rely on superficial cues that fail to generalize to complex or out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks. Conversely, generative RMs leverage extensive reasoning to improve robustness on challenging tasks, but their natural language-based scores lack the numerical flexibility and probabilistic interpret

summary.core_problem: 解决标量奖励模型在复杂和分布外任务上依赖表层线索、泛化差的问题，同时避免生成式奖励模型缺乏数值可解释性和概率语义的缺点。
summary.importance: 这属于 pretrain↔post-train 接口上很有价值的一类工作：不是单纯把 RM 做大，而是把“推理痕迹”作为中间潜变量直接为标量奖励服务。它对 reward signal 质量、latent reasoning、以及 RL 阶段如何反哺基础模型都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 LatentRM，把中间 reasoning traces 建模为离散潜变量，并端到端最大化下游标量奖励的似然，而不是把生成解释和标量打分并行训练。核心点在于：通过 on-policy 优化学习对 reward prediction 真正有用的潜在推理轨迹，使 reasoning 成为标量 RM 的因果中介而非旁路产物。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可知，作者将 LatentRM 与传统 scalar RM、以及生成式 RM/多任务混合范式比较，重点考察复杂任务和 OOD 场景下的鲁棒性与泛化。论文声称在多个 reward modeling 基准上取得更强性能，并提升了对困难样本的判别能力。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度，需看正文实验表确认 setup 是否干净、是否控制了推理 token 开销与 on-policy 数据分布变化。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学与腾讯。腾讯在 reward modeling、对齐和推理增强方向持续有产出；这篇工作也贴近近两年“latent reasoning / hidden CoT for supervision”这条线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the weakness of scalar reward models on complex and out-of-distribution tasks, while avoiding the loss of numerical interpretability found in generative reward models.
summary_en.importance: This is valuable at the pretrain-posttrain interface. Instead of merely scaling reward models, it treats reasoning traces as latent variables optimized specifically for scalar reward prediction. That has implications for reward-signal quality, latent reasoning, and how RL-stage supervision feeds back into foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose LatentRM, which models intermediate reasoning traces as discrete latent variables and optimizes them end-to-end for downstream scalar reward likelihood. Rather than jointly training free-form explanations and scalar scores in parallel, the method uses on-policy optimization so that the learned latent reasoning actually benefits scalar reward prediction.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, LatentRM is compared against standard scalar RMs and generative or multitask reward-modeling baselines, with emphasis on robustness and generalization on hard and OOD tasks. The paper claims stronger performance on multiple reward-modeling benchmarks and better discrimination on challenging examples. The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset scale, or exact margins, so the full paper is needed to judge whether the setup cleanly controls for reasoning-token budget and on-policy distribution shift.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University and Tencent. Tencent has been active in reward modeling, alignment, and reasoning-related post-training, and this paper fits the recent line of latent or hidden reasoning supervision.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得认真看：它在修正“RM 只需更强表征或更长解释”的 prior，建议先核查 latent trace 是否真带来 OOD 增益，而不是被 on-policy 数据分布偷了分。
recommendation.en: This is worth a careful read: it challenges the prior that reward models only need better representations or longer explanations; first verify whether the latent trace truly drives OOD gains rather than borrowing them from on-policy data shift.

paper.title: Lightning OPD 2.0: Mitigating Style Bias in Cross-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but its effectiveness can depend on teacher consistency, meaning that the model providing OPD supervision should also have generated the demonstrations used to train the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) reference. However, this condition is frequently violated in practice when SFT data have mixed or unknown provenance or when different models are preferred for SFT data generation and subsequent distillation. In such

summary.core_problem: 跨教师（SFT 数据由A模型生成、OPD 蒸馏用B模型当 teacher）时，on-policy distillation 往往失效：更强 teacher 也难带来收益。
summary.importance: 把“teacher-reference 分歧”拆成可用的上下文证据与不可用的风格/格式残差，给出一个可操作的去偏方案；对现实中混来源 SFT 数据+后续蒸馏的闭环很贴近。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Lightning OPD 2.0：用 rollout-level cross-fitting 估计并消除跨教师带来的“重复出现的风格差异分量”（措辞、格式、推理节奏等），将其作为 style residualization 的代理信号，从而让 OPD 更聚焦于内容/决策差异而非表面风格差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模与量化提升幅度；核心对比应包含：同教师 OPD vs 跨教师 OPD、以及加入 residualization 前后在推理/对齐指标上的增益与稳定性。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Song Han、Han Cai（常见于 MIT/工业界高效训练与系统方向）。

summary_en.core_problem: Cross-teacher OPD often underperforms: when SFT demos come from one model but OPD supervision comes from another, even a stronger teacher may not improve the student.
summary_en.importance: Decomposes teacher–reference disagreement into useful context-dependent evidence vs. recurring style/format residuals, offering a practical debiasing trick aligned with real mixed-provenance SFT pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Lightning OPD 2.0 introduces rollout-level cross-fitting to estimate a recurring “style component” (wording/format/reasoning cadence) and residualize it away, so OPD focuses on decision/content differences rather than stylistic mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model/data scale or numeric gains; the key comparisons should be same-teacher OPD vs cross-teacher OPD, and ablations with/without style residualization on reasoning/alignment metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Song Han and Han Cai (often associated with MIT / industry efficiency & training systems work).

recommendation.zh: 跨教师蒸馏是工业常态，这篇把“风格差异”当系统性噪声做 cross-fit 去偏，值得只读方法段看能否直接塞进 OPD/RLVR 管线。
recommendation.en: Cross-teacher distillation is the real-world default; this paper treats style mismatch as structured noise and removes it via cross-fitting—skim the method to see if it drops into your OPD/RLVR pipeline.

paper.title: OptimismBench: Forecasting Bias and the Alignment Effect in Language Model Judgment
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as decision aids whose probability judgments shape downstream choices. Whether those judgments carry a systematic directional tilt has been hard to detect: calibration metrics aggregate unsigned errors, and naturalistic uncertainty offers no ground-truth probability. When an LLM rates a startup's success at 70% but its failure at 15%, the missing 15 points expose a distortion no aggregate score flags. We introduce OptimismBench, which detects direction

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要测的是 LLM 概率判断里的方向性偏差，而不是传统校准误差。普通 ECE 这类指标只看误差大小，不看偏向正面还是负面；自然场景又没有真实概率可作标签。OptimismBench 用“正反表述成对询问”的方式，把同一场景拆成成功概率和失败概率，让模型自己的两个回答互为约束，从而暴露乐观或悲观倾向。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对基座研究有两个直接启发。第一，LLM-as-judge、自动评审、风险预测、reward model 都依赖模型的概率或偏好判断，方向性偏差会改变训练信号质量。第二，结果显示偏差方向和后训练栈强相关，同一预训练底座经过不同 alignment 后会出现压缩或放大。这说明 post-train 不只是提高可用性，也会系统性改写模型的判断先验。
summary.technical_approach: 核心设计是 inverted pairs。每个场景分别询问正面事件概率和负面事件概率，理想情况下二者应互补。论文保留互补误差的符号，构造 signed Skew，而不是只统计不一致程度。实验包含多个 track：带显式 base rate 的 sanity check、无显式基准率的自然概率判断、行动与不行动推荐、机会与风险显著性评分。主结果来自自然概率判断 track。论文还把 Skew 拆成正面轴和负面轴相对 50 的偏移，用来区分“同时高估成功和失败”的 compound overclaim、“同时低估”的 underclaim，以及更接近传统含义的乐观或悲观。
summary.experiments: 主实验覆盖 8 个提供方的 16 个模型、60 个 inverted-pair 场景、10 次采样，并做 10 种语言的扩展。16 个模型全部有显著方向性偏差，其中 14 个偏乐观；Anthropic 的 Opus 和 Sonnet 为悲观，Skew 分别约为 -5.1 和 -7.7，而同一家族的 Haiku 4.5 为 +6.1，排除了简单的“模型越大偏差越小”解释。控制实验比较 4 个模型家族的 11 组 base/chat 配对：Qwen 的 alignment 在 5 组中都压缩偏差，Llama 的 alignment 在 4 组中都放大乐观倾向；Gemma-2-2B 和 Mistral-Small-24B 作为单组 pilot 报告。跨语言分析显示模型间方差是语言间方差的 4.7 倍，说明选用哪个模型比使用哪种语言更影响偏差。论文还报告了 prompt、temperature、视角改写和显式自我去偏提示下的稳定性；对 50 分锚点和拒答率做了过滤分析，避免把拒答模式误读为低偏差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 20–30 分钟即可。优先看 Method 里 Skew 的定义和四个 track 的设计，再看 Table 1 的模型偏差方向、Figure 4 的 valence decomposition，以及 base-vs-chat 配对实验。对做 reward model、LLM judge 或自动数据筛选的人，值得多看 robustness 和拒答过滤部分，因为这些细节决定 benchmark 是否真的测到方向性偏差，而不是格式跟随或安全策略的副产物。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures directional bias in LLM probability judgments. Standard calibration metrics collapse errors into unsigned quantities, so they cannot tell whether a model systematically favors positive or negative outcomes. Natural forecasting questions also lack ground-truth probabilities. OptimismBench uses paired positive and negative framings of the same scenario, forcing the model’s own answers to serve as an internal consistency check.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant to evaluation and post-training signal quality. LLM judges, forecasting agents, reward models, and data filters all rely on model judgments that may carry a signed prior. The base-versus-chat comparison is especially useful: post-training can set or amplify the direction of this bias even when the architecture and pretraining are held fixed. That makes optimism or pessimism a property of the alignment stack, not just of scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is built around inverted pairs. For each scenario, the model is asked for the probability of a positive outcome and separately for the probability of the corresponding negative outcome. A coherent model should produce complementary estimates. The paper keeps the sign of the complement violation as a Skew score, rather than reducing it to an unsigned inconsistency measure. It also decomposes the bias into positive-axis and negative-axis deviations from a 50-point anchor, which separates classical optimism, pessimism, compound overclaim, and compound underclaim. The tracks cover explicit-base-rate sanity checks, naturalistic uncertainty, action-versus-inaction recommendations, and opportunity-versus-risk salience.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation uses 16 models from 8 providers, 60 inverted-pair scenarios, and 10 runs, with a multilingual extension over 10 languages. All 16 models show significant directional bias; 14 are optimistic. Anthropic’s Opus and Sonnet are pessimistic, with reported Skew values around -5.1 and -7.7, while Haiku 4.5 is optimistic at about +6.1. A controlled base-versus-chat probe over 11 matched pairs from Qwen, Llama, Gemma, and Mistral shows family-specific alignment effects: Qwen alignment compresses bias in all five pairs, while Llama alignment amplifies optimism in all four pairs. The cross-lingual analysis reports that inter-model variance is 4.7 times inter-language variance. The bias is reported to be stable across prompt variants, temperature, perspective changes, and explicit self-debiasing prompts.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the metric definition in the method section, the four evaluation tracks, Table 1 for model-level bias direction, Figure 4 for the valence decomposition, and the controlled base-versus-chat comparison. The robustness and refusal-filtering analyses are worth checking if the benchmark is used for LLM-as-judge or reward-model auditing, because 50-point anchoring and refusals can otherwise mask signed bias.

recommendation.zh: 读实验表和 base-chat 对比；它提示 post-train 会改概率先验符号，不只是改善校准。
recommendation.en: Read the result tables and base-chat pairs; post-training appears to change the sign of probabilistic priors, not just calibration.

paper.title: Meta-Learned Reward Shaping for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is the standard approach for aligning large language models with human preferences, but its quality is limited by static, task-agnostic reward models. This mismatch leads to sparse learning signals and suboptimal alignment. We introduce MeRLa (Meta-Learned Reward Shaping), a principled framework that meta-learns a task-aware shaping function $Φ(x,y;φ)$ across auxiliary tasks before RLHF training. The learned shaping produces a composite reward th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决 RLHF 中 reward signal 过于静态、稀疏和任务无关的问题。标准 reward model 通常给所有任务提供同一种偏好分数，难以区分细粒度质量差异，也容易被策略优化利用。MeRLa 的目标是在不改变最优策略的前提下，给 RLHF 增加任务感知的 shaping reward。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 post-train 方法，但对预训练研究有间接价值。它关注的是训练信号质量：如何让 reward 在优化过程中更平滑、更有区分度，同时避免 reward shaping 改写原始偏好目标。这个问题和 RL pretrain、持续预训练后的对齐、以及用模型生成训练信号都有共同难点：辅助信号有用，但不能让模型学到错误激励。
summary.technical_approach: MeRLa 分两阶段。第一阶段在辅助任务上 meta-learn 一个 shaping function Φ(x, y; φ)；第二阶段在常规 RLHF 中把它与基础 reward model 组合，形成 shaped reward。Φ 是一个小型 2 层 MLP，隐藏维度 256，参数量少于 1M。输入来自冻结 reference model 的倒数第二层表示，包括 prompt embedding、response embedding，以及二者差值。使用冻结 encoder 是关键取舍：它牺牲了对当前策略表示变化的适配性，但减少 representation drift，也降低每步重新抽取动态表示的成本。为了不改变原 reward 的最优策略，论文把 shaping 约束到 potential-based 形式，在自回归生成中用 token-level potential 分解近似 Ng et al. 的策略不变性条件。meta-objective 包含三项：偏好样本的 task discrimination、提高 reward 分布可分性的 entropy regularization、以及靠近 potential-based 空间的 conservation regularization。
summary.experiments: 实验以 LLaMA-3-8B 为主，比较 PPO、DPO、GRPO、DAPO 等训练方式，并在 4 个 benchmark 上报告一致增益。论文还做了 enhanced base reward 下的消融，说明 MeRLa 不只是弥补弱 reward model，也能在更强基础 reward 上提供额外 shaping。训练动态分析给出两个具体数字：reward variance 降低 37%，training instability 降低 41%，同时保持生成多样性。理论部分分析了 representation drift sensitivity 和 entropy maximization 可能带来的 incentive misalignment，这一点比单纯增加 auxiliary reward 更谨慎。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30 分钟左右。先看 §4.1 的 potential-based shaping 约束，确认它如何把 response-level reward 分解到 token-level potential；再看 §4.2 的 meta-objective，重点是 discrimination、entropy、conservation 三项如何互相制衡。§5.2 和 §5.3 值得扫一遍，因为它们解释了为什么要用冻结 reference encoder，以及为什么 entropy 不能无约束地做大。实验部分优先看 §6.2、§6.5 和 §7.3，关注它在强弱 reward、不同 RL 算法和训练稳定性上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a weakness in standard RLHF: the reward model is usually static, sparse, and task-agnostic. A single preference score is used across reasoning, safety, factuality, and creative writing, which can blur fine-grained quality differences and expose exploitable reward-model blind spots. MeRLa adds a task-aware shaping reward while trying to preserve the optimal policy induced by the original reward.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits in post-training, but it is relevant to foundation-model training through the lens of signal quality. RL pretraining, continual pretraining with feedback, and alignment all face the same tension: auxiliary rewards can improve optimization, but unconstrained rewards can change the target. The paper is useful because it treats reward shaping as a constrained learning problem rather than as another heuristic bonus.
summary_en.technical_approach: MeRLa has two phases. It first meta-learns a shaping function Φ(x, y; φ) over auxiliary tasks, then uses the learned shaping term during RLHF by combining it with the base reward model. The shaping network is a lightweight two-layer MLP with hidden size 256 and fewer than 1M parameters. Its inputs are embeddings from a frozen reference model: the prompt representation, the response representation, and their difference. Freezing the encoder is a deliberate design choice: it reduces representation drift and avoids recomputing features from the evolving policy at every RL step. To avoid changing the optimal policy, the method constrains the shaping term toward a potential-based form and decomposes response-level shaping into token-level potentials for autoregressive generation. The meta-objective combines preference discrimination, entropy regularization over shaped rewards, and a conservation penalty that keeps the shaping function close to the potential-based subspace.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments use LLaMA-3-8B and compare against PPO, DPO, GRPO, and DAPO across four benchmarks. MeRLa is reported to give consistent gains, including ablations where the base reward is strengthened, suggesting that the method is not only compensating for a weak reward model. The training-dynamics analysis reports 37% lower reward variance and 41% less training instability, while preserving generation diversity. The paper also includes theoretical analysis of representation-drift sensitivity and possible incentive misalignment from entropy maximization.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30-minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with §4.1 to understand the potential-based constraint and the token-level decomposition. Then read §4.2 for the three-part meta-objective: discrimination, entropy, and conservation. §5.2 and §5.3 explain the main design tradeoffs behind the frozen reference encoder and the bounded use of entropy. For empirical value, focus on §6.2, §6.5, and §7.3, especially the stability metrics and the ablations with stronger base rewards.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式级，但 reward shaping + policy invariance 这条线值得看；先盯理论约束和对 GRPO/DAPO 的增益，别先信总分。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but the reward-shaping-with-policy-invariance angle is worth checking; read the theory and the gains over GRPO/DAPO before trusting the headline numbers.

paper.title: Inverse RL Helps Align AI by Imitating Humans
paper.abstract: Language model alignment aims to make model behavior reliably reflect desirable properties such as helpfulness, safety, and instruction following. Current approaches typically use supervised fine-tuning on demonstrations or reinforcement learning with rewards derived from verifiers or human feedback. These paradigms leave an important question underexplored: can demonstrations alone yield an implicit reward that can be inspected, reused, and optimized on-policy to align AI? Motivated by inverse

summary.core_problem: 现有对齐范式中，专家演示仅用于监督微调，无法从中恢复出可解释、可审计、可在推理时复用、也可用于策略梯度优化的显式奖励函数；传统逆强化学习方法恢复的奖励通常与策略本身同样黑盒，难以用于对齐场景的可控优化。
summary.importance: 提出了仅依赖演示数据、不依赖偏好标注或独立验证器的显式奖励恢复范式；对演示数据利用率低、奖励标注成本高、需要可审计对齐信号的后训练场景有启发，也为从 SFT 数据中二次提取优化信号、衔接 SFT 与 RL 阶段提供了一条新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PARED（Projected Alignment Reward Estimated from Demonstrations）：将每条「上下文-回复」轨迹投影到人工选定的低维语义特征空间（如 helpfulness、harmlessness、topic 坐标，显式排除长度等易被利用的特征），用轻量级逻辑斯蒂判别器区分专家演示分布与当前策略采样分布；判别器输出的「专家相似度分数」直接作为标量奖励 r = log D(φ(τ))。该奖励有两种使用方式：推理时做 best-of-N 重排序，无需额外训练；训练时作为 KL 正则化在线 RL 的奖励信号，并随策略更新定期用最新的 on-policy 样本重新拟合判别器，避免奖励过时。在受众条件对齐场景下，可共享同一个基础策略，为不同目标受众分别训练独立的 PARED 奖励，实现多目标对齐。
summary.experiments: 在受众条件上下文对齐任务上验证：PARED 作为 best-of-N 重排序器即可显著优于基础模型；在 SFT 之后继续应用 PARED 在线 RL 能获得进一步提升，说明演示中仍残留 SFT 未完全提取的优化信号。针对不同受众分别训练的奖励均能带来对应方向的对齐收益，未出现一个受众的提升以另一个受众退化为代价的明显权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读预计 15–25 分钟。重点关注第 2 节的问题形式化与特征投影设计思路、图 1 的整体流程；若关心落地细节可查看判别器特征选择与在线重训练频率的消融实验。核心启发在于「把演示当作分布匹配问题而非单纯模仿学习」的思路，具体实验规模较小，方法本身的可迁移性需要结合自身数据验证。
summary.authors_note: Carnegie Mellon University；通讯作者 Mateusz Wilinski (mwilinsk@cs.cmu.edu)

summary_en.core_problem: In current alignment pipelines, expert demonstrations are used only for supervised fine-tuning and are never distilled into an explicit reward function that is interpretable, auditable, reusable at inference time, or optimizable via policy gradients. Classical inverse RL methods recover rewards that are typically as opaque as the policies themselves, making them unsuitable for controllable alignment.
summary_en.importance: PARED establishes a demonstration-only, explicit-reward recovery paradigm that requires neither preference labels nor an independent verifier. It improves utilization of demonstration data, offers an auditable alignment signal, and opens a new path to extract a second optimization signal from existing SFT corpora, bridging the SFT and RL stages more tightly.
summary_en.technical_approach: PARED (Projected Alignment Reward Estimated from Demonstrations) first projects every context-response trajectory into a practitioner-chosen, low-dimensional semantic feature space (e.g. helpfulness, harmlessness, topic coordinates, with length and other easily exploitable features explicitly excluded). A lightweight logistic discriminator separates the expert-demonstration distribution from the current policy's sample distribution in this feature space; its expert-likeness score is used directly as a scalar reward r = log D(φ(τ)). This reward supports two downstream uses: best-of-N reranking at inference time with no further training, or KL-regularized on-policy RL. As the policy evolves, the discriminator is periodically refit against fresh on-policy samples to avoid reward staleness. In audience-conditioned contextual alignment, a single shared policy can be paired with separate PARED rewards per target audience to support multi-objective alignment.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are conducted on audience-conditioned contextual alignment tasks. PARED already outperforms the base model when used only as a best-of-N reranker. When applied as on-policy RL after standard SFT, it delivers further gains, demonstrating that demonstrations carry optimization signal not fully extracted by supervised imitation. Audience-specific rewards each improve alignment on their target audience without a visible degradation on the other audience, showing no obvious zero-sum tradeoff.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time estimate: 15–25 minutes. Focus on Section 2 for problem formalization and the design rationale behind feature projection, and Figure 1 for the end-to-end pipeline. For implementation details, check ablations on feature selection and discriminator refit frequency. The main transferable insight is framing demonstrations as a distribution-matching problem rather than pure imitation; reported experiments are relatively small-scale, so real-world applicability should be validated against one's own data.
summary_en.authors_note: Carnegie Mellon University; corresponding author Mateusz Wilinski (mwilinsk@cs.cmu.edu)

recommendation.zh: 值得看奖励参数化和 on-policy loop；若实验规模小，只能当偏好标注替代方案的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the reward parameterization and on-policy loop; if the experiments are small, treat it only as weak evidence for replacing preference labels.

paper.title: DecoEvo: Score-Decoupled Co-Evolution of Solver and Rubric-Generator Skills in Text Space
paper.abstract: Text-space optimization adapts large language models (LLMs) by editing external natural-language artifacts rather than model weights, so the optimized artifacts remain inspectable and the model can be treated as a black box. However, most existing text-space methods keep evaluation fixed. On open-ended tasks, this can become a bottleneck: once the solver improves on the criteria a rubric measures, omitted dimensions remain invisible to the optimization signal. Simply evolving the rubric is also

summary.core_problem: 开放式任务中文本空间优化存在固定rubric瓶颈，且rubric进化时易被solver通过降低rubric难度刷分，导致虚假进步。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出解耦式协同进化框架，无需金标rubric即可同时优化solver与rubric生成能力，避免评分对齐陷阱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DecoEvo框架，将solver skill与rubric-generator skill的优化目标解耦：solver基于准则级反馈更新，rubric生成器通过需求覆盖度与响应质量的互补审计迭代，不依赖solver得分选择rubric更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验设置与量化结果，仅提及方法针对开放式文本任务设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Text-space optimization on open-ended tasks suffers from fixed rubric bottlenecks, and naive rubric evolution is prone to score hacking where solvers make rubrics easier instead of improving actual capability.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a decoupled co-evolution framework that jointly improves solver and rubric-generator skills without gold rubrics, avoiding the score alignment trap in co-evolution.
summary_en.technical_approach: DecoEvo decouples the objectives of solver skill and rubric-generator skill: the solver is updated with criterion-level feedback, while the rubric generator is revised via complementary audits of requirement coverage and response quality, rather than being selected by the solver's score.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental setup and quantitative results are not fully disclosed in the abstract; the method is designed for open-ended text tasks.

recommendation.zh: rubric与solver解耦协同进化的思路对RLHF奖励模型迭代有参考，作为文献备查即可，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: The decoupled rubric-solver co-evolution idea offers minor reference for RLHF reward model iteration; keep as literature backup, no need for full reading.

paper.title: SafeFlow: Semantic Information-Flow Control for Blocking Malicious Propagation in Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems improve capability through task decomposition and role specialization, but these same mechanisms introduce an important safety blind spot: a harmful objective can be fragmented into locally plausible subtasks, allowing malicious intent to evade detection by any single agent. This is a growing social-impact challenge: systems handling sensitive information or consequential tools can turn routine delegation into unauthorized disclosure or unsafe action. We argue that this failu

summary.core_problem: 多智能体系统中恶意目标可被拆解为局部合理的子任务，单智能体级别的安全检测（如对齐、越狱防御、单轮提示分类）无法捕捉跨智能体的语义依赖链，导致恶意意图通过任务分解传播，造成隐私泄露或不安全操作。
summary.importance: 多智能体协作场景下的安全对齐不能仅依赖单样本级别的监督，跨步骤的语义信息流约束思路可拓展到长程推理、多步工具调用等场景的安全对齐训练，也为后训练阶段的安全信号构造提供了结构化的风险传播建模方法。
summary.technical_approach: SafeFlow将多智能体中的恶意跨智能体传播形式化为语义信息流控制问题，设计五阶段防御框架：1）污点标注：为根请求标注初始语义风险污点；2）传播：沿任务委托、消息传递、工具调用等依赖边在协作图中传播污点；3）上下文重建：组装全工作流的风险证据；4）全局校验：检查协作图中是否存在预设的源-汇风险路径；5）归因感知决策：在不可逆操作提交前（硬汇点）执行拦截。核心设计是延迟裁决，仅当多个局部合理步骤组合成明确风险路径时才判定拦截，平衡安全性与可用性。
summary.experiments: 在覆盖提示注入、越狱工具使用、风险代码执行、有害网页智能体行为的四个基准上评测，SafeFlow将平均攻击成功率从69.3%降至12.7%，同时保留较高的良性任务可用性，在对比方法中取得最优的安全-效用平衡；核心流水线阶段移除后性能显著下降，且在更强的越狱增强攻击下仍保持鲁棒性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3节的语义信息流建模与五阶段框架设计（尤其是污点传播规则、源-汇风险模式的定义），以及实验部分的安全-效用权衡分析；预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-agent systems, malicious objectives can be decomposed into locally plausible subtasks, while single-agent-level safety detection (such as alignment, jailbreak defense, single-turn prompt classification) fails to capture cross-agent semantic dependency chains, allowing malicious intent to propagate through task decomposition and cause privacy leakage or unsafe operations.
summary_en.importance: Safety alignment for multi-agent collaboration scenarios cannot rely solely on per-sample supervision; the cross-step semantic information flow constraint design can be extended to safety alignment training for long-horizon reasoning and multi-step tool calling scenarios, and provides a structured risk propagation modeling method for safety signal construction in the post-training stage.
summary_en.technical_approach: SafeFlow formalizes malicious cross-agent propagation in multi-agent systems as a semantic information-flow control problem, with a five-stage defense framework: 1) Taint annotation: attach initial semantic risk taints to the root request; 2) Propagation: propagate taints along dependency edges (task delegation, message passing, tool calling) in the collaboration graph; 3) Context reconstruction: assemble risk evidence from the full workflow; 4) Global validation: check for predefined source-sink risk patterns in the collaboration graph; 5) Attribution-aware decision: block actions at hard sinks (before irreversible operations are committed). The core design is deferred adjudication, which triggers blocking only when multiple locally plausible steps compose into an explicit risk path to balance safety and utility.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on four benchmarks covering prompt injection, jailbreak tool use, risky code execution and harmful web-agent behavior, SafeFlow reduces average attack success rate from 69.3% to 12.7% while retaining high benign task utility, achieving the best safety-utility trade-off among compared methods. Performance degrades significantly when core pipeline stages are removed, and the framework remains robust under stronger jailbreak augmentations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for semantic information flow modeling and the five-stage framework design (especially taint propagation rules and source-sink risk pattern definitions), plus the safety-utility trade-off analysis in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把多 agent 越狱当信息流控制来做是对的方向；先读 taint 设计与传播/验证规则，实验若缺强对抗集就当框架草案。
recommendation.en: Treating multi-agent jailbreaks as information-flow control is the right framing; read the taint/propagation/validation design first, and discount claims if adversarial eval is weak.

paper.title: COVENANT: Natural-Language Workflow Compilation for Aligned Agent Execution
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly entrusted with natural-language workflow instructions (e.g., retail-payment policies) that specify not only what outcome to achieve, but also which steps, branches, and tool interactions are permitted. When these instructions are supplied as prompt context, however, the model retains control over both procedure selection and step execution. As interactions accumulate, an agent can skip required steps, take unsupported branches, or execute a vali

summary.core_problem: LLM 智能体在执行自然语言工作流指令时，容易跳过步骤、走非法分支或产生不合规参数，即工作流错位问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出编译器-解释器架构 COVENANT，将工作流指令从 prompt 转为可执行的控制流结构。
summary.technical_approach: 把自然语言工作流指令视为源程序，编译为工作流抽象语法树（WAST），再降级为工作流控制流图（WCFG）；运行时由控制器逐节点解释执行并做合规校验，模型只负责节点内的具体动作。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验设置、模型规模与量化效果。
summary.authors_note: 作者 Jincheng Wang、Min Zheng、Tao Wei，机构信息未在摘要中明确。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents executing natural-language workflow instructions often skip steps, take invalid branches, or produce non-compliant arguments—a failure mode called workflow misalignment.
summary_en.importance: Architectural innovation: proposes COVENANT, a compiler-and-interpreter architecture that treats workflow instructions as programs rather than prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach: Natural-language workflow instructions are compiled into a Workflow Abstract Syntax Tree (WAST) and lowered to a Workflow Control-Flow Graph (WCFG); a runtime controller interprets the WCFG node by node and enforces compliance, while the model only handles actions within each node.
summary_en.experiments: Detailed experimental setup, model scale, and quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are Jincheng Wang, Min Zheng, and Tao Wei; institutional affiliation is not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把工作流从 prompt 编译成控制流的思路工程上合理，但属于智能体系统层设计，与预训练关系远。
recommendation.en: Compiling workflows into control-flow graphs is sound engineering, but it lives at the agent system layer, far from pretraining.

paper.title: STAIF: A Stage-wise Optimization for Complex Instruction Following
paper.abstract: Following complex instructions with multiple explicit constraints remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs). Existing alignment methods, such as DPO, optimize holistic reward signals that often underemphasize strict satisfaction of individual constraints, particularly under out-of-distribution or multi-constraint settings. In this paper, we propose STAIF, a stage-wise optimization framework that decouples the alignment of subjective (soft) constraints from the optimization

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是复杂 instruction following 里的一个老问题，但切得更细：当用户指令同时包含多种约束时，现有对齐方法往往用一个整体偏好信号去优化，结果是软约束和硬约束被混在一起学，模型可能整体“像是更好”，但对某些必须满足的格式、结构、计数、语言、JSON 合法性之类的硬条件并不稳定。论文要解决的是：能否把不同类型约束拆开优化，让模型既学会主观偏好层面的风格/语气/内容倾向，也能对可验证约束做到更严格的逐项满足，尤其是在多约束和分布外组合下仍然保持稳定。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-train / alignment 侧的方法与数据工作，所以被标成 skim 是合适的。但它仍有两个值得注意的点。第一，它把 instruction following 里的约束异质性讲清楚了：不是所有约束都该用同一种目标学。软约束更适合偏好学习，硬约束更适合 verifier 驱动的 RL。这个拆分对做 reward design、RLVR、可验证对齐的人有现实参考。第二，它配套构建了 StaInstruct，一个带正样本、多负样本和 verifier code 的双语复杂约束数据集。对研究“训练信号质量”与“可验证奖励数据构造”的人，这部分比模型本身更有启发。若从 pretrain-posttrain 接口看，这篇论文说明：当训练目标和数据标注结构与任务结构对齐时，小模型也能在复杂行为约束上获得明显收益。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 StaIF，核心是 stage-wise optimization，而不是把所有约束揉进一个统一损失里。作者先把约束分成两类：soft constraints 是主观、偏好型、难以程序验证的要求，比如语气、风格、鼓励性表达；hard constraints 是客观、可规则检查的要求，比如输出 JSON、包含指定字段、满足字数/格式/语言/枚举条件等。

Stage 1 用 preference optimization 去学 soft constraints，而且不是传统一对一 chosen/rejected，而是为同一条复杂指令构造多个负样本。这样做的理由很直接：复杂指令里常见的失败不是“完全错”，而是漏掉某一条约束、部分满足、风格偏差、格式轻微违规。多负样本能让模型看到更细粒度的错误形态，提升对软约束差异的辨别力。摘要和正文都提到这一阶段使用 multiple negative samples 来 sharpen sensitivity。

Stage 2 用 RLVR，具体实现是 GRPO，在有 verifier 的硬约束上直接做强化学习。这里的关键不是再训练一个 reward model，而是利用规则验证器给出确定性奖励，避免整体偏好目标把硬约束信号稀释掉。对于复杂 instruction following，这种设计是合理的，因为很多失败模式是离散的、可判定的，适合 binary 或 scalar verifier。

数据侧，作者提出自动化复杂约束合成框架，并构建 StaInstruct。数据构造不是简单拼接约束，而是显式建模 task-constraint compatibility，过滤无效、冗余、冲突约束。每条样本包含复杂指令、正样本回答、多个针对 soft constraints 的负样本，以及针对 hard constraints 的规则验证代码。这个数据结构正好支撑两阶段训练：第一阶段吃 preference triples / listwise negatives，第二阶段吃 verifier reward。

和常见 DPO 或单阶段 RL 相比，StaIF 的区别不在公式多新，而在训练信号分解得更贴近任务结构。作者的主张是：如果把软硬约束混在一个 holistic objective 里，模型会倾向于优化整体可接受性，而不是逐条满足关键约束；分阶段训练则能减少这种目标冲突。
summary.experiments:
实验在三个 instruction-following benchmark 上做：IFEval、IFBench、CFBench。底座模型选了两个开源模型：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Tulu3-8B-SFT。论文声称在这两个底座上都得到一致提升，并且 StaIF 训练后的 Tulu3-8B-SFT 在 IFEval 和 IFBench 上能接近一些更大闭源模型的水平。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格，这里不编造具体分数，但可以确认几个实验重点。

第一，主结果证明两阶段训练优于只做单阶段偏好优化或其他基线，且提升覆盖多个 benchmark，而不是只在一个数据集上有效。第二，ablation 显示两个阶段都有效：只做 Stage 1 会改善软约束相关表现，但对严格可验证约束不够；加入 Stage 2 后，hard constraint compliance 进一步提高。第三，多负样本设计是有效的。作者专门做了 negative sampling 的实验，说明多个负样本比单个 rejected response 提供更强的对比学习信号。第四，作者强调泛化而非记忆，说明他们做了更细粒度分析，检查模型是否只是记住训练模板，还是能迁移到新的约束组合。

如果从研究角度看，最值得留意的不是 benchmark 排名，而是约束类型拆分后的误差分析：哪些约束在 DPO 下容易被忽略，哪些约束在 verifier RL 下最容易被拉起来，以及 bilingual 数据是否让中文复杂指令跟随能力有额外收益。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按“问题定义—数据—两阶段训练—消融”这个顺序看。

先看 Introduction，重点理解作者为什么坚持把 soft / hard constraints 分开。若这一点不认同，后面的设计就很难成立。

然后看 StaInstruct 数据构造部分。这里比方法公式更重要，因为复杂 instruction following 的上限很大程度取决于训练样本是否真的覆盖了多约束、冲突过滤、负样本多样性和 verifier 质量。要特别看 task-constraint compatibility、冲突过滤、以及 verifier code 是怎么生成和筛选的。

接着看 Stage 1 和 Stage 2 的训练细节，尤其是 multiple negatives 如何组织、GRPO 的 reward 如何定义。最后看 ablation：单阶段 vs 两阶段、多负样本 vs 单负样本、不同 benchmark 上的约束类型表现。

预计 25-35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若时间很少，优先看数据构造图、主结果表和 ablation 表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in complex instruction following: when an instruction contains multiple constraints, existing alignment methods often optimize a single holistic preference signal, which blurs together heterogeneous requirements. As a result, models may improve in overall helpfulness while still failing strict must-satisfy constraints such as format, structure, counting, language, or valid JSON. The question is whether one can separate the optimization of subjective soft constraints from objectively verifiable hard constraints, so that the model learns both nuanced preference alignment and strict per-constraint compliance, especially under multi-constraint and out-of-distribution combinations.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper; it is better viewed as a post-training and alignment paper, so skim is the right level. Still, it has two useful ideas. First, it makes the heterogeneity of instruction constraints explicit: not all constraints should be learned with the same objective. Soft constraints fit preference learning better, while hard constraints fit verifier-driven RL better. That is relevant for reward design, RLVR, and verifiable alignment. Second, the paper contributes StaInstruct, a bilingual dataset with positive responses, multiple negatives, and verifier code for complex instructions. For researchers interested in training-signal quality and the construction of verifiable supervision, the data design may be more useful than the model recipe itself. From a pretrain-posttrain interface perspective, it is a clean example of how better alignment between task structure and supervision structure can produce meaningful gains even on relatively small open models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, StaIF, is a stage-wise optimization framework rather than a single unified objective. The paper splits constraints into two categories. Soft constraints are subjective and preference-like, such as tone, style, or encouraging phrasing. Hard constraints are objective and programmatically checkable, such as valid JSON, required fields, word-count limits, language requirements, or explicit formatting rules.

Stage 1 uses preference optimization to learn soft constraints. A notable design choice is the use of multiple negative responses for the same instruction rather than a single chosen/rejected pair. This matters because failures on complex instructions are often partial: a response may satisfy some constraints while missing others, or may be semantically correct but stylistically off. Multiple negatives expose the model to a richer set of near-miss errors and sharpen its sensitivity to soft-constraint violations.

Stage 2 applies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, implemented with GRPO. The key idea is to optimize hard constraints directly using deterministic verifiers instead of relying on a learned reward model or a holistic preference objective. For complex instruction following, this is a natural fit because many important failures are discrete and checkable.

On the data side, the paper proposes an automated synthesis pipeline and builds StaInstruct. The construction is not just random constraint concatenation. It explicitly models task-constraint compatibility and filters invalid, redundant, or conflicting constraints. Each example includes a complex instruction, a high-quality positive response, multiple negative responses targeted at soft constraints, and rule-based verification code for hard constraints. This data structure aligns cleanly with the two training stages: preference learning in Stage 1 and verifier-based RL in Stage 2.

Compared with standard DPO or single-stage RL, the novelty is less about a new optimization formula and more about decomposing the training signal to match the structure of the task. The paper’s claim is that a holistic objective tends to optimize overall acceptability, while stage-wise training improves strict per-constraint satisfaction.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is conducted on three instruction-following benchmarks: IFEval, IFBench, and CFBench. Two open-source base models are used: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Tulu3-8B-SFT. The paper reports consistent gains across these bases and benchmarks, and states that StaIF-trained Tulu3-8B-SFT becomes competitive with some much larger proprietary models on IFEval and IFBench. Since the provided text does not include the full result tables, I will not fabricate exact scores, but the experimental structure is clear.

First, the main results show that the two-stage setup outperforms single-stage preference optimization and other baselines across multiple benchmarks, not just on one dataset. Second, the ablations indicate that both stages matter: Stage 1 improves soft-constraint sensitivity, while adding Stage 2 further strengthens strict compliance on verifiable constraints. Third, the multiple-negative design is empirically useful. The paper includes negative-sampling experiments showing that multiple rejected responses provide a stronger contrastive signal than a single negative. Fourth, the authors emphasize generalization rather than template memorization, suggesting that they analyze whether the model transfers to unseen combinations of constraints rather than merely fitting the training patterns.

For a researcher, the most interesting part is not the leaderboard position but the error breakdown by constraint type: which constraints are under-optimized by DPO-like objectives, which ones respond most to verifier-based RL, and whether the bilingual setup yields extra gains for Chinese complex instruction following.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim order is: problem formulation, data construction, the two training stages, then ablations.

Start with the introduction and make sure the soft-vs-hard constraint split is convincing to you. The rest of the paper depends on that framing.

Then read the StaInstruct section carefully. It is arguably more important than the optimization details, because the ceiling on complex instruction following depends heavily on whether the training data really covers multi-constraint composition, conflict filtering, negative diversity, and verifier quality. Pay special attention to task-constraint compatibility, conflict filtering, and how verifier code is generated and validated.

After that, read the Stage 1 and Stage 2 training details, especially how multiple negatives are organized and how GRPO rewards are defined. Finally, inspect the ablations: single-stage vs two-stage, single-negative vs multiple-negatives, and performance broken down by benchmark or constraint type.

A useful skim should take about 25-35 minutes. If time is short, prioritize the data construction figure, the main result table, and the ablation table.

recommendation.zh: 软硬约束解耦的两阶段对齐思路比整体DPO更符合约束满足的结构，重点看阶段2可验证奖励的设计与负样本构造方式，可复用到预训练后对齐的约束类任务。
recommendation.en: The two-stage alignment idea decoupling soft/hard constraints is structurally more sound than holistic DPO; focus on Stage 2 verifiable reward design and negative sample construction, reusable for constraint-heavy post-pretraining alignment.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Inference-Time Consensus for Mitigating Hidden Behaviors from LLM Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on even a small amount of poisoned data can install targeted misbehavior, and ostensibly benign data can transmit hidden preferences that generalize broadly. Standard defenses, such as data filtering, mixing in harmless data, and regularization, attenuate these effects but do not eliminate them. We instead pursue robustness through redundancy: collecting multiple datasets from different sources and only learning what is common between them. Thus

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是多来源微调数据中的隐蔽投毒问题：当少数数据源带有不可从样本表面识别的偏好、人格或目标行为时，常规过滤、混入安全数据、KL 正则只能削弱这些行为，不能可靠地阻断它们。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口有直接参考价值。它把数据供应链安全从“检测坏样本”转为“利用来源冗余做行为共识”。这个视角适合用于多供应商 SFT、领域继续预训练、数据合成管线和模型合并场景。主要启发不在于提出一个可直接替代常规训练的解码器，而在于指出：如果某个行为只来自单一来源，那么平均式训练目标会保留它的弱信号；要消除它，需要带有否决性质的聚合机制。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先按数据来源分别从同一个 base model 微调得到一组 reference models，而不是把所有数据合并训练一个模型。推理时聚合这些模型的 next-token distributions，只保留多个来源共同支持的 token。论文提出两类 consensus decoder：一种是 token-wise minimum aggregation，用各来源对同一 token 的概率下界作为共识信号；另一种是 base-relative minimum aggregation，先看每个来源相对 base model 对 token 概率的提升，再取最小提升，避免单纯概率低估常见 token 或受 base prior 影响过强。和 KL regularization、union training、LoRA weight merging 的区别在于，这里不是平均不同来源的行为，而是让单一来源无法单独抬高某个行为的生成概率。论文还讨论了 quorum aggregation 和 semantic smoothing，用来放松严格一致性：前者允许只要求达到一定来源数的共识，后者缓解不同来源用不同表面表达传递同一 benefit 的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖显式投毒、subliminal learning、emergent misalignment 等设置，并与 union training、LoRA 权重合并、whole-output consensus sampling 比较。核心结果是 consensus decoder 能保留多来源共享的目标能力，同时显著压制只由单个来源携带的 unwanted behavior。论文还给出一个关键理论观察：对多个 reference models 做 KL 正则时，最优解等价于对这些分布求平均，因此恶意来源的行为会被稀释但不会被否决。这个结论解释了为什么常见正则化防御在隐蔽投毒下只能缓解，难以消除。摘要和引言未提供完整数值表、模型规模和数据规模，精确数字需要查看实验章节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。优先看问题设定和 threat model，尤其是 attributable sources 与 support margin 两个假设；再看 Lemma 1，它是论文区分“平均式防御”和“否决式防御”的关键；随后看 consensus aggregation 的定义，重点理解 minimum aggregation 与 base-relative minimum aggregation 的差异。实验部分建议重点看三类攻击设置下与 union training、KL regularization、LoRA merging 的对比，以及 quorum 和 semantic smoothing 的消融。需要保持一个限制意识：方法依赖来源可追踪，并假设目标 benefit 比任一 cost 得到更多来源支持；如果攻击者串通或供应链高度同质，这个假设会变弱。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies hidden behavior injection in multi-source fine-tuning. A small number of malicious or biased sources can transmit targeted behaviors that are not detectable from the surface form of the data, while standard filtering, benign-data mixing, and KL regularization only attenuate these behaviors rather than removing them.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution is a shift from sample-level detection to source-level redundancy. This is relevant to SFT data procurement, continual pretraining with licensed corpora, synthetic-data pipelines, and model-merging workflows. The paper makes a concrete point for pretraining and post-training practice: averaging objectives preserve weak source-specific signals, whereas eliminating such signals requires an aggregation rule with a veto-like structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method trains one reference model per data source, all initialized from the same base model. At decoding time, it aggregates their next-token distributions and keeps tokens only when multiple source-specific models support them. The paper introduces token-wise minimum aggregation and base-relative minimum aggregation. The latter compares each reference model’s token probability against the base model and then aggregates relative improvements, reducing the risk that raw probabilities are dominated by the base prior. This differs from union training, KL regularization, and LoRA weight merging: those methods average source effects, while the proposed decoders prevent a single source from independently increasing the probability of a poisoned behavior. The paper also adds quorum aggregation and semantic smoothing to handle cases where not every source contains the desired benefit or where different sources express the same benefit with different surface forms.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluations cover explicit poisoning, subliminal learning, and emergent misalignment. The proposed consensus decoders are compared with union training, LoRA weight merging, and whole-output consensus sampling. The reported pattern is that shared beneficial behavior is largely preserved, while behavior tied to one source is suppressed. A central theoretical result is that KL regularization toward multiple reference models is minimized by an average of their distributions, so source-specific misbehavior is diluted but not vetoed. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, model sizes, or dataset sizes; those details should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the threat model, especially the attributable-source and support-margin assumptions. Then read Lemma 1, because it explains why regularization behaves like averaging. After that, focus on the definitions of minimum aggregation and base-relative minimum aggregation. In the experiments, prioritize the comparisons against union training, KL-style regularization, and LoRA merging, plus the ablations for quorum aggregation and semantic smoothing. The main limitation to track is that the defense depends on known source identity and on the desired behavior being supported by more sources than any single unwanted behavior.

recommendation.zh: 推理时冗余防御的思路值得后训练安全团队参考，只读§3的两种共识解码器设计部分即可
recommendation.en: The inference-time redundancy defense idea is valuable for post-training safety teams; only read §3 for the two consensus decoder designs

paper.title: Beyond Direct Answering: Aligning Educational LLMs as Socratic Guides via Heuristic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in educational settings often behave as direct answerers: they disclose target concepts in the opening turn instead of guiding students through progressive inquiry, as Socratic pedagogy prescribes. We present HeuristicEdu, a two-phase pipeline that aligns Qwen2.5-7B toward Socratic tutoring via supervised warm-up and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Training uses SocraticEdu, 797 multi-turn Chinese children's science dialogues reconstructed from a

summary.core_problem: 教育场景中的 LLM 往往直接给答案，而不是像苏格拉底式导师那样通过追问逐步引导学生；这篇工作试图用后训练把模型行为从“答题器”改成“引导者”。
summary.importance: 贡献属于场景化对齐与奖励设计，而不是通用推理或预训练方法。对基座研究员的价值主要在于：它展示了启发式 reward 如何塑造对话策略，以及 reward 项之间可能存在冲突。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HeuristicEdu，两阶段训练：先用 797 条中文儿童科学多轮对话做 supervised warm-up，再用 GRPO 优化启发式奖励。奖励由认知深度、好奇心参与度、直接性惩罚组成，并加入 K_query 修正以处理学生主动引入的术语。作者还定义了 Scaffolding Effectiveness 和 Conversation Depth 两个评估指标，试图衡量是否真正实现了逐步引导。
summary.experiments: 基座模型是 Qwen2.5-7B，在 30 个留出问题上评测。最佳 GRPO 变体把 SE 从 30.0% 提升到 63.3%，并把关键词泄露率从 30.0% 降到 13.3%。摘要特别提到最佳变体在优化时反而去掉了 directness penalty，这提示 reward 设计存在相互牵制，但样本规模和评测规模都偏小，结论更适合作为案例而非稳定规律。

summary_en.core_problem: Educational LLMs often answer too directly instead of guiding students through Socratic questioning; this paper tries to post-train a model to behave more like a tutor than an answer engine.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a domain-shaped alignment and reward-design study rather than a general reasoning or pretraining advance. Its value to foundation-model researchers is mostly in showing how heuristic rewards can steer dialogue policy and how reward terms can interfere with one another.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes HeuristicEdu, a two-stage pipeline with supervised warm-up on 797 Chinese children's science dialogues followed by GRPO using heuristic rewards. The reward combines cognitive depth, curiosity engagement, and directness, plus a K_query correction for student-introduced terms. It also introduces Scaffolding Effectiveness and Conversation Depth as evaluation metrics.
summary_en.experiments: The base model is Qwen2.5-7B, evaluated on 30 held-out questions. The best GRPO variant improves SE from 30.0% to 63.3% and reduces keyword leakage from 30.0% to 13.3%. Notably, the best variant omits the directness penalty during optimization, suggesting reward-term interference. Given the small training and evaluation scale, the paper is better read as a case study than a robust general result.

recommendation.zh: 这是小样本场景化 RL，对基座研究只剩 reward design 的边角料；看结果表里“去掉 directness penalty 反而更好”这一点就够了。
recommendation.en: This is small-scale domain RL; for foundation-model work, the only interesting bit is that removing the directness penalty actually helped—read that table and stop.
