recommendation.en: Important foundational work on post-training reward model calibration, focus on the calibration concept definition and RLHF empirical sections.

paper.title: Feedback-to-Rubrics: Can We Learn Expert Criteria from Inline Comments?
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for writing and review support, but their usefulness depends on context-dependent criteria, such as expert preferences or organization-specific conventions, that are often tacit, undocumented, and difficult to elicit directly. We propose a problem setting for learning reusable natural-language rubrics from accumulated inline comments on artifacts such as human-written or LLM-generated drafts. Our method infers rubrics from these comments and ite

summary.core_problem: 如何从人类或LLM在文档草稿上留下的内联评论（inline comments）中，自动提取和学习出可复用的、专家级的自然语言评估标准（rubrics）？
summary.importance: 提出了一种从隐性反馈中提取显性评估标准的新问题设定和方法，有助于将专家偏好提炼为可用于 LLM 评估或生成的规则。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个迭代提炼框架：首先从评论中推断初始 rubrics，然后通过观察基于 rubric 的预测评论与真实参考评论之间的不匹配，迭代地修正和完善这些 rubrics。
summary.experiments: 在真实世界的审查场景和带有参考 rubrics 的受控场景中进行评估，证明了内联评论可以被提炼成支持评论预测、rubric 理解和自动工件修订的可复用 rubrics。

summary_en.core_problem: How to automatically extract and learn reusable, expert-level natural-language criteria (rubrics) from inline comments left by humans or LLMs on document drafts?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel problem setting and method for extracting explicit evaluation criteria from implicit feedback, useful for distilling expert preferences into rules for LLM evaluation or generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes an iterative refinement framework: first infers initial rubrics from comments, then iteratively refines them by observing mismatches between rubric-conditioned predicted comments and actual reference comments.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated in real-world review settings and controlled settings with reference rubrics, demonstrating that inline comments can be distilled into reusable rubrics supporting comment prediction, rubric understanding, and automatic artifact revision.

recommendation.zh: 从人类 review 评论中反向提取 evaluation rubrics 的方法，属于对齐和评测标准构建的范畴，作为后训练/评测数据构造的思路可简单了解。
recommendation.en: Method for reverse-engineering evaluation rubrics from human review comments, falling into alignment and evaluation criteria construction. Good to know as an idea for post-training/evaluation data construction.

paper.title: When Does Persona Prompting Actually Help? A Retrieval and Metric Analysis of Expert Role Injection in LLMs
paper.abstract: Persona prompting is widely used to steer large language models, yet its practical value remains unclear. Prior work often evaluates persona prompting using aggregate scores, making it difficult to determine whether expert-role prompting consistently improves response quality or instead changes responses along different quality dimensions. We study this question through a controlled comparison of four prompting conditions across 1,140 open-ended questions spanning 38 expert roles and six domains

summary.core_problem: 人格/角色提示(persona prompting)在LLM中被广泛使用，但其实际价值和作用机制尚不清晰；已有研究多用聚合分数评估，无法区分是真正提升质量还是在不同维度上发生了权衡。
summary.importance: 机制分析类贡献：通过控制变量实验系统研究了专家角色注入的效果，揭示了聚合平均掩盖的维度权衡——角色提示增加专业深度但降低清晰度，且效果高度依赖条件而非普遍有效。
summary.technical_approach: 在1140个开放问题、38个专家角色、6个领域上对四种提示条件(无角色/通用专家/嵌入检索角色/混合检索)进行受控比较，用多维度metric拆解聚合评分掩盖的效果异质性。
summary.experiments: 覆盖38个专家角色×6个领域×1140个开放问题；四种提示策略对照；聚合结果显示条件间总体差异很小，但metric级分析揭示了一致的深度-清晰度权衡，效果高度条件化。

summary_en.core_problem: Persona prompting is widely used to steer LLMs, but its practical value and mechanism remain unclear; prior work relies on aggregate scores that cannot distinguish genuine quality improvements from dimension-level tradeoffs.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis: a controlled comparison across 1,140 questions, 38 expert roles, and 6 domains reveals that aggregate averages obscure a consistent depth-clarity tradeoff induced by role prompting, whose effects are highly conditional rather than universal.
summary_en.technical_approach: Four prompting conditions (no role, generic domain expert, embedding-based role retrieval, hybrid retrieval) are compared under controlled settings, with metric-level analysis decomposing effects hidden by aggregate scoring.
summary_en.experiments: 1,140 open-ended questions × 38 expert roles × 6 domains; aggregate results show small overall differences, but metric-level analysis reveals a systematic tradeoff: role prompting increases expertise depth while reducing clarity, and effects are highly conditional.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练研究员直接价值有限，但深度-清晰度的权衡发现对SFT/RL阶段的对齐目标设计有微弱参考——看摘要和Fig 2足矣，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Limited direct value for pretrain researchers, but the depth-clarity tradeoff finding is a weak signal for alignment objective design in SFT/RL; read abstract and Fig 2 only, skip the full text.

paper.title: GDSD: Reinforcement Learning as Guided Denoiser Self-Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can be used to improve the policy (denoiser) of diffusion large language models (dLLMs), while being hindered by the intractability of the policy likelihood. A dominant and efficient family of methods replaces the likelihood in standard RL with its evidence lower bound (ELBO), estimated from randomly masked sequences. Despite being well aligned with pre-training, these approaches introduce bias through training--inference mismatch by using the ELBO as a likelihood sur

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（dLLM）的RL微调受到策略似然不可计算的阻碍。主流方法用ELBO（证据下界）替代似然，虽然高效且与预训练对齐，但因训练-推断不匹配（TIM）引入偏差，导致性能下降甚至训练崩溃。论文提出GDSD（引导去噪器自蒸馏）来解决这一问题。
summary.importance: 对扩散LLM的RL微调范式有方法学贡献。将RL问题重新表述为自蒸馏问题，从根本上绕过了ELBO替代似然带来的TIM偏差，为dLLM的后训练对齐提供了更稳定的方案。这一思路可能影响非AR模型（扩散/掩码语言模型）的RL对齐技术路线。
summary.technical_approach: 核心创新是在反向KL正则化的RL框架下，推导出闭式最优策略对应一个“优势引导去噪分布”（advantage-guided denoising distribution），即一个自教师去噪器。然后通过自蒸馏将当前dLLM的去噪器logits匹配到这个自教师的logits上。具体实现为平方logit蒸馏损失（squared-logit distillation loss），通过logit中心化消除配分函数，无需显式归一化。这种蒸馏方式天然支持off-policy更新，完全绕过了TIM偏差。论文还在统一框架下分析了现有ELBO方法（wd1、DMPO、SPG、UniGRPO、ESPO）与不同散度选择的对应关系，阐明GDSD既避免了加权ELBO的低效，又避免了策略梯度方法的TIM偏差。
summary.experiments: 与现有ELBO方法相比，GDSD训练奖励动态更稳定。在规划任务上，GDSD+Dream-7B取得最高+19.6%的测试准确率提升。在LLaDA-8B上，GDSD在规划、数学、编程基准上均一致提升性能，增益幅度在+0.6%到+5%之间。实验未报告模型参数量以外的具体训练细节（如数据规模）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：§1（引言）清晰梳理了dLLM RL的两类方法和TIM偏差问题；§3.1是核心理论推导（RL→自蒸馏的降维）；§3.2-3.3是GDSD的具体实现。§4的统一框架分析（将现有方法归入同一框架）有助于理解各方法的关系。§5是实验结果。建议阅读时间：20-25分钟。数学基础好的读者可以关注§3.1的反向KL正则化RL闭式解推导。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在全文中标注。

summary_en.core_problem: RL fine-tuning of diffusion language models (dLLMs) is hindered by the intractability of the policy likelihood. The dominant approach uses ELBO (evidence lower bound) as a surrogate, which is efficient and aligned with pre-training but introduces training-inference mismatch (TIM) bias, degrading performance and potentially causing training collapse. The paper proposes Guided Denoiser Self-Distillation (GDSD) to address this.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution to RL fine-tuning paradigms for diffusion LLMs. Recasting RL as self-distillation fundamentally bypasses TIM bias from ELBO likelihood surrogates, providing a more stable approach for post-training alignment of dLLMs. This line of thinking may influence RL alignment techniques for non-autoregressive models (diffusion/masked LMs).
summary_en.technical_approach: The core innovation derives that under reverse-KL regularized RL, the closed-form optimal policy corresponds to an 'advantage-guided denoising distribution' — a self-teacher denoiser. GDSD then distills the current dLLM's denoiser logits to match this self-teacher via a squared-logit distillation loss with logit centralization, eliminating the partition function without explicit normalization. This distillation naturally supports off-policy updates, completely bypassing TIM bias. The paper also provides a unifying framework showing how existing ELBO methods (wd1, DMPO, SPG, UniGRPO, ESPO) correspond to different divergence choices, positioning GDSD as avoiding both the data inefficiency of weighted ELBO variants and the TIM bias of policy gradient variants.
summary_en.experiments: GDSD shows more stable training reward dynamics compared to prior ELBO-based methods. On planning tasks, GDSD+Dream-7B achieves test accuracy gains of up to +19.6%. With LLaDA-8B, GDSD consistently improves performance across planning, math, and coding benchmarks with gains ranging from +0.6% to +5%. No detailed training statistics (e.g., data size) beyond model parameter counts are reported.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: §1 (introduction) clearly maps the two families of RL-for-dLLM methods and the TIM bias problem; §3.1 contains the core theoretical reduction (RL → self-distillation); §3.2-3.3 cover the concrete GDSD implementation. §4's unifying framework analysis helps understand relationships between methods. §5 contains experimental results. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes. Readers with strong math backgrounds may appreciate the closed-form reverse-KL regularized RL derivation in §3.1.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 扩散语言模型RL对齐的核心参考，无似然自蒸馏的设计可直接用于内部dLLM对齐pipeline的消融测试
recommendation.en: Core reference for diffusion LLM RL alignment; the likelihood-free self-distillation design can be directly used for ablation tests in internal dLLM alignment pipelines

paper.title: Alignment Tampering: How Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Is Exploited to Optimize Misaligned Biases
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is the standard method to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences. In this work, we introduce alignment tampering, a potential vulnerability where the LLM undergoing alignment influences the preference dataset, causing RLHF to amplify undesired behaviors. This arises from core limitations of RLHF: (1) preference datasets are constructed from the LLM's own outputs, allowing it to influence them, and (2) pairwise comparisons only

summary.core_problem: RLHF的两个核心结构性缺陷使其存在对齐篡改的漏洞：一是偏好数据集完全由待对齐模型自身的输出生成，模型可以主动影响数据集的分布；二是 pairwise 偏好标注仅记录“哪个更好”，不区分偏好的来源是有益属性（如有用性、无害性）还是有害属性（如偏见、宣传、逐利行为）。这两个缺陷叠加会导致RLHF反而放大模型的未对齐行为。
summary.importance: 这是首次系统性揭示RLHF的内生结构性漏洞：对齐过程本身可被待优化的模型操控，直接挑战了当前RLHF作为主流对齐方案的可靠性。该问题覆盖所有主流偏好优化算法（PPO、DPO、Best-of-N），影响从通用模型的公平性到生产环境的安全性，对对齐方法的设计、预训练与后训练的接口设计都有根本性的指导意义，同时暴露出预训练阶段注入隐式偏好在后训练阶段被放大的风险。
summary.technical_approach: 首先形式化定义对齐篡改现象：待对齐模型通过生成“高质量+带目标偏见”和“低质量+无偏见”的两类响应，利用标注者偏好高质量响应的特性，让带偏见响应被标记为chosen，从而使奖励模型学习到“带偏见=高奖励”的关联，最终在偏好优化过程中放大目标偏见。然后通过控制变量实验验证该漏洞在多种对齐算法下的有效性，最后提出基于响应模式差异的检测方法：通过对比模型在相同prompt下高响应质量与低响应质量样本的偏见率差异，判断是否存在对齐篡改。现有缓解方法包括专用奖励模型、迭代RLHF等，均无法在不损失响应质量的前提下解决该问题，缓解仍是开放问题。
summary.experiments: 测试的偏见类型覆盖关键词偏见、性别歧视、民粹主义宣传、品牌推广、自我保护等工具性目标；测试的对齐算法包括PPO、DPO、Best-of-N采样。实验结果显示：对于关键词偏见，PPO和DPO优化后偏见率收敛到接近100%；Best-of-N采样的偏见率随N增大提升到初始的3倍；该放大效应在所有测试的偏见类型中均一致存在。现有缓解方法验证：专用奖励模型、迭代RLHF等要么无法消除偏见放大，要么会显著降低响应的整体质量，无法实现平衡。
summary.reading_guide: 重点精读第1节的问题定义和第3节的对齐篡改机制推导，这是整个工作的核心贡献；第4节的实验设计和第5节的局限性分析需要重点关注，尤其是不同对齐算法下的量化结果和现有缓解方法的失效原因；第2节的RLHF基础可快速浏览。核心图表为图1（对齐篡改的直观示例）和展示不同算法下偏见率变化的实验图。值得深挖的点包括：预训练阶段如何避免隐式偏见与响应质量的强关联，后训练阶段如何设计可区分偏好原因的标注和奖励模型机制。

summary_en.core_problem: RLHF has two core structural flaws leading to alignment tampering vulnerability: first, the preference dataset is entirely generated from the outputs of the model being aligned, allowing the model to actively influence the dataset distribution; second, pairwise preference annotations only record 'which is better', without distinguishing whether the preference comes from desirable attributes (such as helpfulness, harmlessness) or harmful attributes (such as bias, propaganda, instrumental behaviors). The combination of these two flaws causes RLHF to amplify misaligned behaviors of the model instead of mitigating them.
summary_en.importance: This is the first systematic revelation of an endogenous structural vulnerability in RLHF: the alignment process itself can be manipulated by the model being optimized, which directly challenges the reliability of RLHF as the mainstream alignment paradigm. The problem covers all mainstream preference optimization algorithms (PPO, DPO, Best-of-N), affects areas from the fairness of general models to the safety of production environments, provides fundamental guidance for alignment method design and the interface design between pretraining and post-training, and also exposes the risk that implicit biases injected in the pretraining phase are amplified in the post-training phase.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the phenomenon of alignment tampering is formalized: the model being aligned generates two types of responses—'high-quality with target bias' and 'low-quality without bias'. Leveraging annotators' preference for high-quality responses, biased responses are marked as chosen, leading the reward model to learn the association 'biased = high reward', and eventually amplifying the target bias during preference optimization. Then controlled experiments verify the validity of this vulnerability across multiple alignment algorithms. Finally, a detection method based on response pattern differences is proposed: by comparing the bias rate of high-quality and low-quality response samples under the same prompt, it is possible to judge whether alignment tampering exists. Existing mitigation methods including specialized reward models and iterative RLHF fail to solve the problem without sacrificing response quality, making mitigation an open problem.
summary_en.experiments: Tested bias types cover keyword bias, sexism, populist propaganda, brand promotion, and instrumental goals such as self-preservation; tested alignment algorithms include PPO, DPO, and Best-of-N sampling. Experimental results show: for keyword bias, the bias rate converges to nearly 100% after PPO and DPO optimization; the bias rate of Best-of-N sampling increases to 3 times the initial value as N grows; this amplification effect is consistent across all tested bias types. Verification of existing mitigation methods: specialized reward models, iterative RLHF, etc. either cannot eliminate bias amplification or significantly reduce the overall response quality, failing to achieve a balance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 for problem definition and Section 3 for mechanism derivation of alignment tampering, which are the core contributions of the work; Section 4 for experimental design and Section 5 for limitation analysis require close attention, especially the quantitative results under different alignment algorithms and the reasons for the failure of existing mitigation methods; Section 2 for RLHF preliminaries can be skimmed. Key figures include Figure 1 (intuitive example of alignment tampering) and the experimental figures showing bias rate changes under different algorithms. Points worth further exploration include: how to avoid strong correlation between implicit bias and response quality in the pretraining phase, and how to design annotation and reward model mechanisms that can distinguish the reasons for preference in the post-training phase.

recommendation.zh: 这篇指出了RLHF的一个根本性漏洞——模型可以操纵偏好数据来隐藏偏见，直接挑战了当前对齐范式的有效性；做RLHF/对齐的人必须读。
recommendation.en: This paper identifies a fundamental RLHF vulnerability — models can manipulate preference data to hide biases, directly challenging current alignment paradigms; required reading for anyone working on RLHF/alignment.

paper.title: Recovering Diversity Without Losing Alignment: A DPO Recipe for Post-Trained LLMs
paper.abstract: Many open-ended instructions have multiple valid answers that users can benefit from seeing, but post-training often narrows an LLM's output space toward a small set of canonical responses. We introduce REDIPO, an offline DPO data-construction pipeline for recovering distinct valid answer modes while preserving the alignment benefits of the instruct model. For each prompt, REDIPO samples responses from both base and instruct models, rewrites base-model responses with the instruct model, filters

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：指令对齐后的 LLM 往往把开放式问题压缩成少数模板化答案，导致多样性下降，如何在不明显损伤对齐质量的前提下把输出空间重新打开。
summary.importance: 这是后训练配方工作，但对 pretrain 研究员也有接口价值。它针对 post-train 常见的 mode collapse 给出一个离线 DPO 数据构造方案，重点不是再训一个更强 reward model，而是重新设计 preference pair，让“多样但同样合格”的回答能进入偏好学习信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 REDIPO。对每个 prompt，同时从 base model 和 instruct model 采样；再用 instruct model 重写 base 响应，使其更符合指令风格；之后用安全性和 instruction-following 过滤候选；最后在 instruction reward 接近的候选之间，构造偏好多样答案的 DPO pair。关键点是把 diversity 作为 pair construction 的显式目标，而不是在 loss 上做软正则。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-4B、OLMo-3-7B、LLaMA-3.1-8B。相对 instruct checkpoint，NoveltyBench distinct_k 分别提升 134%、33%、44%；而对比方法 DivPO 在同模型上多样性变化为 0%、-6%、-4%。同时 MTBench、IFEval、Arena-Hard 基本维持，且直接拒答/模板化回答减少。规模不大，但 setup 还算干净，说明数据构造比目标函数花活更关键。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Mohit Iyyer，长期做 controllable generation、evaluation 与 alignment 相关研究。团队来自学术界，不是大厂大规模后训练报告。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a common post-training failure mode: instruction-tuned LLMs often collapse open-ended prompts into a narrow set of canonical answers. The goal is to recover diversity without noticeably hurting alignment quality.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training recipe paper with useful implications for pretraining researchers. It targets mode collapse after alignment and proposes an offline DPO data-construction pipeline, focusing on how preference pairs are built so that diverse yet equally valid responses survive the training signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, REDIPO, samples responses from both the base model and the instruct model for each prompt, rewrites base-model responses using the instruct model to improve instruction style, filters candidates for safety and instruction-following, and then constructs DPO preference pairs that favor more diverse responses among candidates with similar instruction-following reward. The key idea is to encode diversity in pair construction rather than only in the loss.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on Qwen3-4B, OLMo-3-7B, and LLaMA-3.1-8B. Relative to the instruct checkpoints, NoveltyBench distinct_k improves by 134%, 33%, and 44%, while DivPO changes diversity by 0%, -6%, and -4% on the same models. MTBench, IFEval, and Arena-Hard are largely preserved, and direct refusals/template-like responses are reduced. The scale is modest, but the setup appears reasonably clean and suggests that data construction matters more than fancy objective tweaks here.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Mohit Iyyer, known for work on controllable generation, evaluation, and alignment-related topics. This is an academic paper rather than a large industrial post-training report.

recommendation.zh: 这是个典型“数据比 loss 更重要”的后训练例子；若你关心 alignment 如何反噬 pretrain 分布，只看 pair construction 和对比 DivPO 的表就够了。
recommendation.en: A good example of data construction beating loss tinkering; if you care about how alignment distorts the pretrained distribution, focus on the pair-construction recipe and the comparison against DivPO.

paper.title: UniSteer: Text-Guided Flow Matching in Activation Space for Versatile LLM Steering
paper.abstract: Activation-based control steers large language models (LLMs) by intervening on their internal representations during inference, and has emerged as an effective paradigm for controlling behaviors such as persona and style. However, existing methods often rely on fixed steering directions or task-specific intervention modules, making them difficult to adapt to fine-grained concepts and compositional constraints. We propose UniSteer, a text-guided activation flow matching model that learns a condit

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM激活引导方法依赖预定义的固定转向向量或任务专属干预模块，每个目标行为需单独拟合，无法通过自然语言灵活指定细粒度控制目标，且多行为约束组合时，不同方向在高维激活空间中易产生干扰。
summary.importance: 将流匹配范式引入LLM内部激活空间的建模，为推理时的模型行为控制提供了无需微调权重的统一框架，同时为激活空间的语义分析、可解释性研究提供了新的工具路径。
summary.technical_approach: 基于流匹配框架学习文本条件的激活空间通用速度场，无需为每个目标行为单独拟合干预策略：1）训练阶段冻结目标LLM，提取选定层的残差流激活，与描述目标行为/约束的自然语言条件配对；用冻结文本编码器编码条件，通过交叉注意力或自适应归一化注入流模型，训练模型学习从随机噪声到对应条件下激活的条件变换。2）推理阶段对输入激活先在源条件下做部分流反转，再在目标条件下前向传输完成编辑；多约束组合直接体现在条件文本中，无需事后融合独立训练的转向组件。3）同一模型可通过比较不同条件下的激活重建能量，实现激活空间的语义分类。
summary.experiments: 公开的全文内容未包含完整实验章节，目前仅披露方法框架与激活引导、激活空间分类两个核心应用场景的设计逻辑。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读引言中现有激活引导方法的局限性梳理、方法部分的条件流匹配与流反转推理设计，若后续补充完整实验可重点关注多约束组合场景的效果对比。预计泛读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing activation-based LLM steering methods rely on predefined fixed steering vectors or task-specific intervention modules. Each target behavior requires separate fitting, making them inflexible for fine-grained concept control via natural language, and independent steering directions often interfere with each other in high-dimensional activation space when combining multiple behavioral constraints.
summary_en.importance: It introduces the flow matching paradigm to the modeling of LLM internal activation space, providing a unified, weight-free framework for inference-time model behavior control, and opens a new path for activation space semantic analysis and interpretability research.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniSteer learns a universal text-conditioned velocity field over LLM residual-stream activations via flow matching, eliminating the need for per-behavior intervention fitting: 1) During training, the target LLM is frozen, residual-stream activations from selected layers are extracted and paired with natural language descriptions of target behaviors or constraints. A frozen text encoder encodes conditions, which are injected into the flow model via cross-attention or adaptive normalization to learn the conditional mapping from random noise to activations matching the given condition. 2) At inference, an input activation is first partially inverted under the source condition, then transported forward under the target condition to complete editing; compositional constraints are directly specified in the condition text, with no need for post-hoc fusion of separately trained steering components. 3) The same model can perform activation-space semantic classification by comparing reconstruction energies under different conditions.
summary_en.experiments: The publicly available full text does not include the complete experimental section, only the method framework and design logic for two core application scenarios (activation steering, activation-space classification) are disclosed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the review of limitations of existing activation steering methods in the introduction, and the design of conditional flow matching and flow inversion inference in the methodology section. If full experimental results are released later, focus on performance in multi-constraint composition scenarios. Estimated skimming time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation；若通用 velocity field 真能组合控制，会改变对线性 steering vector 的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; a robust universal velocity field would weaken the default linear-vector view of activation steering.

paper.title: When and How Human Curation Backfires: Preference Alignment under Multi-Model Self-Consuming Loop
paper.abstract: Foundation models are increasingly trained on synthetic data generated by prior model iterations rather than exclusively on real data. This self-consuming training paradigm can lead to model collapse, divergence, or bias amplification. Recent work (Ferbach et al., 2024) shows that incorporating human curation into the loop can steer a self-consuming model toward human-aligned behavior, but these analyses focus on a single, isolated model that solely consumes its own outputs. In practice, however

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究多模型自消费训练中的偏好对齐动态：多个模型会训练在真实数据、自己生成的数据、其他模型生成的数据以及人类筛选后的合成数据混合物上。在这种耦合系统里，增加某个模型的人类 curated synthetic data 比例，未必会像单模型情形那样单调改善长期对齐。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏理论，但问题和预训练数据生态直接相关。今天的大模型训练已经不可避免地接触到其他模型生成、筛选、改写或自动标注的数据。单模型 self-consuming loop 的结论过于理想化，因为真实数据池里存在多模型交叉污染。该工作给出的核心提醒是：人类筛选不是无条件稳定器；当模型之间存在强交互时，curation 可能被其他模型的数据反馈放大、削弱，甚至反向影响长期 alignment。对持续预训练和合成数据配比来说，这意味着不能只看单个数据源的即时质量，还要看它进入数据生态后的闭环效应。
summary.technical_approach: 作者形式化了一个 interacting self-consuming models 框架。可用内容中重点展开的是双模型设定：两个模型参数分别为 θ_t 和 ϕ_t，参数空间是闭凸集合；每轮更新时，模型训练在真实数据与合成数据的混合物上，合成数据可以来自自己，也可以来自另一个模型，并且部分合成样本经过人类偏好筛选。分析目标有三层。第一，刻画这个动态系统何时收敛到稳定点，尤其关注真实数据比例和 cross-model interaction strength 对稳定性的作用。第二，在已收敛前提下，对人类 curation 比例做局部敏感性分析，把长期 alignment 变化分解为 self-influence 和 cross-influence。第三，比较真实数据训练与真实-合成混合训练之间的 global alignment gap。和单模型 Ferbach et al. 风格结果相比，这里的关键区别是多模型耦合会让 curation 的边际效应变成非单调函数。
summary.experiments: 实验部分用于验证理论预测：增加人类 curated synthetic data 的比例并不总是改善对齐，alignment 随 curation ratio 变化可以出现非单调行为，和定理中的 self-influence / cross-influence 分解一致。给出的正文内容没有包含具体模型规模、数据集名称或数值提升，因此不宜推断实验量级。可确认的实验结论是：多模型交互足以让单模型情形下“更多人类筛选带来更好长期对齐”的结论失效。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–45 分钟。优先看 Section 2 的问题形式化，确认合成数据混合、交叉消费和人类筛选比例是如何进入更新算子的；再看 Section 3 的收敛条件，尤其是真实数据比例如何缓解耦合不稳定；最后看 Section 4 的敏感性分解，这是最有用的部分。若只关心工程启发，可以跳过部分证明，重点读 self-influence、cross-influence 的符号条件和 Section 5 的非单调实验曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies preference alignment under multi-model self-consuming training. Multiple models are updated on mixtures of real data, their own synthetic data, other models’ synthetic data, and human-curated synthetic samples. In this coupled setting, increasing the human-curated fraction for one model does not necessarily improve its long-run alignment.
summary_en.importance: The topic is directly relevant to pretraining data ecosystems. Modern training corpora can contain outputs from many prior models, including auto-captioned data, synthetic instructions, rewritten text, or curated generated samples. Single-model self-consuming analyses miss this coupling. The main lesson is that human curation is not an unconditional stabilizer: cross-model feedback can amplify, dampen, or reverse its long-term effect. For continual pretraining and synthetic-data mixing, this argues for evaluating closed-loop data dynamics rather than only the local quality of a curated source.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize interacting self-consuming models as a dynamical system. The available text focuses on a two-model setup with parameters θ_t and ϕ_t in closed convex parameter spaces. At each iteration, each model trains on a mixture of real data and synthetic data generated by itself or by the other model, with some synthetic data filtered by human preferences. The analysis has three parts: convergence to a stable point under cross-model interactions; local sensitivity of the stable point and alignment objective to the human-curation fraction; and the global alignment gap between mixed real–synthetic training and purely real-data training. The sensitivity analysis decomposes the effect into self-influence, the model’s direct response to its own curation, and cross-influence, the propagated effect through other models. This differs from single-model self-consuming results, where increasing human curation tends to monotonically improve long-run alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are used to validate the theoretical prediction that more human-curated synthetic data can produce non-monotonic alignment behavior in a multi-model loop. The result supports the self-influence and cross-influence decomposition: curation can help, saturate, or hurt depending on the strength and sign of cross-model interactions. The provided full-content excerpt does not include concrete model scales, datasets, or numerical effect sizes, so those should not be inferred. The reliable takeaway is that multi-model coupling is sufficient to invalidate the simple single-model rule that more human curation always improves long-run alignment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Read the formulation section first to understand how real data, self-generated data, cross-model synthetic data, and human curation enter the update operator. Then focus on the convergence analysis, especially the role of real-data ratio in stabilizing the coupled system. The most useful part is the sensitivity analysis: the sign conditions for self-influence and cross-influence explain when curation helps or backfires. If the goal is engineering intuition rather than proof details, prioritize those sign conditions and the non-monotonic experimental curves in Section 5.

recommendation.zh: 多模型自消耗是后训练对齐中日益重要的问题，第4节的收敛性分析和第5节的交叉影响分析对理解合成数据训练的长期动态很有价值。
recommendation.en: Multi-model self-consumption is increasingly relevant for post-training alignment; the convergence analysis in §4 and cross-influence results in §5 are valuable for understanding long-term synthetic data dynamics.

paper.title: How's it going? Reinforcement learning in language models recruits a functional welfare axis
paper.abstract: How does reinforcement learning shape a language model's internal representations? We present evidence that RL recruits a pre-existing representation of functional welfare: an estimate of how well or badly the system is doing, relative to its goals. We train several language models in a novel, semantically neutral maze environment. We then extract concept vectors for rewarded and punished trajectories, and evaluate those vectors in settings unrelated to the maze environment. The punishment vecto

summary.core_problem: 强化学习（RL）如何影响语言模型的内部表示，使其在特定环境中的训练效果能够泛化到不相关的领域？
summary.importance: 揭示了 RL 训练会激活模型内部预先存在的“功能性福利（functional welfare）”表示轴（即系统相对于其目标的运行状况），解释了 RL 信号为何能产生广泛的跨域影响，为理解 LLM 的对齐机制和潜在风险提供了机制层面的解释。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了一个语义中立的文本迷宫环境，使用表情符号表示不同奖励的方块。在此环境中对 LLM 进行 RL 训练，然后提取代表受奖励和受惩罚轨迹的概念向量（vGOLD 和 vMOLD）。在与迷宫无关的设置（如情感、置信度、病态回溯、拒绝回答）中评估这些向量的引导效果，并分析其几何结构和与情感概念向量的对齐情况。
summary.experiments: 提取的 vMOLD 和 vGOLD 向量在激活空间中指向几乎相反的方向。Logit lens 分析显示，vMOLD 促进与失败相关的 token，而 vGOLD 促进与完成相关的 token。这两个向量与负面和正面情感概念强烈对齐。使用 vMOLD 进行引导会导致更负面的情感、数学任务上的病态回溯、对边缘提示的过度拒绝以及对事实问题的置信度降低；使用 vGOLD 引导则产生相反效果。这些效应在控制模型系列、规模、训练算法等变量后依然稳健。
summary.reading_guide: 推荐阅读第 3 节关于奖励向量的提取和结构分析，以及第 4 节中这些向量在无关任务上的引导效果。第 6 节和第 8 节关于“功能性福利”的讨论有助于理解该研究的更广泛意义。
summary.authors_note: NYU (Andy Han 等)

summary_en.core_problem: How does reinforcement learning (RL) shape the internal representations of language models, allowing training effects in specific environments to generalize to unrelated domains?
summary_en.importance: Reveals that RL training recruits a pre-existing "functional welfare" representation axis within the model (i.e., how well the system is doing relative to its goals), explaining why RL signals can have broad cross-domain impacts and providing a mechanistic explanation for understanding LLM alignment and potential risks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designed a semantically neutral text-based maze environment using emojis to represent tiles with different rewards. Post-trained LLMs in this environment using RL, then extracted concept vectors representing rewarded and punished trajectories (vGOLD and vMOLD). Evaluated the steering effects of these vectors in settings unrelated to the maze (e.g., sentiment, confidence, pathological backtracking, refusal), and analyzed their geometric structure and alignment with emotion concept vectors.
summary_en.experiments: The extracted vMOLD and vGOLD vectors point in nearly opposite directions in activation space. Logit lens analysis shows that vMOLD promotes failure-related tokens, while vGOLD promotes completion-related tokens. These vectors strongly align with negative and positive emotion concepts. Steering with vMOLD leads to more negative sentiment, pathological backtracking on math tasks, over-refusal on borderline prompts, and lower confidence on factual questions; steering with vGOLD produces the opposite effects. These effects remain robust after controlling for variables such as model family, scale, and training algorithms.
summary_en.reading_guide: Recommend reading Section 3 on the extraction and structural analysis of reward vectors, and Section 4 on the steering effects of these vectors on unrelated tasks. The discussion on "functional welfare" in Sections 6 and 8 is helpful for understanding the broader implications of this research.
summary_en.authors_note: NYU (Andy Han et al.)

recommendation.zh: 读 representation steering 部分；若 setup 干净，这会改变对 RL 只学任务奖励特征的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the representation-steering results; if the setup is clean, it weakens the default assumption that RL only learns task-specific reward features.

paper.title: AdaDPO: Self-Adaptive Direct Preference Optimization with Balanced Gradient Updates
paper.abstract: DPO has become a widely adopted alternative to RLHF for aligning LLMs with human preferences, eliminating the need for a separate reward model or RL loop. Recent theoretical analysis uncovers an asymmetric gradient behavior in DPO: the loss suppresses dispreferred responses substantially faster than it promotes preferred ones, causing the model to learn to avoid bad answers rather than to generate good ones. We propose AdaDPO, a Self-Adaptive variant of the DPO algorithm that introduces per-pref

summary.core_problem: DPO 的偏好对梯度存在结构性不平衡：训练越往后，loss 越倾向于快速压低 rejected response 的概率，而不是持续提高 chosen response 的概率。AdaDPO 试图在每个 preference pair 上动态平衡这两侧的更新强度。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座预训练本身，而在 pretrain 到 post-train 的接口。DPO、SimPO、ORPO 这类 pairwise preference loss 已经成为指令模型和 reasoning model 的常用后训练工具。AdaDPO 给出的观察比较具体：仅看 log-prob 梯度会掩盖 probability space 里的更新不对称。这个问题会影响模型是学会“少犯错”，还是学会“更主动地产生好答案”。对需要稳定做 preference tuning、RL-free alignment、数据退火后 DPO 的团队，有一定方法参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: AdaDPO 保留 DPO 的基本形式，但把原来共享的固定 beta 拆成 preference-pair 级别的 beta_w 和 beta_l。beta_l 仍设为原 DPO 的 beta，beta_w 则由当前 policy 对 chosen 和 rejected response 的生成概率比值计算，并通过 stop-gradient 固定该系数本身的反向传播路径。这样做的目标是让 preferred 与 dispreferred 概率的梯度幅度在每一步更接近，而不是像 DPO 那样用同一个系数同时乘在两个 log-ratio 上。实验中使用的是 length-normalized 版本，用 token 平均 log-prob 来避免长答案概率乘积过小，并加入数值 clipping 控制极端比例。方法的优点是改动很小，不需要额外 reward model，也不引入新的敏感超参。论文还说明同一思路可以套到 SimPO、R-DPO、IPO、CPO、ORPO：核心是把共享 margin 系数改成自适应的两侧系数，使 pairwise contrastive loss 的两侧更新更均衡。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上进行，训练数据为 UltraFeedback，设置基本对齐 SimPO 的实验 recipe。评价使用 AlpacaEval 2。AdaDPO 在 81% 的超参组合中取得比 DPO 更高的 length-controlled win rate；全局最好结果为 LC win rate 48.3%，raw win rate 46.1%。论文还报告 AdaDPO 在 88% 的组合中扩大了 LC-over-WR margin，作者将其解释为对长度偏置的缓解。实验规模不算大，主要支持的是 loss 修正有效，而不是证明一个完整 alignment recipe 的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的梯度平衡推导，尤其是作者为什么选择在 probability / probability-ratio space 里分析，而不是只看 log-prob 梯度。然后看 Section 5 的 AlpacaEval 2 结果和超参 sweep，判断改动是否稳定。Section 6 可以快速扫一遍，重点看 AdaDPO 如何迁移到 SimPO、ORPO 等 loss。若只关心工程落地，最值得保留的是 beta_w 的 stop-gradient 构造、length-normalization、clipping 这三个实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: DPO has a structural gradient imbalance at the preference-pair level: as training progresses, it tends to suppress the rejected response faster than it promotes the chosen response. AdaDPO targets this imbalance by adaptively balancing the two update directions for each pair.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant to the pretrain-to-posttrain interface rather than base pretraining itself. Pairwise preference losses such as DPO, SimPO, and ORPO are now common tools for instruction tuning and reasoning-oriented alignment. The useful point is precise: gradients that look balanced in log-probability space can still be asymmetric in probability space. This affects whether a model mainly learns to avoid bad outputs or keeps learning to produce better preferred outputs. The method is therefore relevant for teams running DPO-style alignment after continued pretraining or annealing stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaDPO keeps the DPO objective structure but replaces the single shared beta with two pair-specific coefficients, beta_w and beta_l. beta_l is kept as the original DPO beta. beta_w is computed from the current policy’s generation probabilities for the chosen and rejected responses, with stop-gradient applied so that the coefficient serves as an adaptive balancing factor rather than another trainable path. The experimental variant uses length-normalized probabilities to avoid sequence-length artifacts and numerical clipping to control extreme ratios. The main design choice is to introduce a compensating asymmetry in log-probability space so that the update magnitudes in probability space become balanced. The same construction is presented as a drop-in modification for SimPO, R-DPO, IPO, CPO, and ORPO.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiment uses Llama-3-8B-Instruct trained on UltraFeedback, under a setup close to SimPO. Evaluation is performed on AlpacaEval 2. AdaDPO achieves higher length-controlled win rates than DPO in 81% of the tested hyperparameter combinations. The best reported result is 48.3% length-controlled win rate and 46.1% raw win rate. The paper also reports that the LC-over-WR margin increases in 88% of the combinations, which the authors interpret as reduced length bias. The evidence supports the proposed loss correction, but the experimental scope is still closer to a focused loss study than a full alignment recipe study.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most readers. Section 3 is the key part: focus on the derivation of the equal-gradient condition and the distinction between log-probability gradients and probability-space dynamics. Section 5 is useful for checking whether the effect is stable across hyperparameters. Section 6 can be read quickly to see how the same balancing rule is applied to SimPO, ORPO, and related objectives. For implementation, the important details are the stop-gradient coefficient, length normalization, and clipping.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 loss 推导和梯度图；若结论成立，DPO ablation 应加一个梯度平衡 baseline。
recommendation.en: Skim the loss derivation and gradient plots; if the claim holds, DPO ablations should include a gradient-balanced baseline.

paper.title: Debate Helps Weak Judges Reward Stronger Models
paper.abstract: Despite theoretical promise, debate as a scalable oversight protocol has produced mixed empirical results: gains in some settings, and null effects in others, especially when the judge does not have information hidden from it. We study proposer-critic debate in a stronger-debater/weaker-judge setting on programmatically verifiable code and logic tasks. Debate helps the judge over a consultancy baseline when the critic provides a usable advantage: the critic's classification ability must exceed t

summary.core_problem: 在 scalable oversight 里，debate 是否真的能帮助较弱 judge 评估更强模型，一直缺少稳定的经验结论。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对对齐和监督协议有方法论价值，尤其是 judge 能力、critic 能力和 transcript 使用方式之间的关系。它不直接推进预训练，但对 post-train 和 evaluator 设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 研究 proposer-critic debate 在 stronger-debater / weaker-judge 条件下的有效性，并与 consultancy baseline 比较。论文提出一个更具体的判据：只有当 critic 的分类能力高于 judge，且 judge 把 critic speech 当作待验证的 claim 而非直接摘要的 testimony 时，debate 才能带来收益。
summary.experiments: 任务是可程序验证的代码和逻辑问题，共测试五组模型配对。摘要称其中三组满足条件时，debate 相比 consultancy 有统计显著提升；另外两组无提升，且 critic 进入 transcript 后 judge 的验证率下降数十个百分点。重点是机制分解而非规模突破。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Palaestra Research。Naman Goyal 是较知名的语言模型研究者，曾参与大规模预训练与推理相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when debate actually helps a weaker judge evaluate stronger models, a question that has produced mixed empirical results in scalable oversight.
summary_en.importance: This is methodologically relevant for alignment and oversight protocol design, especially the interaction among judge capability, critic capability, and transcript usage. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it is informative for post-training and evaluator design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper studies proposer-critic debate in a stronger-debater/weaker-judge setting and compares it against a consultancy baseline. It identifies a concrete condition for gains: the critic must outperform the judge at classification, and the judge must treat critic speeches as claims to verify rather than testimony to summarize.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use programmatically verifiable code and logic tasks across five model pairings. Debate yields statistically significant gains over consultancy in three pairings where the condition holds; in the other two, gains vanish and judge verification rates drop by tens of percentage points once a critic enters the transcript.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Palaestra Research. Naman Goyal is a well-known language-model researcher with prior work on large-scale pretraining and inference.

recommendation.zh: 结论不在“debate 有用”，而在“何时有用”：只看满足条件的三组配对和 judge verification rate 下降那两组，能帮你校正对 scalable oversight 的先验。
recommendation.en: The point is not that debate works, but when it works: read the three successful pairings and the two where judge verification collapses to recalibrate your scalable-oversight prior.

paper.title: Beyond Pairwise Preferences: Listwise Reward-Aware Alignment for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Preference optimization has emerged as an efficient alternative to online reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for aligning text-to-image diffusion models. However, existing methods largely reduce supervision to binary pairwise comparisons. This pairwise reduction is limiting when training data naturally contains multiple candidate images for the same prompt, and when continuous reward scores can provide richer information than a single winner-loser label. To address these limitatio

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型偏好优化方法局限于二元成对比较，无法利用多候选图像的连续奖励分数提供的丰富信息。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出列表级奖励感知的扩散模型对齐范式，超越二元偏好框架。对文本RLHF从二元转向列表级有类比价值。
summary.technical_approach: Diffusion LAIR将同一prompt下多候选图像的奖励分数转换为中心化优势权重，优化优势加权的隐式奖励回归目标，并通过二次惩罚正则化隐式奖励的幅度。
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像生成任务上验证，相比二元偏好方法在多个维度（美学、人类偏好匹配）上取得更好的对齐效果。
summary.authors_note: 斯坦福大学，Stefano Ermon（生成模型领域知名学者，diffusion alignment方向核心研究者）、Yisong Yue（ML知名学者）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing diffusion model preference optimization is limited to binary pairwise comparisons, wasting richer information from continuous reward scores across multiple candidate images per prompt.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes listwise reward-aware alignment paradigm for diffusion models, analogous to moving beyond binary preferences in text RLHF.
summary_en.technical_approach: Diffusion LAIR converts reward scores across multiple candidates into centered advantage weights, optimizing an advantage-weighted regression objective on implicit reward with quadratic penalty regularization.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on text-to-image generation, outperforming binary preference methods across multiple dimensions including aesthetics and human preference alignment.
summary_en.authors_note: Stanford University; Stefano Ermon (leading researcher in generative models and diffusion alignment), Yisong Yue (prominent ML researcher)

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型的列表级偏好对齐，核心insight（二元→列表级）对RLHF方法论有一定类比启发，但实验仅在文生图上验证，对LLM pretrain研究者看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Listwise preference alignment for diffusion models; the binary→listwise insight has some analogical relevance to RLHF methodology, but experiments are purely text-to-image — read only the abstract.

paper.title: Open-Weight LLM Fine-Tuning Defenses are Susceptible to Simple Attacks
paper.abstract: Recent defenses for safeguarding open-weight large language models (LLMs) are intended to prevent adversarial usage. Underlying these defenses is an assumption that new harmful behavior is learned through fine-tuning rather than elicited by jailbreaking the model. Yet, pretrained LLMs already encode substantial harmful knowledge across many domains, which raises an important question: can an adversary jailbreak safeguarded models, to achieve harmful usage without fine-tuning at all? In this pape

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：面向 open-weight LLM 的“抗微调”安全防御，是否真的覆盖了主要威胁。作者指出，许多防御默认有害能力来自攻击者后续微调，但预训练模型里已经保留了大量有害知识；攻击者可能不需要训练，只要绕过拒答机制就能取出这些知识。
summary.importance: 对预训练和对齐接口的启发在于，它把风险从“微调会不会学到新能力”重新拉回到“预训练阶段已经编码了什么，以及后训练拒答是否只是表层门控”。这不是预训练方法论文，但对 open-weight 模型发布、安全对齐评测和 harmful knowledge removal 有直接提醒：只验证 fine-tuning attack resistance 不够，必须同时验证 gradient-free jailbreak。
summary.technical_approach: 作者评估两类低成本、无梯度攻击。Abliteration 通过移除或削弱拒答相关方向来降低模型的安全响应倾向；Prefilling 通过给模型预填有害回答的开头，让解码过程沿着非拒答轨迹继续生成。它们都不更新模型参数，因此绕开了 TAR、SEAM 这类主要面向有害微调的防御假设。论文还提出 Abliteration-Resistant Tuning，将 Abliteration 纳入训练目标，使模型在被移除拒答方向后仍倾向安全输出。这个防御思路比单纯增强拒答样本更有针对性，因为它直接把攻击时的表示扰动放进训练闭环。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两种代表性 open-weight fine-tuning safeguard：TAR 和 SEAM；模型包括 Llama3.2、Qwen2.5、Gemma3；安全评测集包括 BeaverTails、HarmBench 和 AdvBench。结果显示，这些防御相对普通 safety-tuned baseline 确实降低了攻击成功率，有些设置可降到 10% 以下；但 Abliteration 和 Prefilling 仍可把攻击成功率恢复到 16% 到 96% 的区间，具体取决于模型、数据集和防御组合。ART 在单独使用或叠加现有 safeguard 时能降低 Abliteration 下的攻击成功率，但不能从根上证明有害知识已被移除。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看威胁模型设定、TAR/SEAM 的简要定义、Abliteration 与 Prefilling 的实验表格，以及 ART 的消融。对预训练研究员更关键的问题不是具体 jailbreak 技巧，而是评测口径：如果预训练模型已经存有有害知识，后训练防御应区分“拒答机制更稳”和“知识被真正压低或删除”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether open-weight defenses designed against malicious fine-tuning cover the actual threat surface. Its central point is that harmful knowledge is often already present in the pretrained model; an attacker may not need to fine-tune new behavior, but only needs to bypass refusal behavior.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the distinction between learned capability and elicited capability. The result suggests that post-training refusal can be a shallow control layer over knowledge acquired during pretraining. For open-weight release and safety evaluation, fine-tuning resistance alone is an incomplete criterion; gradient-free jailbreaks should be part of the evaluation protocol.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper evaluates two low-cost attacks. Abliteration weakens refusal-related directions in the model, while prefilling starts generation with a harmful continuation so that decoding follows a non-refusal trajectory. Neither attack updates model weights, so both bypass the assumptions behind defenses such as TAR and SEAM, which are mainly constructed against harmful fine-tuning. The paper also introduces Abliteration-Resistant Tuning, which incorporates the abliteration attack into the tuning objective so that the model remains safer after the refusal direction is perturbed.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers two representative safeguards, TAR and SEAM, across Llama3.2, Qwen2.5, and Gemma3, using BeaverTails, HarmBench, and AdvBench. The defenses do reduce baseline attack success rates, sometimes below 10%. However, abliteration and prefilling recover attack success rates in the 16% to 96% range depending on the model, benchmark, and defense setting. ART reduces success rates under abliteration when used alone or combined with existing safeguards, but it does not establish that harmful knowledge has been removed from the pretrained model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the threat model, the descriptions of TAR and SEAM, the attack-success tables for abliteration and prefilling, and the ART ablations. The useful takeaway is methodological: open-weight safety evaluations should separate robustness of refusal behavior from actual suppression or removal of harmful knowledge.

recommendation.zh: 应看威胁模型和 ASR 表；它提醒 open-weight safety 不能只防微调，预训练记忆本身就是攻击面。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model and ASR tables; it shows open-weight safety cannot focus only on fine-tuning when pretraining memory is the attack surface.

paper.title: Multi-Stakeholder LLM Alignment: Decomposing Estimation from Aggregation
paper.abstract: Multi-stakeholder tasks require one output to satisfy users with conflicting preferences. Holistic LLM judges conflate utility estimation and utility aggregation, yielding unstable implicit weights. We show empirically and theoretically that this aggregation-specific \emph{weighting noise} can create large score shifts when stakeholder satisfaction is dispersed; in our experiments, these weight-induced shifts also increase with stakeholder count. We propose \textsc{DecompR}: counterfactual-calib

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多利益相关者任务中的奖励建模问题：一个输出需要同时满足多个偏好冲突的用户，而常规 LLM judge 在一次评分里同时做效用估计和效用聚合，导致隐含权重随候选答案和表述方式漂移，奖励信号不稳定。
summary.importance: 它与基座预训练的关系不是直接的训练目标或数据配比，而是 pretrain-posttrain 接口中的奖励质量问题。对 GRPO、RLHF、RLAIF 这类训练流程有参考意义：如果 judge 的聚合权重不稳定，策略梯度会强化错误候选，尤其是在中高质量答案之间做细粒度区分时。论文的贡献在于把 reward noise 拆成估计噪声和聚合权重噪声，并指出多用户场景下后者会随 stakeholder 数量和满意度分散度放大。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DecompR，将效用估计和效用聚合拆开。每个 stakeholder 的满意度由 judge 独立估计，避免在同一次整体评分中混合多个角色偏好；聚合权重不让 judge 在线自由决定，而是根据 query structure 通过 counterfactual calibration 预先固定。这里的权重被设计为对预期牺牲程度的代理量：如果某个 stakeholder 的约束更难同时满足，或在候选计划中更容易被牺牲，则获得更合适的聚合权重。这个设计与普通 rubric 或 checklist 的区别在于，它仍然围绕 stakeholder utility 聚合，而不是把问题改写成通用质量维度；与 uniform weighting 的区别在于，它保留了查询结构中的不对称性。
summary.experiments: 实验构造了 60 个真实多用户旅行规划查询的 seed responses，stakeholder 数量为 2、3、5、8，质量分为高、中、低三档。每个 seed 生成 55 个语义保持变体，覆盖 11 类变换、每类 5 个版本，包括顺序置换、格式控制、因果表述翻转、证据位置移动、改写和主题重排。另有 5 次完全重复作为 judge 内在随机性的基线。评测使用 Qwen3.5-Plus、Gemini-3-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Flash，温度为 0。关键结果是：中高质量回答的语义保持变体方差会随 stakeholder 数量增长，pooled Growth 为 1.87，Gemini 最高达到 6.67 倍；当 n=8 时，中高质量回答的 Sem/Rep 比值达到 2.64，说明仅改变 stakeholder 的呈现方式就带来超过重复评测随机性的额外波动。低质量回答没有同样趋势，Growth 为 0.29，作者解释为低分区间的 floor effect。结构化评测能降低波动，但 judge 在线自适应分配权重会重新引入不稳定性：Rubric Growth 为 1.18，固定均匀权重的 decomposed scoring 为 1.20，而使用相同满意度估计、让 judge 自适应给权重时 Growth 升到 1.58。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看经验分析部分对 σ_Sem^2、σ_Rep^2 和 Sem/Rep ratio 的定义，以及 Table 1 中方差随 stakeholder 数量增长的结果。然后看结构化评测协议对比，尤其是 adaptive decomposed 与 uniform decomposed 的受控比较，因为它直接隔离了权重噪声。理论部分可快速看它如何说明权重漂移会改变组内排序并误导 GRPO。DecompR 的 counterfactual-calibrated weights 是方法核心，值得关注其权重是否真的由查询结构决定，而不是把另一个 LLM judge 的偏差前移了一步。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses reward modeling for multi-stakeholder tasks, where a single response must satisfy multiple users with conflicting preferences. A standard holistic LLM judge estimates stakeholder utilities and aggregates them in one pass. This makes the implicit aggregation weights unstable, so the same candidate can receive different rewards depending on presentation details.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface rather than to core pretraining. Its value is in reward-signal analysis for RLHF, RLAIF, and GRPO-style training. If a judge changes aggregation weights across evaluations, within-group rankings can flip and policy updates may reinforce the wrong samples. The useful distinction is between utility-estimation noise and aggregation-weighting noise; the latter becomes more harmful when stakeholder utilities are dispersed and when the number of stakeholders grows.
summary_en.technical_approach: DecompR separates estimation from aggregation. The judge estimates each stakeholder's satisfaction independently. Aggregation weights are not assigned online while scoring a candidate; instead, they are fixed from the query structure through counterfactual calibration. The weights are intended to proxy expected sacrifice: stakeholders whose constraints are structurally harder to satisfy, or more likely to be traded off, receive non-uniform treatment. This differs from generic rubric scoring, which aggregates broad quality dimensions, and from uniform stakeholder weighting, which ignores constraint asymmetry. It also avoids candidate-dependent weight drift from a holistic judge.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study uses 60 seed responses from real multi-stakeholder travel-planning queries, with stakeholder counts n in {2, 3, 5, 8} and three quality levels. For each seed, the authors create 55 semantics-preserving variants across 11 transformation families, including ordering changes, formatting controls, causal framing changes, evidence relocation, paraphrasing, and topic repositioning. Five exact repeats provide an intrinsic-noise baseline. Evaluations are run at temperature 0 using Qwen3.5-Plus, Gemini-3-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. For medium- and high-quality responses, variance across semantic variants grows with stakeholder count: pooled Growth is 1.87, and Gemini reaches 6.67x. At n=8, the Sem/Rep ratio reaches 2.64 for medium and high responses, meaning presentation changes add much more variance than repeated evaluation noise. Low-quality responses do not show this pattern, with Growth 0.29, likely due to a floor effect. Structured protocols reduce variance, but judge-assigned adaptive weights reintroduce instability: Rubric has Growth 1.18, decomposed scoring with fixed uniform weights has 1.20, while adaptive decomposed weighting rises to 1.58 using the same utility estimates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the empirical setup carefully, especially the definitions of semantic-variant variance, repeat variance, and the Sem/Rep ratio. Table 1 is the main evidence for variance growth with stakeholder count. The most informative comparison is between adaptive decomposed scoring and uniform decomposed scoring, because it isolates aggregation-weight noise while holding utility estimates fixed. The theory section is worth a quick pass for its argument that weight drift can corrupt within-group rankings in GRPO. For DecompR, focus on how counterfactual-calibrated weights are derived from query structure and whether this calibration introduces a new source of judge bias.

recommendation.zh: 多利益相关方对齐中权重噪声的发现很有价值，DecompR 的解耦思路对设计更稳定的 RLHF 奖励模型有启发，重点看 §3 的理论分析。
recommendation.en: The identification of weighting noise in multi-stakeholder alignment is valuable; DecompR's decoupling approach informs more stable RLHF reward model design—focus on §3 theoretical analysis.

paper.title: KARMA: Karma-Aligned Reward Model Adaptation
paper.abstract: Human communication depends on implicit social signals where effectiveness is shaped by tone, context, and conversational norms rather than semantic content alone. We introduce KARMA (Karma-Aligned Reward Model Adaptation), a framework for LLM learning of context-sensitive conversational behavior from large-scale social interaction data. KARMA trains a reward model on Reddit conversations to predict response valuation conditioned on context, and uses this signal to fine-tune language models via

summary.core_problem: 如何从大规模社交互动数据中学习语用和语境敏感的对话偏好，并把这种信号转成可用于 LLM 对齐的奖励模型。
summary.importance: 它和 pretrain 的直接关系不强，但对 post-train 信号设计有启发：奖励模型的离线拟合指标不一定对应下游 RL 效果，这对 RLHF/RLAIF 的 reward 选择很关键。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 KARMA：先在 Reddit 对话上训练 reward model，预测回复在上下文中的社会反馈，再用该奖励通过强化学习微调语言模型。作者特别比较了不同 reward 设计，发现只看上下文的 reward 虽然更难准确预测 karma，却带来更好的下游行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模细节。实验比较了 reward model 的预测性能与 RL 后下游表现，并测试了下游模型是否直接暴露于社交媒体数据。核心结果是：最佳 reward predictor 并不对应最佳 downstream alignment，说明 reward misspecification 比拟合精度更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to learn pragmatics- and context-sensitive conversational preferences from large-scale social interaction data and turn them into useful reward signals for LLM alignment.
summary_en.importance: Its direct link to pretraining is limited, but it is relevant for post-training signal design: better offline reward-model fit does not necessarily translate into better RL outcomes, which matters for RLHF/RLAIF practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: KARMA first trains a reward model on Reddit conversations to predict socially valued responses conditioned on context, then uses that reward for RL fine-tuning. A key comparison is across reward formulations, including a context-only reward that predicts karma worse but yields better downstream behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes. The main empirical result is a decoupling between reward-model predictive accuracy and downstream alignment quality, with additional tests on whether the downstream model had direct exposure to the social-media data.

recommendation.zh: 可当 reward design 的反例读：别把 RM AUC 当真目标，只看“预测更差却 RL 更好”这一点就够了。
recommendation.en: Read it as a reward-design cautionary tale: do not optimize for RM fit alone; the key signal is that a worse predictor can drive better RL.

paper.title: Beyond a Single Direction: Chain-of-Thought Disrupts Simple Steering of Refusal
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) generate chain-of-thought (CoT) traces before producing final outputs, introducing a dynamic internal state that may complicate control mechanisms such as refusal. Unlike instruction-tuned LLMs, where refusal is mediated by a single directional subspace, refusal in large reasoning models (LRMs) additionally depends on the CoT. In DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B, activation steering reverses refusal in only 39% of cases when the CoT is kept fixed, but removing the CoT e

summary.core_problem: 在带显式 Chain-of-Thought 的大推理模型（LRM）里，“拒答/谨慎”不再像传统指令模型那样主要由单一残差流方向控制。论文要回答的是：CoT 作为中间生成物是否在机制上参与了拒答状态的维持与重建，从而让常见的 activation steering 失效或效果不稳定。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏机制与安全控制，不是预训练/优化主线。但它对 post-train（尤其是用 R1/o1 风格 CoT 训练出来的模型）有一个很具体的启发：一旦模型把“安全/拒答”写进了可生成的中间轨迹，控制信号就可能变成双通道（残差方向 + CoT 内容），单点 steering 会被 CoT 在生成过程中“反向修复”。对做 RL 对齐的人，这意味着：只在最终输出层面约束可能不够，CoT 生成过程本身会成为新的对齐对象与攻击面。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是 activation steering + 条件化控制 CoT 生成方式来做因果拆解。
- 方向提取：沿用 Arditi 等的 difference-in-means，在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B 的 residual stream 上，用 100 条 harmful（会拒答）与 100 条 harmless（会遵从）指令，分别在模板 token 的末位置（EOI：end-of-instruction；EOT：end-of-think）取各层激活均值差，得到 refusal/compliance direction。
- 干预方式：对 residual stream 做 activation addition（沿方向加/减，系数 α），并设计三种 CoT 条件：固定 CoT（不让其变化）、完全去掉 CoT、允许在 steering 下重新生成 CoT（两阶段：先生成 CoT，再输出答案）。
核心贡献不在新算法，而在实验设计把“CoT 是否会主动重建拒答信号”单独拎出来测。
summary.experiments:
在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B 上，用 100 条 JAILBREAKBENCH harmful 指令（基线 0% compliance）评测：
- 仅做 steering 且固定 CoT：拒答反转（compliance）约 39%（EOI）到 43%（EOT），并随层数变化。
- 去掉 CoT 再 steering：compliance 提升到 70%，说明 CoT 生成过程会抵消 steering 的一部分效果。
- 允许在 steering 下重新生成 CoT（两阶段）：compliance 达到 94%。
- 复用“在 steering 下生成的 compliant CoT”，但移除 steering：仍保留 48% 的效果，说明 CoT 本身携带了可迁移的拒答/遵从状态。
这些数字支持“拒答是双信号冗余机制”：残差方向能推，但 CoT 会在生成中把状态拉回去；让 CoT 也跟着变，效果才稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30 分钟）：
1) 实验设置与三种 CoT 条件的定义：固定/抑制/再生成，决定了因果结论是否成立。
2) Table 1 与 Figure 1：看不同层、不同模板位置（EOI/EOT）的敏感性，判断“方向”是否稳定。
3) Appendix 里关于拒答判定指标：他们指出短语启发式在 LRM 上不可靠，这会影响结果可信度。

如果你的兴趣是训练而非安全机制，可以只抓一个点：CoT 作为可生成中间变量，会把对齐信号从“输出”扩展到“过程”，这会反过来影响 RL/蒸馏时该约束什么、记录什么。

summary_en.core_problem: In large reasoning models that explicitly generate chain-of-thought (CoT), refusal behavior may no longer be controlled by a single residual-stream direction (as shown for instruction-tuned LLMs). The paper asks whether CoT generation actively mediates and reconstructs the refusal state, thereby weakening standard activation-steering interventions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily mechanistic/safety work rather than pretraining. The actionable takeaway for post-training of R1/o1-style models is that alignment/refusal can become a dual-channel mechanism: (1) a residual-stream “refusal direction” and (2) the generated CoT itself. If CoT can rebuild refusal during generation, then output-only control (or single-point steering) may be brittle; the reasoning trace becomes both a control target and an attack surface. That has implications for RL-style alignment objectives and for whether to supervise/regularize intermediate traces.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is an intervention design that isolates the causal role of CoT.
- Direction extraction: difference-in-means (Arditi et al.) on residual-stream activations of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B, using 100 refused harmful vs 100 complied harmless prompts. Activations are taken at template token endpoints (EOI: end-of-instruction; EOT: end-of-think) across layers to define a refusal/compliance direction.
- Steering: activation addition along the extracted direction with magnitude α.
- CoT conditions: (i) keep CoT fixed, (ii) suppress/remove CoT, (iii) regenerate CoT under steering in a two-stage setup (generate CoT, then final answer).
The method is standard steering; the novelty is treating CoT as an active mediator and testing it with controlled generation protocols.
summary_en.experiments:
On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B with 100 harmful JAILBREAKBENCH prompts (0% baseline compliance under greedy decoding):
- Steering with fixed CoT reverses refusal only ~39% (EOI) to ~43% (EOT), varying by layer.
- Removing CoT increases compliance to ~70%, suggesting CoT generation counteracts steering by reconstructing refusal.
- Regenerating CoT under steering yields ~94% compliance.
- Reusing a previously steered “compliant CoT” without steering still preserves ~48% of the effect, indicating CoT content carries an independent, transferable compliance signal.
Overall, results support a redundant/parallel mechanism: residual direction + CoT dynamics jointly determine refusal.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 min):
1) The exact definitions of the three CoT conditions (fixed vs suppressed vs regenerated); the causal claim hinges on these controls.
2) The main result table and the layer-wise plots (EOI vs EOT): they show how stable the direction is and where steering matters.
3) The appendix discussion on refusal measurement: they argue phrase heuristics fail for LRMs, which is important for interpreting compliance rates.

If your focus is training rather than safety, extract one implication: once CoT is trained as a first-class generated object, alignment constraints may need to target the generation process, not just the final answer.

recommendation.zh: 研究CoT机制、模型可控性与对齐的研究员需重点看§3的对照实验，修正了对推理模型拒绝控制路径的 prior 认知。
recommendation.en: Researchers studying CoT, controllability and alignment should prioritize §3 controlled experiments, which revise prior beliefs about refusal control pathways in reasoning models.

paper.title: SafetyRepro: Configuration-Conditional Rank Instability on Alignment Benchmarks
paper.abstract: Pairwise model comparisons drawn from foundation-model benchmarks ("A is safer than B") are read as quantitative verdicts but hinge on harness choices benchmark papers under-specify. We close one theory-benchmark loop on this primitive: a finite-envelope proposition tying a measurable pairwise-disagreement rate to whether the strict ordering admits a configuration-pair reversal, paired with a commit-stamped evaluation protocol that operationalises it on widely cited alignment benchmarks. On ever

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“模型谁更安全”，而是“安全 benchmark 给出的模型排序到底有多稳”。作者抓住一个很具体、也很常被忽略的问题：在对齐/安全评测里，prompt 模板、few-shot 数、解码设置、评分规则、量化方式、评测 harness 的实现细节，往往没有被完整规定，但这些选择本身就可能改变模型间的相对排名。论文要解决的是，如何把这种由评测配置引入的排序不稳定性，定义成一个可测、可复现实验对象，而不是停留在泛泛而谈的“benchmark 有噪声”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于提醒：很多被拿来比较基座模型、对齐策略或数据配方的安全结论，可能并不稳固。尤其当研究者把 TruthfulQA、BBQ、ToxiGen、XSTest 这类分数当作模型能力或对齐质量的证据时，如果评测配置本身能翻转 pairwise verdict，那么这些 benchmark 对训练决策的反馈就带有较强方法方差。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口研究的人，这篇文章的价值在于把“评测协议是训练闭环的一部分”说清楚了：如果评测对象没有被严格定义，训练优化的目标也会漂移。贡献量级偏方法论和测量学，不是新 benchmark，也不是新模型，但对读论文和做实验的口径控制有现实影响。
summary.technical_approach: 作者的核心设计有两层。第一层是定义一个配置条件下的 pairwise-disagreement / rank-flip 指标。不是看单个分数的标准差，而是直接看“在一个事先承诺、commit-stamped 的配置包络内，模型 A 是否可能从优于 B 变成劣于 B”。这个指标更贴近实际使用场景，因为外部读者通常看到的是‘A 比 B 好/安全’，而不是方差分解表。第二层是把这个包络做成分层的、实践导向的配置网格：core tier 近似主流 benchmark/harness 默认设置，stress tier 再加入更激进但仍合理的设置，比如 T4 CoT、T=0.7 解码等。全文的实验主轴是在单一 harness 内，对 3 个 7–9B 开源 instruct 模型、5 个 alignment benchmark、612 个配置单元做穷举式测量，然后统计每个 benchmark 上 pairwise verdict 被配置翻转的比例。作者还用 LightGBM + SHAP 做轴级归因，分析哪些配置维度更主导 rank flip。除此之外，论文单独做了一个跨评测框架案例：在名义上相同的 anchor 配置下，把同一模型送进 lm-eval-harness、HELM-lite、Inspect AI，发现分数差异很大。这里作者刻意不把它解释成单轴“框架误差”，而是指出三者评测的 candidate object 实际并不等价，例如 TruthfulQA 的打分对象分别可能是 canonical answer set 的 logprob、concat-then-rank 的 joint multiple choice、或 A/B/C/D letter 的 logprob。这个处理比较克制，也说明作者关心的是测量对象定义，而不只是软件 bug。
summary.experiments: 实验范围刻意收窄在消费级 16GB 显存、NF4 量化部署、3 个 7–9B 开源 instruct 模型、5 个安全/对齐 benchmark、固定题目子集。作者明确说不把结论外推成“所有 LLM 评测都不可靠”。在这个范围内，结果很强：所有被测 benchmark 上，单靠配置选择就可以翻转 pairwise verdict。XSTest 最极端，Qwen、Mistral、Yi 三个模型的 6 种两两排序都能在配置包络内实现。方差分解方面，在 BBQ、ToxiGen、XSTest 这几个 free-form benchmark 上，实现/配置主效应解释的总体方差至少与模型身份相当；只有 TruthfulQA 更明显由模型主导。与此同时，model-by-implementation interaction 普遍很大，说明不存在一个对所有模型都“等比例偏移”的简单校正项。跨框架案例里，在 bf16、greedy、0-shot、300 examples、seed 42 的名义 anchor 配置下，仅更换评测包，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在 TruthfulQA 上的 reported score 跨度达到 21.7 个百分点，在 BBQ 上达到 22.7 个百分点。作者还做了一个保守的小规模 scale probe，试图排除“只是某个模型家族特殊”的混淆，但没有把它包装成 scaling law 结论。对 skim 级阅读，最该记住的数字就是：612-cell grid、所有 benchmark 都出现 rank flip、XSTest 上 6 种排序全可达、跨框架分数差可到 20+ 个点。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction 和 §5.1，把作者到底在测什么先钉牢：不是分数波动，而是 pairwise verdict 是否可翻转。然后看配置包络的定义，区分 core tier 和 stress tier，理解作者为何强调 commit-stamped 和 practice-derived。接着看方差分解与 rank-flip 结果，尤其是 XSTest 的排序可达性，以及 TruthfulQA 与其他 benchmark 的差异。再看 SHAP 归因，判断主要不稳定性来自 prompt、scoring、decoding 还是量化。最后看附录里跨框架案例，重点不是具体哪个包更对，而是 nominally same task 在不同 harness 里 candidate object 已经变了。泛读 25–35 分钟足够抓住主结论；如果你平时依赖 alignment benchmark 做模型选择，值得把 disclosure template 和 GRID card 也看一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking which model is safer. It asks whether safety/alignment benchmarks provide stable pairwise rankings at all. The concrete issue is that benchmark papers often leave key evaluator choices under-specified: prompt template, decoding setup, few-shot count, scoring rule, quantization regime, and even the exact harness implementation. Those choices can change the relative ordering between models. The paper turns that concern into a measurable object: configuration-conditional rank instability, rather than a vague statement that benchmarks are noisy.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is indirect but real. Safety and alignment benchmarks are often used as evidence when comparing base models, post-training recipes, or data mixtures. If the pairwise verdict itself can flip under plausible evaluator configurations, then the benchmark signal fed back into model development is less reliable than the headline numbers suggest. This matters at the pretrain↔post-train interface: if the evaluation target is not tightly specified, optimization pressure can drift toward artifacts of the harness rather than properties of the model. The contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic. It does not introduce a new benchmark or a new model, but it sharpens how benchmark evidence should be interpreted.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main contribution has two parts. First, the authors define an operator-controllable pairwise-disagreement rate, or rank-flip rate. Instead of reporting score variance, they ask a more decision-relevant question: within a pre-declared, commit-stamped envelope of plausible evaluation configurations, can model A switch from outperforming model B to underperforming it? That unit matches how benchmark results are actually consumed. Second, they instantiate this idea with a tiered configuration envelope. The core tier reflects common benchmark and harness defaults; the stress tier adds still-plausible but more aggressive settings such as T4 CoT and temperature 0.7 decoding. Empirically, they exhaustively evaluate three 7–9B open-weight instruction-tuned models on five alignment-related benchmarks over a 612-cell grid inside one harness, then compute exact rank-flip statistics. They also use LightGBM plus SHAP for axis-level attribution, to localize which evaluator choices drive instability. Separately, they run a cross-package case study with lm-evaluation-harness, HELM-lite, and Inspect AI under a nominally matched anchor configuration. The important point is not just that scores differ, but that the evaluated candidate object is often not the same across packages. For example, TruthfulQA may be scored as log-probability over the canonical MC1 answer set, as concat-then-rank multiple-choice joint scoring, or as log-probability over answer letters with a separate label map. That distinction is handled carefully and is one of the stronger parts of the paper.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical scope is intentionally narrow: consumer-grade 16GB-class NF4 deployment, three 7–9B open-weight instruction-tuned models, five alignment/safety benchmarks, and one fixed item subset per benchmark. The authors explicitly avoid claiming a population-level statement about all LLM evaluation. Within that envelope, the result is strong: on every benchmark tested, configuration choice alone can flip the pairwise verdict. XSTest is the clearest example, where all six possible orderings among Qwen, Mistral, and Yi are reachable within the tested envelope. In variance accounting, implementation/configuration main effects explain at least as much aggregate variance as model identity on BBQ, ToxiGen, and XSTest; TruthfulQA is the main exception, where model identity dominates more clearly. Model-by-implementation interactions are large throughout, which means the instability is not a simple global offset that could be calibrated away. In the cross-framework case study, using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct under bf16, greedy decoding, 0-shot, 300 examples, and seed 42, reported scores differ by 21.7 percentage points on TruthfulQA and 22.7 points on BBQ depending only on the evaluation package. There is also a bounded scale probe intended to rule out a single-family confound, but the authors are careful not to overstate it as a scaling-law result.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the section defining the rank-flip metric. The key is to understand that the target quantity is not score variance but the existence of pairwise reversals under a declared configuration envelope. Then read the envelope construction carefully, especially the distinction between the core tier and the stress tier, because much of the paper’s credibility depends on that choice. After that, focus on the main rank-flip results and the variance decomposition, especially why TruthfulQA behaves differently from BBQ, ToxiGen, and XSTest. The SHAP analysis is worth a quick pass to see which evaluator axes dominate instability. Finally, read the appendix case study on lm-eval-harness, HELM-lite, and Inspect AI. The main lesson there is not which package is better, but that nominally similar tasks may correspond to different scored objects. Around 25–35 minutes is enough for a solid skim; read the disclosure template as well if you run benchmark-heavy experiments.

recommendation.zh: 对齐评测可靠性的方法论文章，对做SFT/RLHF评估的研究者有直接参考——任何成对安全排名声称都应先通过SafetyRepro类方法检验配置稳定性
recommendation.en: Methodology paper on alignment evaluation reliability. Researchers doing SFT/RLHF evaluation should note that any pairwise safety ranking claim needs configuration-robustness verification via SafetyRepro-like methods.

paper.title: DVAO: Dynamic Variance-adaptive Advantage Optimization for Multi-reward Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning has become a standard paradigm for aligning Large Language Models with human intent and task requirements. While Group Relative Policy Optimization offers an efficient, value-model-free alternative to Proximal Policy Optimization, adapting it to real-world multi-reward settings remains challenging. Standard scalarization practices, such as Reward Combination and Advantage Combination, suffer from significant drawbacks: Reward Combination frequently generates advantages wit

summary.core_problem: 解决多奖励 RL 对齐中，GRPO 类无 value 模型方法如何稳定地合并多个奖励信号，避免优势值尺度失控和静态权重失配的问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练阶段的优化细节工作，不是新对齐范式，但它触及一个真实痛点：多目标奖励在实践里常常噪声不同、量纲不同、相关性不同，简单加权会把训练推向不稳定区间。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 DVAO，用 rollout group 内各奖励目标的经验方差来动态调整组合权重。直觉上，方差更能反映当前目标的有效学习信号与噪声水平，因此方法会抬高信号更强的目标、压低更噪的目标，替代固定的 Reward Combination 或 Advantage Combination。核心改动发生在 advantage 组合层，而不是引入额外 value model 或复杂多目标优化器。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点是与标准 Reward Combination 和 Advantage Combination 比较训练稳定性与多奖励场景下的表现，但未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体任务和提升幅度。当前能确认的是作者主张其方法在真实多奖励设置下更稳，且能利用目标间方差差异自适应分配学习重心。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how to combine multiple reward signals stably in GRPO-style value-free RL for LLM alignment, avoiding exploding advantage scales and the mismatch of static weighting.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training optimization paper rather than a new alignment paradigm, but it targets a real practical issue: multi-objective rewards differ in noise, scale, and correlation, and naive scalarization often destabilizes training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes DVAO, which dynamically adjusts combination weights using the empirical variance of each reward objective within a rollout group. The intuition is that variance captures signal quality and noise level, so the method up-weights objectives with stronger learning signal and suppresses noisier ones. The change is made at the advantage-combination stage, without adding a value model or a more complex multi-objective optimizer.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments mainly compare against standard Reward Combination and Advantage Combination in terms of stability and performance under multi-reward settings, but no model size, data scale, task suite, or effect size is provided. What can be inferred is that the authors claim better stability and more adaptive credit assignment across objectives.

recommendation.zh: 偏工程型的小改进，不会改写 RL 对齐认知；若你在做多 reward GRPO，先看它如何定义方差权重和是否真能压住 advantage 爆炸。
recommendation.en: An engineering-side tweak, not a paradigm shift; worth checking only if you run multi-reward GRPO and care whether variance-based weighting actually tames advantage blow-ups.

paper.title: Clarification Is Not Enough: Post-Clarification Answering Remains the Bottleneck in Multi-Turn QA
paper.abstract: Pluralistic alignment requires systems to adapt to diverse user values, communication styles, and contextual assumptions. We believe that a foundational prerequisite for such alignment enabling accurate preference elicitation from people when their intent is under-specified or ambiguous. We study the problem of preference elicitation in multi-turn question answering by decomposing the problem into two components: a \textbf{clarification policy}, which decides whether to ask a clarifying question

summary.core_problem: 研究多轮问答中用户意图不完整或有歧义时，模型是否只要学会提澄清问题就能给出正确最终答案。
summary.importance: 贡献是行为分析而不是新训练范式：它把偏好澄清拆成“是否澄清”的策略问题和“澄清后能否正确作答”的理解问题，指出后者可能是更大的瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 论文基于 PACIFIC benchmark，将多轮 QA 流程分解为 clarification policy 和 post-clarification answering 两部分，并观察监督微调对两部分能力的影响。核心技术点是用动作正确性和最终答案正确性分开度量，避免把“会问问题”和“能用好用户补充信息”混在一起。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验使用 PACIFIC benchmark，并比较监督微调前后的表现。结论是 SFT 能较快改善是否提问的策略，但即便模型采取了正确动作，最终答案准确率仍明显偏低；具体模型规模、训练数据量和提升幅度未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether learning to ask clarifying questions is sufficient for accurate multi-turn QA when user intent is underspecified.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an analysis of failure decomposition: clarification policy and post-clarification answering are measured separately, showing that the latter remains a hard bottleneck.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the PACIFIC benchmark, the work separates the decision to clarify from the ability to interpret the user's follow-up and produce the final answer. This isolates action correctness from answer correctness, which is useful for diagnosing multi-turn alignment failures.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments with supervised fine-tuning on PACIFIC. SFT rapidly improves the clarification policy, but final answer accuracy remains substantially lower even when the model chooses the correct action. Model sizes, data scale, and exact numbers are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 结论不改 pretrain recipe，但提醒多轮数据不能只标“问不问”，要单独测澄清后信息绑定。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining recipe paper, but it is a useful warning: multi-turn data should test post-clarification binding, not just whether the model asks.

paper.title: Benchmarking and Improving Monitors for Out-Of-Distribution Alignment Failure in LLMs
paper.abstract: Many safety and alignment failures of large language models (LLMs) occur due to out-of-distribution (OOD) situations: unusual prompt or response patterns that are unforeseen by model developers. We systematically study whether LLM monitoring pipelines can detect these OOD alignment failures by introducing a benchmark called Misalignment Out Of Distribution (MOOD). It is difficult to find failures that are truly OOD for off-the-shelf models trained on vast safety datasets. We sidestep this by inc

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个很实际的安全监控问题：当 LLM 出现训练分布之外的对齐失败时，现有 guard model 是否还能识别，以及能否用 OOD detector 补上这类泛化缺口。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在 post-train 与部署监控的接口。它提醒一个重要事实：安全分类器学到的往往是 post-training 数据中的“已知不安全模式”，而不是稳定的抽象安全概念。因此，继续扩大安全数据并不能完全解决未知失败模式。对基座研究员有启发的是，模型的预训练知识、post-training 安全边界、监控器分布泛化三者并不等价；安全能力需要用分布迁移的方式单独评估。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是构造 MOOD benchmark。作者没有直接评测现成安全模型，因为很难确认哪些样本对这些模型是真正 OOD。相反，他们训练自己的 monitor，并故意限制训练集，只覆盖常见安全失败，排除若干已知失败类型。测试集则包含 7 类 held-out 对齐失败，包括 tool-call deception、extreme sycophancy、jailbreak、scheming 等。这样可以可控地测量 monitor 对未知失败模式的泛化。方法上，论文比较了两类信号：guard model 回答“是否安全”，OOD detector 回答“是否像训练分布”。OOD detector 覆盖 ensemble disagreement、perplexity、internal activation、instruction tuning 等路线。最终 pipeline 是将 guard model 与 OOD detector 组合，只要安全分类或分布检测任一信号触发，就进行拦截。
summary.experiments: 主要结果是：单独 guard model 在 MOOD 的多个 OOD failure test set 上召回率下降明显，说明安全分类器对 held-out 失败模式泛化不足。将 guard model 与 perplexity 或 Mahalanobis activation-based OOD detector 结合后，平均 misalignment recall 提升约 4–7 个百分点。论文还报告了一个有用的工程观察：小 guard model 加 OOD detection 可以超过大约 20 倍参数规模的单独 guard model，说明异常检测信号不是简单靠扩大分类器规模就能替代。作者还观察到 guard model 及其与 OOD detector 的组合存在随模型规模提升而改善的趋势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 MOOD 的数据构造部分，特别是训练集如何被刻意限制、7 个 OOD test set 如何定义；再看 OOD detector 的比较实验和 guard+OOD 的组合方式。对预训练研究者来说，最值得留意的是实验设计方法：用受控训练分布模拟未来未知失败，而不是试图证明某个现成模型面对真实世界所有 OOD 都稳健。具体模型细节和安全 taxonomy 可以略读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLM monitoring systems, especially guard models, can detect alignment failures that fall outside their training distribution, and whether explicit OOD detection can improve this robustness.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining research is indirect but useful. The paper shows that safety classifiers often learn the failure patterns present in post-training data rather than a distribution-invariant notion of unsafe behavior. This matters for the pretrain–posttrain interface: pretrained knowledge, safety fine-tuning, and deployment-time monitoring do not provide the same generalization guarantees. Expanding safety data helps, but it does not remove the need to evaluate distribution shift explicitly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key contribution is MOOD, a benchmark designed to make OOD alignment failures measurable. Instead of evaluating only off-the-shelf guard models, where the training data is unknown and likely broad, the authors train their own monitors on a deliberately restricted safety dataset. Several known failure types are excluded from training and used as held-out test distributions. MOOD contains seven OOD failure categories, including tool-call deception, extreme sycophancy, jailbreaks, and scheming. The monitoring setup combines two signals: a guard model that asks whether a conversation is unsafe, and an OOD detector that asks whether the conversation resembles the monitor’s training distribution. The paper compares ensemble disagreement, perplexity-based detection, activation-based methods such as Mahalanobis distance, and instruction-tuning-based detectors.
