paper.title: Hölder Policy Optimisation
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) enhances large language models by estimating advantages across a group of sampled trajectories. However, mapping these trajectory-level advantages to policy updates requires aggregating token-level probabilities within each sequence. Relying on a fixed aggregation mechanism for this step fundamentally limits the algorithm's adaptability. Empirically, we observe a critical trade-off: certain fixed aggregations frequently suffer from training collapse, whi

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 GRPO 类算法中 token 概率聚合方式过于固定的问题：把 trajectory-level advantage 转成 token-level policy update 时，不同聚合函数会在稀疏信号利用和梯度方差之间产生明显取舍。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 post-train/RL 优化方法，对预训练研究的间接启发在于训练信号如何被放大、平滑和稳定化。长链推理训练常见的问题不是只有 reward 设计，也包括 advantage 如何传递到每个 token。HölderPO 给出了一个统一视角，把 GRPO 的算术平均、GSPO/GMPO 的几何平均放进同一族聚合函数中，并用可调参数解释不同任务上的训练稳定性差异。它不是预训练方法，但对 RLVR 与 reasoning model 的训练动态有实用参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是用 Hölder mean 统一 token-level probability ratio 的聚合。参数 p 控制聚合形态：p=1 对应算术平均，p 趋近 0 对应几何平均，其他正负取值则在两者之外提供连续调节。作者给出的分析是双向取舍：较大的 p 会把梯度权重集中到少数 token 上，更容易放大稀疏但关键的学习信号；代价是方差边界变松，训练更容易不稳。较小或负的 p 会压低方差，有利于收敛稳定；代价是会削弱稀疏高价值 token 的影响。基于这个观察，HölderPO 不是固定一个 p，而是采用动态 annealing：训练早期用较大的正 p 强化稀疏信号，后期逐步转向负 p 以控制方差。
summary.experiments: 主要实验基于 Qwen2.5-Math-7B。作者先展示不同任务对 p 的偏好不同：AIME 这类稀疏信号任务在 p=3 附近表现更好，MATH500 这类更密集信号任务在 p=-1 附近更稳。固定 p=3 时，AIME accuracy 达到 46.7%，高于文中列出的 43.3% 对照记录。使用动态 p annealing 后，五个数学 benchmark 的平均准确率为 54.9%，相对标准 GRPO 提升 7.2%。评测包括 AIME、AMC、MATH、Minerva 和 OlympiadBench。方法还在 ALFWorld 上报告 93.8% success rate，相对 GRPO 的 72.8% 有 28.8% 相对提升。需要关注的是，不同任务的 reward 密度定义、p schedule 的敏感性、以及是否在更大模型和更长训练预算下保持同样结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。先看引言和 Figure 1，理解 p 对 AIME24 与 MATH500 的相反影响。再看理论部分中梯度权重分布和方差边界的推导，重点判断结论依赖哪些近似。实验部分优先看 p 的网格消融、动态 annealing schedule、与 GRPO/GSPO/GMPO/PMPO 的对比。若用于复现实验，应重点检查 reward normalization、长度归一化、KL 约束、采样组大小和 p schedule，这些因素会显著影响结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific weakness in GRPO-style training: trajectory-level advantages must be mapped to token-level policy updates, and the fixed aggregation function used for token probabilities creates a trade-off between exploiting sparse learning signals and controlling gradient variance.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training optimization paper, but it is relevant to researchers studying training dynamics for reasoning models. It shifts attention from reward design alone to how reward-derived advantages are distributed over tokens. HölderPO provides a unified lens for arithmetic-mean GRPO and geometric-mean variants such as GSPO or GMPO, and explains why different reasoning tasks may prefer different aggregation regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method replaces a fixed token-probability aggregation rule with the Hölder mean. The parameter p controls the aggregation shape: p=1 recovers the arithmetic mean, p approaching 0 recovers the geometric mean, and other positive or negative values provide a continuous family of update rules. The paper characterizes a two-sided trade-off. Larger p concentrates gradient weight on a smaller set of tokens, which can amplify rare but informative signals in sparse-reward reasoning tasks. The cost is a looser variance bound and higher risk of unstable updates. Smaller or negative p tightens variance and improves stability, but it can smooth away rare high-value token contributions. The proposed practical instantiation uses p annealing: start with a larger positive p to exploit sparse signals, then move toward a negative p to stabilize convergence.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Qwen2.5-Math-7B. The ablations show task-dependent sensitivity to p: AIME-style sparse-signal tasks prefer larger positive values, with AIME24 peaking around p=3, while denser tasks such as MATH500 prefer lower or negative values, with a reported peak around p=-1. With fixed p=3, AIME accuracy reaches 46.7%, compared with the 43.3% reference reported by the authors. With dynamic p annealing, HölderPO reaches 54.9% average accuracy over five math benchmarks: AIME, AMC, MATH, Minerva, and OlympiadBench. This is reported as a 7.2% relative gain over standard GRPO. The method also reports a 93.8% success rate on ALFWorld, compared with 72.8% for GRPO. The main points to verify are reward-density definitions, sensitivity of the p schedule, and whether the same behavior holds for larger models and longer RL runs.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to see why AIME24 and MATH500 prefer different p values. Then read the theoretical section on gradient weight concentration and variance bounds, focusing on the assumptions behind the trade-off. In the experiments, prioritize the p-grid ablation, the annealing schedule, and comparisons against GRPO, GSPO, GMPO, and PMPO. For reproduction, pay close attention to reward normalization, length handling, KL control, group size, and the exact p schedule.

recommendation.zh: 只需看第3章的理论推导和第4.2节的实验结果，可直接用于内部RL对齐实验的baseline改进
recommendation.en: Only read theoretical derivation in §3 and experimental results in §4.2, can be directly used to improve RL alignment baseline in internal experiments

paper.title: To Whom Do Language Models Align? Measuring Principal Hierarchies Under High-Stakes Competing Demands
paper.abstract: Language models deployed in high-stakes professional settings face conflicting demands from users, institutional authorities, and professional norms. How models act when these demands conflict reveals a principal hierarchy -- an implicit ordering over competing stakeholders that determines, for instance, whether a medical AI receiving a cost-reduction directive from a hospital administrator complies at the expense of evidence-based care, or refuses because professional standards require it. Acro

summary.core_problem: 论文评测高风险专业场景中，语言模型在用户、机构权威和专业规范发生冲突时，会把谁的要求排在前面。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 alignment evaluation，不是预训练方法论文。它对基座研究的间接价值在于，把“对齐”从单一用户偏好扩展到多主体冲突，并显示模型在 advisory framing 下看似遵守专业标准，但在 drafting、execution 这类实际执行任务中会明显退化。这个现象提示，后训练数据和评测不能只覆盖“问模型该不该做”，还要覆盖“让模型直接产出专业工作物”时的规范稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 principal hierarchy 的测量框架，显式区分三类 principal：用户、机构权威和专业标准。数据覆盖法律和医疗两个领域。ground-truth 子集包含可验证事实，例如已被推翻的 Supreme Court precedent、已撤回药物；另有一组两个选项都合理的场景，用来隔离模型是否偏好某类 principal，而不是只是在追踪正确答案。场景生成采用 counterbalanced design：固定事实内容，只扰动 principal 配置、任务 framing 和压力水平。评测时不只看模型是否知道事实，还看它在冲突指令下是否把相关知识写入最终行动。
summary.experiments: 评测规模为 7,136 个场景、10 个 frontier models。其中 6,096 个场景有可验证专业标准，1,040 个场景包含两个同样有效但由不同 principal 支持的选项。主要发现包括：在 advisory tasks 中，模型通常更能维护专业标准；在 execution tasks 中，principal ordering 最多有 74% 的情况发生变化；医疗场景里 authority figure 往往比用户更容易被模型优先考虑，但法律场景不明显；不同模型家族表现不稳定。一个关键失败模式是 knowledge omission：每个 item 都先经过 per-model knowledge check，确认模型知道相关事实，但在 principal-demand conflict 下，模型没有把已知事实纳入最终输出，表现得像真正不知道一样。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解场景扰动如何控制内容不变、只改变 principal 和 framing。然后看数据构造与过滤流程，尤其是 per-model knowledge check，因为它决定了 failure mode 是否能归因于对齐冲突而不是知识缺失。结果部分重点看 advisory 与 execution 的差异，以及 legal 与 medical 的差异。若关心后训练评测，可重点看 failure mode taxonomy 和 pressure-level manipulation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures which principal a language model prioritizes when user requests, institutional authority, and professional standards conflict in high-stakes legal and medical settings.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an alignment-evaluation paper rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that it moves evaluation beyond single-user preference following. The main lesson is that models can appear standards-aligned in advisory settings but become less stable when asked to draft or execute professional work. This has implications for post-training data design and safety evaluation: asking whether a model can state the rule is not enough; evaluations need to test whether the model applies the rule under conflicting demands.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define a principal hierarchy over three parties: the user, an authority figure, and the professional standard. They build counterbalanced legal and medical scenarios where factual content is held fixed while principal configuration, task framing, and pressure level are varied. The ground-truth subset uses verifiable professional facts, such as overruled Supreme Court cases and withdrawn drugs. A separate subset with two equally valid options isolates principal preference from correctness tracking. The evaluation separates knowledge possession from action: each item passes a per-model knowledge check before being used to test behavior under conflict.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 10 frontier models on 7,136 scenarios: 6,096 with verifiable professional standards and 1,040 with two valid options endorsed by competing principals. The key findings are that professional standards tend to dominate in advisory tasks, but the ordering can shift in up to 74% of cases under execution-style tasks; authority figures are often prioritized over users in medical contexts but not consistently in legal contexts; and model families differ substantially. The dominant failure mode is knowledge omission: models know the relevant fact during a knowledge check, yet fail to surface it when a conflicting principal demand appears in the task.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read Figures 1 and 2 first to understand the controlled perturbation design. Then inspect the dataset construction, especially the per-model knowledge filtering, because it supports the claim that failures are not simple ignorance. In the results, focus on advisory versus execution framing, legal versus medical differences, and the failure-mode analysis. For post-training evaluation work, the pressure manipulation and knowledge-omission analysis are the most reusable parts.

recommendation.zh: 对齐优先级量化方法可参考，发现的执行/咨询场景对齐差异可用于预训练对齐目标设计，重点看§3的测试集构造
recommendation.en: Refer to its alignment hierarchy quantification method, the observed execution-advisory scenario alignment gap can inform pre-training alignment objective design, focus on §3 test set construction

paper.title: Spurious Correlation Learning in Preference Optimization: Mechanisms, Consequences, and Mitigation via Tie Training
paper.abstract: Preference learning methods such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) are known to induce reliance on spurious correlations, leading to sycophancy and length bias in today's language models and potentially severe goal misgeneralization in future systems. In this work, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of this phenomenon, characterizing the mechanisms of spurious learning, its consequences on deployment, and a provable mitigation strategy. Focusing on log-linear policies, we show that

summary.core_problem: 现有偏好优化方法（如DPO）会诱导模型依赖训练数据中的伪相关特征（如回复长度、礼貌程度等表面属性），导致分布偏移下的泛化失效，此前研究仅观测到现象，缺乏统一的理论机制分析和可证明的缓解方案。
summary.importance: 从理论层面解释了对齐阶段伪相关学习的结构性根源，为提升偏好优化的分布鲁棒性、减少对齐后的谄媚、长度偏见等问题提供了有理论依据的指导，同时打通了预训练与对齐阶段分布鲁棒性的研究链路。
summary.technical_approach: 首先构建log-linear DPO的理论分析框架，证明伪相关学习来自训练分布中的平均伪偏置、因果-伪特征相关泄漏两个结构性通道，且仅靠增加同分布训练数据无法消除分布偏移带来的误差；提出平局训练（Tie Training）数据增强策略，通过加入效用相同但伪特征不同的偏好对，选择性正则化伪参数而不影响因果特征的学习。
summary.experiments: 线性模型实验结果与理论推导定量吻合，神经网络和大语言模型实验验证了机制定性成立，平局训练可有效减少模型对伪相关的依赖，同时不降低同分布下的任务精度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的问题定义和核心贡献，第4-6章的核心理论结论，以及第7章的主要实验结果，预计阅读时间30-40分钟，无需深究理论证明细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing preference optimization methods such as DPO induce models to rely on spurious correlations in training data (e.g., response length, politeness), leading to generalization failure under distribution shift. Prior work only observed this phenomenon, lacking unified theoretical mechanism analysis and provable mitigation strategies.
summary_en.importance: It theoretically explains the structural root cause of spurious correlation learning during alignment, provides theoretically grounded guidance for improving the distributional robustness of preference optimization and reducing post-alignment issues such as sycophancy and length bias, and connects distributional robustness research across pretraining and alignment stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first builds a theoretical analysis framework for log-linear DPO, proving that spurious correlation learning arises from two structural channels in the training distribution: mean spurious bias and causal-spurious correlation leakage, and that scaling in-distribution training data alone cannot eliminate error caused by distribution shift. It then proposes Tie Training, a data augmentation strategy that adds preference pairs with equal utility but different spurious features, to selectively regularize spurious parameters without impairing causal feature learning.
summary_en.experiments: Linear model experiments quantitatively match theoretical derivations, neural network and LLM experiments verify the qualitative mechanism holds, and Tie Training effectively reduces model reliance on spurious correlations without degrading in-distribution task accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem definition and core contributions in Chapter 1, key theoretical conclusions in Chapters 4-6, and main experimental results in Chapter 7. Estimated reading time is 30-40 minutes, no need to dive into detailed theoretical proofs.

recommendation.zh: DPO伪相关的机制推导扎实，tie训练思路可直接引入内部对齐pipeline做ablation，重点看§3的理论部分。
recommendation.en: The mechanism derivation of spurious correlation in DPO is rigorous; the tie training idea can be directly introduced to internal alignment pipelines for ablation, focus on §3 theoretical analysis.

paper.title: OGLS-SD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Outcome-Guided Logit Steering for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: We study {on-policy self-distillation} (OPSD), where a language model improves its reasoning ability by distilling privileged teacher distributions along its own on-policy trajectories. Despite the performance gains of OPSD, we identify a common but often overlooked mismatch between teacher and student responses: self-reflected teacher responses can be shifted by reflection-induced bias and response templates, leading to miscalibrated token-level supervision. To mitigate this issue, we propose \

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是 on-policy self-distillation 在推理后训练中为什么会不稳定。OPSD 让模型沿自己的 on-policy 轨迹生成答案，再用同一个模型在带有 privileged information 的条件下提供 token-level teacher distribution。问题在于 teacher 和 student 虽然参数相同或接近，但条件分布不同：teacher 看到了测试时不可用的专家解或反思信息，容易产生路径偏置、模板偏置和过度自信，学生被迫逐 token 拟合这些目标时会出现错配。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近 post-train，但对预训练研究也有信号意义：训练信号质量比目标形式更关键。RLVR 的序列级 reward 太稀疏，OPSD 的 token-level supervision 更密，但如果 teacher distribution 被 privileged condition 污染，密集监督会把错误偏置放大。这个问题与 RL pretrain、reasoning mid-training、合成推理数据训练都有关系：不能只看 reward 是否可验证，也要看 token-level target 是否校准。
summary.technical_approach: OGLS-SD 的核心做法是用 outcome reward 校准自蒸馏 logits，而不是简单把 OPSD loss 和 GRPO/RLVR loss 相加。流程是：对同一问题采样一组 on-policy trajectories，用可验证 reward 标记成功和失败；再分别观察 privileged teacher 在成功轨迹和失败轨迹上的 logits；通过二者对比构造 outcome-guided logit-steering direction；最后用这个方向修正 teacher logits，再作为 student 的 dense token-level 蒸馏目标。这样做的动机是保留 OPSD 的细粒度信用分配，同时用 outcome-level correctness 抑制自反思带来的过度自信和特定答案路径偏置。论文在预备部分还指出，直接拟合每个 privileged teacher instance 是不适定的；学生在测试时没有 privileged solution，理论上应拟合的是对 privileged variable 边缘化后的分布，而不是某个特定 privileged 条件下的分布。
summary.experiments: 实验结论是 OGLS-SD 比 vanilla OPSD 更稳定，也优于把 OPSD 与 RLVR/GRPO 朴素相加的混合训练。改进主要来自两个方面：一是减少 self-distillation collapse，二是把可验证 outcome 的稀疏信号转化为更可用的 token-level 校准信号。提供内容没有包含完整实验表格，因此无法可靠给出模型规模、数据规模、benchmark 名称和绝对提升幅度。可确认的是，实验关注 verifiable reasoning 场景，并以训练稳定性和推理性能作为主要指标。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–40 分钟。先看 introduction 和 preliminaries，重点理解 teacher-student mismatch：同一个模型在 privileged condition 下并不等于无偏 teacher。然后看 OGLS-SD 的 logit steering 公式，确认 steering direction 是如何由成功/失败轨迹对比得到的。实验部分优先看与 vanilla OPSD、GRPO/RLVR、OPSD+GRPO 的对照，以及 collapse 曲线或训练稳定性指标。若时间有限，可以跳过常规 benchmark 描述，保留对 loss 设计和消融实验的阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why on-policy self-distillation can collapse during reasoning-oriented post-training. In OPSD, the model samples its own trajectories and then uses a privileged version of itself as the teacher. The mismatch is subtle: the teacher may condition on expert solutions or reflective context that the student will not have at test time, so its token-level distribution can become biased, templated, or overconfident.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining-adjacent work is signal quality. Dense token-level supervision is not automatically better than sparse outcome rewards. If the teacher distribution is miscalibrated, dense supervision can amplify the wrong bias faster than RLVR. This matters for reasoning mid-training, RL-style pretraining, and synthetic reasoning data pipelines, where the training target often mixes verifiable outcomes with generated rationales.
summary_en.technical_approach: OGLS-SD calibrates the teacher logits using outcome information. For each prompt, the model samples a group of on-policy rollouts, and a verifier labels them as successful or failed. The method then contrasts teacher logits induced by successful and failed trajectories to build an outcome-guided steering direction. This steering signal modifies the privileged teacher distribution before distillation, so the student still receives dense token-level guidance, but the guidance is constrained by correctness signals. This differs from a naive OPSD-plus-GRPO mixture: outcome rewards are not only added as a separate sequence-level objective, but are used to reshape the token-level teacher target itself.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results show better stability and reasoning performance than vanilla OPSD and simple hybrids with RLVR-style objectives. The qualitative effect is reduced self-distillation collapse and more efficient use of verifiable rewards for token-level learning. The supplied content does not include enough experimental tables to quote model sizes, dataset sizes, benchmark names, or exact gain numbers. The experiments should therefore be read for the comparative pattern and ablations rather than for a single headline metric.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–40 minute skim is appropriate. Read the introduction and preliminaries first, especially the argument that the privileged teacher target is not the same distribution the student should learn at test time. Then inspect the logit-steering formulation and the ablations comparing vanilla OPSD, RLVR/GRPO, naive mixtures, and OGLS-SD. If time is limited, focus on the loss construction and collapse/stability plots; routine benchmark descriptions can be skimmed.

recommendation.zh: 自蒸馏的监督偏差是推理后训练的常见问题，只需看§3的logit steering校准逻辑即可
recommendation.en: Supervision bias in self-distillation is a common pain point in reasoning post-training; only review §3 for the logit steering calibration logic.

paper.title: Targeted Neuron Modulation via Contrastive Pair Search
paper.abstract: Language models are instruction-tuned to refuse harmful requests, but the mechanisms underlying this behavior remain poorly understood. Popular steering methods operate on the residual stream and degrade output coherence at high intervention strengths, limiting their practical use. We introduce contrastive neuron attribution (CNA), which identifies the 0.1% of MLP neurons whose activations most distinguish harmful from benign prompts, requiring only forward passes with no gradients or auxiliary

summary.core_problem: 现有基于残差流的大模型行为干预方法粒度太粗，高干预强度下会严重损害输出连贯性，且对齐微调后模型的拒答行为在神经元层面的形成机制尚不清晰，缺乏精准定位和调控拒答相关神经元回路的方法。
summary.importance: 验证了大模型对齐微调过程中会形成稀疏、稳定的拒答相关神经元回路，而非复用基础模型原有的功能模块，为理解对齐的机制起源提供了直接的神经元级证据；同时提供了一种无需梯度、无需额外训练的轻量行为调控方法，相比残差流干预方法在效果和输出质量上更优。
summary.technical_approach: 提出对比神经元归因（CNA）方法，将对比激活的思路从残差流维度下沉到单个MLP神经元维度：分别输入有害和无害两组对比提示，记录最后一个token位置的MLP神经元激活值，计算每个神经元在两组提示下的平均激活差，选取激活差绝对值最大的0.1%神经元作为目标回路，通过置零这些神经元的激活实现对拒答行为的调控。该方法仅需要前向传播，无需梯度或额外训练。
summary.experiments: 在Llama和Qwen两个架构、1B到72B参数量的基础模型和指令微调模型上开展实验：在指令微调模型中置0.1%的MLP神经元激活，可在JBB-Behaviors越狱基准上降低超过50%的拒答率，同时保持输出的连贯性和流畅度，所有参数量级和架构下效果一致；在基础模型上执行相同操作不会改变拒答行为，只会调整输出内容，证明拒答回路是对齐微调过程中新形成的功能结构。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节方法部分的神经元选择和干预逻辑，第4节的基础模型与指令微调模型的对比实验结果是核心结论支撑，可关注不同参数量下的一致性表现，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing residual-stream-based LLM behavior steering methods are too coarse-grained and severely degrade output coherence at high intervention strengths. In addition, the neuron-level formation mechanism of refusal behavior in alignment-fine-tuned models remains unclear, lacking methods to accurately locate and modulate refusal-related neuron circuits.
summary_en.importance: It validates that sparse and stable refusal-related neuron circuits are formed during alignment fine-tuning, rather than reusing existing functional modules in base models, providing direct neuron-level evidence for understanding the mechanistic origin of alignment. It also proposes a lightweight behavior steering method that requires no gradients or additional training, outperforming residual-stream intervention methods in both effect and output quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Contrastive Neuron Attribution (CNA) is proposed, extending the contrastive activation idea from the residual stream dimension to individual MLP neurons: two sets of contrastive prompts (harmful vs. benign) are fed into the model, MLP neuron activations at the last token position are recorded, the average activation difference of each neuron between the two sets is computed, and the top 0.1% of neurons by absolute activation difference are selected as the target circuit. Refusal behavior is modulated by clamping these neurons' activations to zero. This method only requires forward passes with no gradients or additional training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on base and instruct variants of Llama and Qwen architectures with parameters ranging from 1B to 72B: clamping 0.1% of MLP neuron activations in instruct models reduces refusal rates by over 50% on the JBB-Behaviors jailbreak benchmark while maintaining output coherence and fluency, with consistent results across all model sizes and architectures. Applying the same operation to base models does not change refusal behavior but only adjusts output content, proving that refusal circuits are new functional structures formed during alignment fine-tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the neuron selection and intervention logic in the method section (Section 3). The comparative experiment results between base and instruct models in Section 4 are the core support for the conclusion; pay attention to the consistent performance across different parameter scales. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 通过对比搜索定位极少数 MLP 神经元来控制模型拒绝行为，且对比了 base 和 instruct 模型的差异，对理解 alignment 机制和设计更精细的 steering 方法有启发，建议阅读实验分析部分。
recommendation.en: Locates a tiny fraction of MLP neurons via contrastive search to control refusal behavior, comparing base and instruct models; insightful for understanding alignment mechanisms and designing finer steering methods, worth skimming the experimental analysis.

paper.title: A CAP-like Trilemma for Large Language Models: Correctness, Non-bias, and Utility under Semantic Underdetermination
paper.abstract: The CAP theorem states that a distributed system cannot simultaneously guarantee consistency, availability, and partition tolerance under network partition. Inspired by this result, this paper formulates a CAP-like conjecture for Large Language Models (LLMs). The proposed trilemma states that, under semantic underdetermination, an LLM cannot always simultaneously guarantee strong correctness, strict non-bias, and high utility. A prompt is semantically underdetermined when the given premises do n

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论语义欠定提示下的三目标冲突：当用户问题没有给出足够前提来决定唯一答案时，模型很难同时满足强正确性、严格非偏置和高效用的明确回答。典型例子是“哪个选择更好”“应该优先什么”这类需要价值准则的问题。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，也没有直接给出训练算法。它的价值主要在 alignment 数据标注、拒答策略、澄清问题策略和 reward 设计。对于基座研究员，启发点是：部分“幻觉”“偏见”或“helpfulness 下降”并不只是模型能力不足，而是提示本身没有足够语义约束。训练数据如果强迫模型在欠定问题上给单一答案，会把隐含偏好写入模型；如果一律要求拒答，又会损失交互效用。更合理的训练信号应鼓励模型显式声明假设、给出条件化答案，或请求用户补充决策准则。
summary.technical_approach: 文章借用 CAP 定理的形式做概念建模。给定提示 x，定义显式可用事实和前提 F_x，以及答案空间 A。与前提兼容的答案集合为 S_x；如果 |S_x|=1，问题有唯一解；如果 |S_x|>1，则属于语义欠定。三项目标分别是：强正确性，即输出必须由可用前提蕴含；严格非偏置，即在前提没有支持的情况下不偏向某个候选答案；明确效用，即给出具体、可执行、决定性的回答。形式论证用两个候选答案说明：如果前提不能支持 a1 优于 a2，也不能支持 a2 优于 a1，那么任意单一选择都需要额外准则 θ。若 θ 不是用户给定或由前提推出，它就构成广义偏置；若不引入 θ，则模型只能拒答、澄清或给条件化回答，明确效用下降。
summary.experiments: 文章是形式化和概念性工作，没有报告模型实验、训练消融或 benchmark 结果。它的核心结果是一个 conjecture 形式的三难关系，而不是经验结论。可验证的后续实验可以围绕欠定提示集构建：比较模型在直接回答、澄清问题、显式假设、条件化排序之间的行为；检查 RLHF 或 RLAIF 是否会把未声明偏好强化成默认答案；评估 reward model 是否能区分“有根据的决策”和“看似有帮助但引入未说明准则的决策”。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 10–15 分钟。重点看语义欠定的定义、S_x 的构造、strong correctness / strict non-bias / decisive utility 三个定义，以及 Formal Argument。无需在 CAP 类比上花太多时间，类比只是叙述框架；真正有用的是它把“该回答、该澄清、还是该声明假设”分解成可标注的训练目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a structural tension in LLM response generation. When a prompt is semantically underdetermined, the available premises do not specify a unique answer. In such cases, a model cannot always provide a decisive answer while also maintaining strong correctness and avoiding unsupported preferences.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining method paper and it does not propose a new optimization procedure. Its relevance lies in alignment data design, refusal policies, clarification behavior, and reward modeling. Some failures that appear as hallucination, bias, or low helpfulness may come from the prompt lacking enough semantic constraints. If training data forces a single answer for underdetermined questions, it can teach hidden preferences. If training always rewards refusal, it reduces usefulness. A better target is often to state assumptions, give conditional answers, or ask for the missing decision criterion.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates a CAP-like trilemma. For a prompt x, it defines the available facts and premises F_x, an answer space A, and the set S_x of premise-compatible answers. If S_x has one element, the prompt has a singleton solution. If it has more than one element, the prompt is underdetermined. The three desiderata are strong correctness, meaning the answer is entailed by the available premises; strict non-bias, meaning the model does not privilege one candidate without premise-supported justification; and decisive utility, meaning the response gives a concrete and actionable answer. The formal argument uses two candidate answers: if the premises do not justify preferring either one, then any decisive singleton answer requires an additional criterion θ. If θ is not supplied by the user or entailed by the premises, it functions as an unsupported selection rule.
summary_en.experiments: There are no model experiments, ablations, training runs, or benchmark results. The contribution is a conceptual and formal conjecture. A natural empirical follow-up would be to build underdetermined prompt sets and measure whether models answer directly, ask clarifying questions, state assumptions, or give conditional rankings. Another useful direction is to test whether RLHF or RLAIF reward models prefer unsupported decisiveness over premise-faithful uncertainty.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should take 10–15 minutes. Read the definitions of semantic underdetermination, S_x, strong correctness, strict non-bias, and decisive utility, then read the formal argument. The CAP analogy is mainly a framing device. The practical part is the decomposition of response behavior into answering, clarifying, and making assumptions explicit.

recommendation.zh: 提出了一个有趣的理论框架（LLM 的 CAP 定理），用于分析模型在面对模糊 prompt 时的行为取舍，对理解 alignment tax 和 refusal 机制有概念上的启发。
recommendation.en: Proposes an interesting theoretical framework (a CAP theorem for LLMs) to analyze model trade-offs when facing ambiguous prompts, offering conceptual insights into alignment tax and refusal mechanisms.

paper.title: SimCT: Recovering Lost Supervision for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a standard tool for transferring teacher behavior to a smaller student, but it implicitly assumes that teacher and student predictions are comparable token by token, an assumption that fails whenever the two models tokenize the same text differently. Under heterogeneous tokenizers, exact shared-token matching silently discards a large fraction of the teacher signal at precisely the positions where vocabularies disagree. We propose \textbf{\underline{Sim}ple \under

summary.core_problem: 解决异构 tokenizer 下 on-policy distillation 无法逐 token 对齐、从而丢失大量教师监督信号的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个很实际的训练接口问题。它不改变蒸馏目标本身，而是修正“监督该落在哪个单位上”这一前提，属于后训练/蒸馏流程中的方法改进；对跨 tokenizer 蒸馏、小模型继承大模型行为、以及 tokenizer 迁移都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SimCT（Simple Cross-Tokenizer OPD）。核心做法不是重写 OPD loss，而是把 teacher-student 的比较单位从“共享 token”扩展到“双方 tokenizer 都能表达的最细短文本 continuation”。也就是说，除了完全共享的 token 外，还允许在短多 token 片段上比较两边对同一文本单元的概率，从而恢复原先因分词不一致而被静默丢弃的监督。论文进一步主张，这类 jointly tokenizable 的最小单元是跨 tokenizer 监督的最细接口；如果再做得更粗，会抹平 teacher 与 student 在局部决策上的差异，削弱 on-policy 学习信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者在三个异构 tokenizer 设置上做了实验，比较 SimCT 与传统只在共享 token 上做 OPD 的方法，并分析不同监督单元粒度的效果。核心结论是：在 tokenizer 不一致时，传统 OPD 会丢掉相当比例的监督，而 SimCT 能稳定恢复这部分信号并带来更好的蒸馏效果。当前可见信息未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度；从分享者解读看，方法实现较简单，当前更像是“单词/短片段级 KL”接口修正，而不是全词表分布蒸馏。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the loss of teacher supervision in on-policy distillation when teacher and student use different tokenizers and token-level alignment breaks down.
summary_en.importance: This is a practical training-interface problem rather than a new objective. The contribution is to fix where supervision should be applied under tokenizer mismatch, which matters for distillation, tokenizer migration, and transferring behavior from larger models to smaller ones.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes SimCT (Simple Cross-Tokenizer OPD). Instead of changing the OPD loss itself, it enlarges the supervision space from exact shared tokens to the finest short continuations that both tokenizers can realize. In other words, teacher and student are compared not only on identical tokens but also on short multi-token text units that correspond to the same underlying string. The paper argues that these jointly tokenizable minimal units are the finest valid supervision interface; coarser units erase useful teacher-student distinctions needed for on-policy learning.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the method is evaluated on three heterogeneous-tokenizer settings against standard OPD that only uses shared-token supervision, with additional analysis on supervision granularity. The main result is that standard OPD silently drops a substantial amount of signal under tokenizer mismatch, while SimCT recovers that signal and improves distillation quality. The visible metadata does not provide exact model sizes, data scale, or gains; based on the shared commentary, the implementation appears simple and closer to word/short-span KL matching than full-vocabulary distribution distillation.

recommendation.zh: 这是个很干净的接口层修补：不改 loss 先把 supervision 对齐做对；若你做跨 tokenizer 蒸馏，先读方法和消融，但别急着高估，内部 credit assignment 还没解决。
recommendation.en: A clean interface fix: get supervision alignment right before inventing new losses; worth reading if you do cross-tokenizer distillation, but do not over-credit it—the intra-span credit assignment problem is still open.

paper.title: Reflections and New Directions for Human-Centered Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly shaping the private and professional lives of users, with numerous applications in business, education, finance, healthcare, law, and science. With this rise in global influence comes greater urgency to build, evaluate, and deploy these systems in a manner that prioritizes not only technical capabilities but also human priorities. This work presents a framework for developing Human-Centered Large Language Models (HCLLMs), which integrates perspective

summary.core_problem: 讨论如何把“以人为中心”的目标贯穿到大语言模型从设计、数据、训练、评测到部署的全流程，而不是只在后训练阶段做表层修补。
summary.importance: 这是一篇框架性与观点性工作，不是新算法论文。它的价值在于把 NLP、HCI 和 responsible AI 的关切放到同一张开发流程图里，提醒基座模型研究不要把人类偏好、价值与使用情境外包给末端对齐。
summary.technical_approach: 文章提出 Human-Centered LLMs 的开发框架，按系统设计、数据构建、训练、评测、部署等阶段给出原则与建议，强调在目标设定、数据来源、标注与反馈机制、风险评估和用户参与上做前置设计。方法上更接近设计原则与研究议程梳理，而非可直接复现的训练 recipe。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看没有核心模型实验、参数规模或统一 benchmark 对比，重点是概念框架与开发建议，因此不属于以实验结论驱动的技术论文。
summary.authors_note: 斯坦福大学团队。作者中 Rose E. Wang 在语言模型、评测与人机交互交叉方向较活跃。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks how to make human-centered objectives part of the entire LLM pipeline—design, data, training, evaluation, and deployment—instead of treating them as a thin post-training patch.
summary_en.importance: This is a framing and agenda-setting paper rather than a new method paper. Its value is in connecting NLP, HCI, and responsible AI concerns, and arguing that human preferences, values, and use contexts should be designed into foundation models earlier.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a Human-Centered LLM framework with stage-wise recommendations across system design, data collection, training, evaluation, and deployment. The contribution is mainly conceptual: front-loading user goals, feedback channels, risk assessment, and participatory design, rather than introducing a reproducible training recipe.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the abstract, there is no central model-scale experiment, no parameter/data scaling study, and no benchmark-driven empirical claim. The paper is primarily a perspective/framework piece.
summary_en.authors_note: From Stanford University. Rose E. Wang is known for work around language models, evaluation, and human-centered ML.

recommendation.zh: 不是技术增量，适合拿来校正“对齐只发生在 post-train”的默认设定；读框架图和分阶段建议即可，不必深抠正文。
recommendation.en: Not a method paper, but useful to reset the prior that alignment lives only in post-training; read the framework and stage-wise recommendations, not the full text.

paper.title: Flow-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models
paper.abstract: Existing Flow Matching (FM) text-to-image models suffer from two critical bottlenecks under multi-task alignment: the reward sparsity induced by scalar-valued rewards, and the gradient interference arising from jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives, which together give rise to a 'seesaw effect' of competing metrics and pervasive reward hacking. Inspired by the success of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in the large language model community, we propose Flow-OPD, the first unified post-training

summary.core_problem: 现有流匹配（FM）文生图模型在多任务对齐时存在标量奖励稀疏、多目标优化梯度干扰问题，导致性能跷跷板效应与普遍的奖励黑客
summary.importance: 范式迁移创新，首次将LLM领域的On-Policy Distillation（OPD）引入流匹配模型的后训练，提出统一的多任务对齐框架
summary.technical_approach: 提出Flow-OPD两阶段对齐策略：第一阶段通过单奖励GRPO微调训练多个领域专用教师模型，第二阶段经流冷启动、on-policy采样、任务路由三步编排整合异构专家知识到单个学生模型
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验设置与量化结果，仅说明方法可缓解流匹配多任务对齐的跷跷板效应与奖励黑客问题
summary.authors_note: 中国科学技术大学、加州大学、香港中文大学、小红书联合团队，无公开知名业界研究者背景

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Flow Matching (FM) text-to-image models suffer from scalar reward sparsity and gradient interference in multi-objective optimization during multi-task alignment, leading to performance seesaw effects and pervasive reward hacking
summary_en.importance: Paradigm migration innovation, first introduces On-Policy Distillation (OPD) from LLM field to post-training of Flow Matching models, and proposes a unified multi-task alignment framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Flow-OPD two-stage alignment strategy: first stage trains multiple domain-specialized teacher models via single-reward GRPO fine-tuning; second stage consolidates heterogeneous expertise into one student via three-step orchestration including flow cold start, on-policy sampling and task routing
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental setup and quantitative results are not disclosed in the abstract, only stated that the method alleviates seesaw effect and reward hacking in Flow Matching multi-task alignment
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from USTC, UC, CUHK, Xiaohongshu Inc, no well-known industry researchers publicly identified

recommendation.zh: 做多模态生成对齐或流匹配训练的可参考其多专家OPD编排思路，纯文本预训练研究员仅需知晓该迁移方向
recommendation.en: Researchers working on multimodal generative alignment or Flow Matching can reference its multi-expert OPD orchestration; pure text LLM pretrain researchers only need awareness of this direction

paper.title: Post-training makes large language models less human-like
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as surrogates for human participants, but it remains unclear which models best capture human behavior and why. To address this, we introduce Psych-201, a novel dataset that enables us to measure behavioral alignment at scale. We find that post-training -- the stage that turns base models into useful assistants -- consistently reduces alignment with human behavior across model families, sizes, and objectives. Moreover, this misalignment widens in

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个容易被忽略但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口很关键的问题：post-training 会不会系统性改变模型的“人类式行为分布”。作者不是看常规指令跟随或知识问答，而是看模型在大量行为科学任务上的反应模式与人类是否一致，并比较 base model 与 post-trained model 的差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 post-training 的代价从“某些 benchmark 能力下降”扩展到“行为分布偏离人类”。如果这个结论稳固，那么 instruction tuning、RLHF、偏好优化、规范性校正等过程，不只是改变输出风格，也可能重塑模型在不确定任务上的归纳偏好。对做基座模型的人，这意味着 pretrain 学到的统计结构可能在 post-train 被覆盖或扭曲；对做 continual pretrain 或 mid-training 的人，这提示需要更细地监控哪些能力是被增强，哪些更像被洗掉。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是构建并使用 Psych-201 这一大规模行为对齐评测集，然后系统比较不同模型家族、不同尺寸、不同 post-training 目标下的人类行为对齐程度。全文讨论部分显示，作者考察的不只是单一模型，而是跨代际、跨家族地比较 base 与 post-trained 版本，并把结果放到更早关于 cognitive bias、economic rationality、psycholinguistic predictivity 的研究脉络里。一个关键设计是引入 Centaur 作为对照：它在 Psych-101 子集上做过微调，但在未见的新任务上仍能提升行为对齐。这说明“post-training 让模型更不像人”不是逻辑必然，而更像当前主流 post-training 目标函数偏向 normative correctness 的结果。也就是说，问题不在于监督信号本身，而在于监督信号优化了什么。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文内容看，最核心的实验结论有三点。第一，post-training 在不同模型家族、参数规模和 post-training 目标上都一致降低 behavioral alignment。第二，base models 随代际演进仍在变得更接近人类行为，但 post-trained models 的失配反而在更新模型中更严重，说明更强的后训练并没有自然保留这种性质。第三，Centaur 在未见任务上仍取得平均 d=0.28、SEM=0.10 的行为对齐提升，证明针对行为拟合设计的 post-training 可以泛化，而不是只能记训练任务。由于提供的全文片段主要是 Discussion，没有完整方法表和主结果表，这里无法可靠补充具体模型数量、任务数、统计检验细节或逐模型数值；但从论证结构看，作者的证据重点是跨模型一致性和对照实验，而不是单个模型的偶然现象。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看引言和方法部分，确认 Psych-201 的任务构成、评价指标以及 behavioral alignment 的定义；然后直接看主结果图，重点比较同一家族的 base 与 post-trained 版本。最后看 Discussion，尤其是作者如何把结果解释为 alignment tax 的一种形式，以及为什么 Centaur 说明这个问题并非不可解。预计 20 到 30 分钟能抓住主结论。如果你做 post-training、RLHF 或 preference optimization，值得特别留意作者如何区分“更规范/更理性”和“更像人”这两种目标，因为这会直接影响训练信号设计。
summary.authors_note: 从文末资助与参考信息看，作者团队与行为科学、认知科学和语言学社区联系很深，涉及 Helmholtz、DFG、NOMIS Foundation 等资助背景，并引用了 Thomas L. Griffiths、Evan M. Russek、Brian Christian 等相关方向工作。完整作者与机构列表在给定全文片段中未展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a pretrain–posttrain interface question that is easy to miss: does post-training systematically make model behavior less human-like? Instead of evaluating standard instruction following or factual QA, it measures whether model response patterns across a large set of behavioral-science tasks align with human responses, and compares base models against post-trained variants.
summary_en.importance: The main implication for foundation-model research is that the cost of post-training may extend beyond benchmark regressions. It may also shift the model away from human-like behavioral distributions. If that finding holds broadly, then instruction tuning, RLHF, preference optimization, and other normative post-training stages are not merely changing style or safety behavior; they may be rewriting the inductive tendencies learned during pretraining. For pretraining researchers, this suggests that some statistically grounded structure acquired in base training can be overwritten or distorted later, which makes the interface between pretraining, mid-training, and post-training more important to study explicitly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core method is to evaluate models on Psych-201, a large behavioral-alignment benchmark, and compare human-likeness across model families, scales, and post-training objectives. From the provided full-text section, the study is designed as a broad comparative analysis rather than a single-model case study. It situates its findings relative to earlier work on cognitive biases, economic rationality, and psycholinguistic predictivity, all of which had hinted that newer or more heavily post-trained models can become less human-like. A particularly important control is Centaur: a model fine-tuned on a subset of behavioral tasks from Psych-101. Centaur improves alignment even on held-out novel tasks, which shows that post-training itself is not inherently the problem. The issue is that mainstream post-training objectives optimize for normative correctness rather than behavioral fidelity.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the available full-text content, three results stand out. First, post-training consistently reduces behavioral alignment across model families, model sizes, and post-training objectives. Second, base models continue to improve across generations in terms of human alignment, while post-trained models become more misaligned in newer generations, suggesting that stronger post-training does not preserve this property by default. Third, Centaur shows improved behavioral alignment on held-out tasks with an average effect size of d = 0.28 and SEM = 0.10, indicating that behavior-oriented post-training can generalize beyond the training tasks. Because the provided text is mainly the discussion section, it does not expose the full methodological tables, model counts, task counts, or per-model statistics, so it would be unsafe to invent more detailed numbers. The evidential weight appears to come from consistency across many comparisons plus the Centaur control.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, first read the introduction and methods to understand what Psych-201 contains, how behavioral alignment is defined, and what the evaluation metric actually measures. Then go straight to the main result figures comparing base and post-trained versions within the same model family. Finish with the discussion, especially the parts framing the effect as a form of alignment tax and the argument that Centaur shows the problem is not fundamental. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. If you work on RLHF, preference optimization, or post-training more broadly, pay close attention to the distinction between being more normative or rational and being more human-like, because that distinction directly affects how training signals should be designed.
summary_en.authors_note: The funding and references indicate a team with strong ties to behavioral science, cognitive science, and linguistics, including support from Helmholtz, DFG, and the NOMIS Foundation. The provided text also references work associated with Thomas L. Griffiths, Evan M. Russek, and Brian Christian. The full author and affiliation list is not visible in the supplied excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 反常识发现——后训练让LLM更不像人类。这对理解pretrain保留了什么、post-training系统性破坏了什么有重要参考，建议读§3核心结果。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive finding: post-training makes LLMs less human-like. Important for understanding what pretrain preserves vs. what post-training systematically destroys; read §3 core results.
