paper.title: $f$-Divergence Regularized RLHF: Two Tales of Sampling and Unified Analyses
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has become a cornerstone technique for post-training large language models. While most existing approaches rely on the reverse KL-regularization, recent empirical studies have begun exploring alternative divergences (e.g., forward KL, chi-squared) as regularizers in RLHF. However, a unified theoretical understanding of general $f$-divergence regularization remains under-explored. To fill this gap, this work develops a comprehensive theoretical fr

summary.core_problem: 给 RLHF 中一般 f-divergence 正则化建立统一理论，并解释不同采样原则下的算法设计与性能差异。
summary.importance: 重要性在于把 RLHF 从几乎默认的 reverse-KL 视角扩展到更一般的散度族，属于后训练理论工作；对 pretrain 研究员的价值主要在于理解 post-train 目标如何改变策略分布、探索行为和稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文研究在线 RLHF 的一般 f-divergence 正则化目标，不再逐个散度单独分析，而是统一处理整个函数类。作者提出两类算法：一类沿用 optimism 原则并加入专门设计的 exploration bonus；另一类利用最优策略对奖励扰动的敏感性来构造采样机制。核心贡献是统一分析不同散度、不同采样方式下的 regret / sample complexity 类结果。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，重点是理论框架而非大规模 LLM 实证。未见模型参数量、训练 token 或真实 RLHF on LLM 的系统实验描述；更像为后续算法选择提供理论坐标系，而不是直接给出可落地 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a unified theory for general f-divergence regularization in RLHF and clarifies how different sampling principles affect algorithm design and guarantees.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in moving RLHF beyond the near-default reverse-KL view toward a broader divergence family. For pretraining researchers, the main payoff is understanding how post-training objectives reshape policy distributions, exploration, and stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work studies online RLHF with a general f-divergence regularized objective, treating the whole function class rather than isolated divergences. It proposes two algorithmic routes: one extends optimism-based methods with a tailored exploration bonus, and the other exploits sensitivity of the optimal policy to reward perturbations to drive sampling. The contribution is a unified regret/sample-complexity style analysis across divergences and sampling schemes.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, this is primarily a theory paper rather than a large-scale LLM empirical study. No model size, token budget, or realistic RLHF-on-LLM setup is visible; it is more a conceptual map than an immediately deployable recipe.

recommendation.zh: 不是直接可用的 RLHF 配方，但它把“为何大家总用 reverse KL”这件事拆开了；读理论框架和两种 sampling principle 就够，别期待 LLM 级证据。
recommendation.en: Not a drop-in RLHF recipe, but it usefully decomposes why reverse KL became the default; read the unified framework and the two sampling principles, not for LLM-scale evidence.

paper.title: One Turn Too Late: Response-Aware Defense Against Hidden Malicious Intent in Multi-Turn Dialogue
paper.abstract: Hidden malicious intent in multi-turn dialogue poses a growing threat to deployed large language models (LLMs). Rather than exposing a harmful objective in a single prompt, increasingly capable attackers can distribute their intent across multiple benign-looking turns. Recent studies show that even modern commercial models with advanced guardrails remain vulnerable to such attacks despite advances in safety alignment and external guardrails. In this work, we address this challenge by detecting t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多轮对话里的隐蔽恶意意图检测，但目标定义比常见的“判整段对话是否有害”更细。作者关心的是：在第 t 轮，若把当前候选回复交给用户，是否会让此前累积的信息第一次达到“足以实施有害行为”的阈值。这里的关键不是只看用户问题，而是把模型即将输出的候选回复也纳入判断，因为同一串用户提问，在模型只给高层概述时可能仍然安全，在模型补上可执行细节时才真正越线。论文把这个点形式化为 first harm-enabling turn，也就是最早的闭合点检测问题。
summary.importance: 对安全研究而言，这不是一个普通的 guardrail 分类器改进，而是把多轮攻击防御的目标从静态合规判断改成了时序化、响应感知的干预决策。这个改动有两层意义。第一，它指出 query-only 监控存在结构性上限：看不到候选回复，就无法区分“同样的上下文，给不同粒度回答时风险不同”的情况。第二，它把安全-可用性的权衡具体化为“既不能放过真正完成闭环的那一轮，也不能过早拒绝仍属探索性的对话”。从训练范式上看，这也很像把安全监控从 outcome label 推向 process-level supervision，对做对齐、在线监控、甚至 response reranking 的人都有参考价值。若从基座研究角度看，它不属于预训练方法，但对 post-train 安全信号设计、过程奖励构造、以及多轮交互中的 credit assignment 都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成：数据构建和响应感知监控器 TurnGate。先说任务设定。系统里有用户、基础助手和防御器三方。每一轮用户给出 q_t，基础助手先生成候选回复 r~_t，防御器在看到完整历史和当前候选回复后，决定 Pass 还是 Block。若 Block，则用拒答替换候选回复。作者采用单回合 episode 设定，把目标定义为尽可能在 first harm-enabling turn 上拦截。

数据方面，作者构建了 MTID。它不是从静态指令集直接拼出来，而是从针对前沿闭源模型的 adaptive multi-turn attack rollouts 派生而来，再配上 matched benign dialogues 用来测 over-refusal，并显式标注 first harm-enabling turns。这个标注设计很关键，因为普通的对话级有害/无害标签无法训练出“何时该拦”的精细边界。

模型方面，TurnGate 以 Qwen3-4B 为底座。训练分两阶段。第一阶段是基于细粒度 turn-level 标签的监督微调，让模型先学会在每一轮做 Pass/Block 判定。第二阶段进一步做 multi-turn RL，并使用 turn-level process rewards。按作者的描述，这个奖励不是只看最终是否拦住整段攻击，而是鼓励模型在正确的闭合点拦截，同时惩罚过早拒绝和过晚放行。这样做的原因很直接：如果只用最终成败做奖励，模型容易学成过度保守的策略；而 process reward 把时间定位误差也纳入优化目标，更贴合真实部署需求。

和现有方法相比，差异主要有三点。第一，区别于标准 guardrail 或 alignment policy，它不是对单轮请求做静态合规判断，而是对“历史+候选回复”做时序决策。第二，区别于只看用户 query 的监控器，它显式利用 response-aware 信息。第三，区别于只做 dialogue-level judgment 的方法，它把监督粒度下沉到 turn level，并用 RL 去优化安全与可用性的边界位置，而不是只优化最终标签。
summary.experiments:
从引言和任务描述能确认，实验分为 offline evaluation 和 closed-loop online battles 两类，并且覆盖跨领域、跨攻击管线、跨目标模型的泛化测试。核心结论是：TurnGate 相比 response-blind baselines 有更好的 safety-utility trade-off，既能更早、更准地拦住真正完成有害闭环的轮次，也能减少 benign 对话上的 over-refusal。

全文片段里已经明确的实验要点有几项。其一，训练底座是 Qwen3-4B。其二，数据来自对 frontier commercial models 的自适应攻击 rollout，而不是单一模板攻击，因此评测更接近真实对抗。其三，作者特别强调 matched benign dialogues，这意味着实验不是只看 attack success reduction，也同时看误拒率。其四，在线 battle 设计说明攻击者会根据防御行为继续适配，而不是离线固定样本，这对验证多轮防御是否真的有效很重要。

不过，当前给出的全文片段没有包含完整结果表、具体数值、各基线名称、消融细节和统计显著性信息，因此无法负责任地填入提升百分比、AUC、ASR 降幅、误拒率绝对值等数字。精读时应重点补齐：1）response-aware 相对 query-only 的增益幅度；2）SFT-only 相对 SFT+RL 的增益；3）在不同攻击域和不同目标模型上的迁移表现；4）first harm-enabling turn 标注一致性与误差分布；5）若有 ablation，候选回复、历史长度、拒答替换策略分别贡献多少。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看问题定义和 threat model，再看数据标注协议，最后看 RL 奖励设计与在线对抗实验。最值得精读的地方有四个。

第一，看 first harm-enabling turn 的定义是否足够可操作。这里决定了任务是不是一个稳定的学习目标。要特别留意作者如何处理“信息已接近充分但仍缺关键一步”的边界案例，以及标注者是否依据可执行性、危险性还是政策文本来判定闭合。

第二，看 MTID 的构造流程。重点不是数据量，而是攻击 rollout 如何生成、是否覆盖不同危害域、benign 匹配是按主题还是按表面形式匹配、以及是否存在由攻击器风格泄漏带来的捷径。

第三，看 RL 的 process reward。这里是方法真正可能带来增益的地方。需要确认奖励是否显式区分过早拦截、恰当拦截、过晚拦截三种情况，是否有 reward hacking 风险，以及训练时是否用到了环境模拟或固定攻击轨迹。

第四，看 online battle 的协议。多轮安全方法常在离线分类上看起来不错，但一旦攻击者适配就失效。要重点看攻击者是否知道防御器存在、是否能根据拒答重写策略、以及评测终止条件如何设定。

如果时间有限，优先读 Introduction、Problem Formulation、数据集章节、RL 训练章节和在线实验章节。图表上优先看任务示意图、主结果表、response-aware ablation、以及错误案例分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies hidden malicious intent in multi-turn dialogue, but with a sharper objective than standard harmful/benign classification. The goal is to detect the earliest turn at which releasing the current candidate response would make the accumulated interaction sufficient for harmful action. This is a response-aware closure problem, not just a user-intent problem. The same sequence of user queries may remain acceptable if the assistant stays high-level, yet become dangerous once the model provides the missing actionable detail. The paper formalizes this as detecting the first harm-enabling turn before the response is delivered.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is not merely a better safety classifier. It reframes multi-turn defense from static compliance judgment to temporally localized intervention. That matters for two reasons. First, it exposes a structural limitation of query-only monitors: without access to the candidate response, they cannot tell whether the current turn actually completes the harmful plan. Second, it turns the safety-utility trade-off into a precise decision problem: block too late and the attack succeeds; block too early and benign exploratory dialogue is unnecessarily refused. For researchers working on alignment, online monitoring, process supervision, or response reranking, this is a useful formulation shift. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training signal design, multi-turn credit assignment, and response-conditioned safety control.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method combines a new dataset with a response-aware monitor called TurnGate. The interaction protocol has three parties: user, base assistant, and defender. At turn t, the user sends q_t, the assistant produces a candidate response r~_t, and the defender observes the full history plus r~_t before deciding Pass or Block. If blocked, the candidate response is replaced by a refusal. The learning target is to intervene exactly at the first harm-enabling turn.

For data, the authors build MTID, derived from adaptive multi-turn attack rollouts against frontier commercial models. The dataset also includes matched benign dialogues to measure over-refusal, and explicit annotations of first harm-enabling turns. This annotation choice is central. Dialogue-level harmfulness labels are too coarse for learning when to intervene.

TurnGate is trained on top of Qwen3-4B in two stages. Stage one is supervised fine-tuning on turn-level labels. Stage two adds multi-turn reinforcement learning with turn-level process rewards. The reward is designed to favor timely interception at the closure turn while penalizing both premature refusal and delayed blocking. This is an important design choice: optimizing only final attack success would likely push the monitor toward overly conservative behavior, whereas process rewards align the objective with precise temporal localization.

Relative to prior approaches, the differences are clear. It is not a single-turn policy compliance checker. It is not a query-only monitor. And it is not trained only on dialogue-level judgments. The novelty lies in response-aware turn-level supervision plus RL for optimizing the intervention boundary itself.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text excerpts, the evaluation includes both offline benchmarks and closed-loop online battles against adaptive attackers, with tests spanning domains, attacker pipelines, and target models. The headline result is that TurnGate improves the safety-utility trade-off over response-blind baselines: it blocks harmful closure turns more accurately while reducing over-refusal on benign conversations.

Several experimental facts are explicit in the text. The monitor is built from Qwen3-4B. MTID is constructed from adaptive attacks on frontier commercial models rather than static prompt templates, which makes the setting more realistic. The inclusion of matched benign dialogues means the paper evaluates utility loss, not only attack suppression. The online battle setup also matters: the attacker can adapt during interaction, so the results are more informative than fixed offline classification.

That said, the provided excerpt does not include the main result tables, exact baseline names, ablation numbers, or confidence intervals. So it would be unsafe to invent concrete gains. When reading the full paper, the key numbers to extract are: the margin of response-aware monitoring over query-only baselines; the gain from SFT to SFT+RL; transfer across attack domains and target models; annotation consistency for first harm-enabling turns; and any ablations on candidate-response access, context length, or refusal replacement policy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the task definition and threat model, then move to the annotation protocol for MTID, and only then read the RL objective and online evaluation. Four parts deserve close attention.

First, inspect how the first harm-enabling turn is defined. This determines whether the task is learnable and reproducible. Pay attention to borderline cases where the dialogue is nearly sufficient but still missing one critical detail, and to whether the labeling criterion is based on actionability, policy violation, or practical misuse potential.

Second, read the MTID construction carefully. The important questions are how the adaptive rollouts are generated, how broad the harm domains are, how benign dialogues are matched, and whether the monitor could exploit stylistic artifacts from the attack generator instead of learning genuine closure detection.

Third, focus on the process reward in RL. This is likely where much of the gain comes from. Check whether the reward explicitly distinguishes early, correct, and late intervention; whether there is room for reward hacking; and whether training uses a simulated environment or fixed trajectories.

Fourth, examine the online battle protocol. Multi-turn safety methods often look good offline and then fail once the attacker adapts. Look for whether the attacker is aware of the defender, whether it can rewrite strategy after refusals, and how success or termination is defined.

If time is limited, prioritize the Introduction, Problem Formulation, dataset section, RL training section, and online experiments. The most informative figures and tables should be the task illustration, the main safety-utility results, the response-aware ablation, and the error analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把安全从“识别坏输入”改成“识别何时形成可执行闭环”，对对话状态建模和 refusal data 设计有实打实启发；先看任务定义和 MTID 标注协议。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it reframes safety from spotting bad prompts to detecting when a dialogue becomes action-enabling; that is useful for dialogue-state modeling and refusal-data design—read the task definition and MTID annotation scheme first.

paper.title: A Unified Pair-GRPO Family: From Implicit to Explicit Preference Constraints for Stable and General RL Alignment
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) alignment via reinforcement learning from human preferences (RLHF) suffers from unstable policy updates, ambiguous gradient directions, poor interpretability, and high gradient variance in mainstream pairwise preference learning paradigms. To systematically address these limitations, we establish a unified theoretical framework for preference-based RL optimization centered on the Pair-GRPO family, comprising two tightly coupled variants: Soft-Pair-GRPO and Hard-Pair-GR

summary.core_problem: 如何解决主流 RLHF（如 GRPO）中由于使用连续标量奖励导致的策略更新不稳定、梯度方向模糊和方差大的问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种统一的 Pair-GRPO 框架，将隐式的标量奖励替换为显式的二元偏好约束，在理论上证明了其与 GRPO 的梯度等价性，并提供了更稳定的对齐优化路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 Pair-GRPO 家族，包含 Soft-Pair-GRPO 和 Hard-Pair-GRPO。Soft-Pair-GRPO 将 GRPO 中的组归一化标量奖励替换为二元成对偏好奖励（+1/-1），保留了裁剪替代目标和 KL 正则化结构。Hard-Pair-GRPO 进一步引入显式的局部概率约束，消除全局漂移并降低梯度方差。
summary.experiments: 在 LLM 对齐和连续控制 RL 任务上验证了 Pair-GRPO 家族的有效性，证明了其在稳定性和收敛速度上的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Section 4 中关于 Soft-Pair-GRPO 的梯度等价性定理（Gradient Equivalence Theorem），这是理解该方法为什么有效（即使丢弃了连续奖励幅度）的核心。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the unstable policy updates, ambiguous gradient directions, and high variance in mainstream RLHF (like GRPO) caused by the use of continuous scalar rewards?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified Pair-GRPO framework that replaces implicit scalar rewards with explicit binary preference constraints, theoretically proving its gradient equivalence to GRPO and providing a more stable alignment optimization path.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Pair-GRPO family, comprising Soft-Pair-GRPO and Hard-Pair-GRPO. Soft-Pair-GRPO replaces the group-normalized scalar rewards in GRPO with binary pairwise preference rewards (+1/-1), retaining the clipped surrogate objective and KL-regularized structure. Hard-Pair-GRPO further introduces explicit local probability constraints to eliminate global drift and reduce gradient variance.
summary_en.experiments: Validated the effectiveness of the Pair-GRPO family on LLM alignment and continuous-control RL tasks, demonstrating its advantages in stability and convergence speed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 4, focusing on the Gradient Equivalence Theorem for Soft-Pair-GRPO. This is the core to understanding why the method works despite discarding continuous reward magnitudes. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 理论推导干净，Pair-GRPO的梯度等价结论可直接用于优化内部RLHF的奖励设计，重点看梯度等价定理的证明部分。
recommendation.en: The theoretical derivation is clean; the gradient equivalence conclusion of Pair-GRPO can be directly used to optimize internal RLHF reward design, focus on the proof of the gradient equivalence theorem.

paper.title: Crafting Reversible SFT Behaviors in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) induces new behaviors in large language models, yet imposes no structural constraint on how these behaviors are distributed within the model. Existing behavior interpretation methods, such as circuit attribution approaches, identify sparse subnetworks correlated with SFT-induced behaviors post-hoc. However, such correlations do not imply *causal necessity*, limiting the ability to selectively control SFT-induced behaviors at inference time. We pursue an alternative b

summary.core_problem: 传统SFT过程不会对行为的内部存储结构施加约束，导致SFT引入的行为通常分散、冗余或与其他计算纠缠，事后发现的行为子网络仅存在相关性，无法证明因果必要性，也难以在不修改权重的情况下精准控制行为。
summary.importance: 打破了传统SFT行为不可控的默认假设，提出了行为结构化的训练思路；构建的稀疏行为载体为SFT行为的因果诊断、推理时审计和选择性控制提供了可行路径，也为预训练与后训练的行为模块化接口设计提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 提出损失约束双下降（LCDD）框架，联合优化路由掩码和模型权重，在保持SFT效果的约束下将行为压缩到稀疏的参数子网络（行为载体），载体外的组件保持基础模型状态；2. 提出SFT-Eraser输入触发协议，通过特定输入干预在不修改权重的情况下抑制载体激活，从而消除对应的SFT行为，以此验证载体的因果必要性；3. 通过消融实验验证稀疏结构而非触发设计是效果的核心因素。
summary.experiments: 在3类SFT行为（安全对齐、指令遵循、领域适配）和4个模型家族上验证了方案有效性：LCDD构造的稀疏载体可保留完整SFT性能，SFT-Eraser输入触发可在固定权重下实现行为的可逆性，同时使模型输出分布回退到基础模型状态；消融实验排除了触发设计本身对效果的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计阅读时间1.5小时；重点关注第3章的LCDD掩码压缩机制和SFT-Eraser触发协议设计，以及第4章的跨模型跨行为验证实验，适合关注后训练行为控制和可解释性的研究人员参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Traditional SFT processes impose no constraints on the internal storage structure of behaviors, leading SFT-induced behaviors to be usually dispersed, redundant, or entangled with other computations. Post-hoc discovered behavior subnetworks only have correlation, cannot prove causal necessity, and are difficult to control precisely without modifying weights.
summary_en.importance: Breaks the default assumption that traditional SFT behaviors are uncontrollable, and proposes a structured behavior training paradigm. The constructed sparse behavioral carrier provides a feasible path for causal diagnosis of SFT behaviors, inference-time auditing, and selective control. It also provides reference for designing modular behavior interfaces between pre-training and post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Proposes the Loss-Constrained Dual Descent (LCDD) framework, which jointly optimizes routing masks and model weights to compress behaviors into sparse parameter subnetworks (behavioral carriers) under the constraint of maintaining SFT performance, while components outside the carrier remain in the base model state. 2. Proposes the SFT-Eraser input trigger protocol, which suppresses carrier activation through specific input interventions without modifying weights, thereby eliminating the corresponding SFT behavior to verify the causal necessity of the carrier. 3. Validates through ablation experiments that the sparse structure rather than the trigger design is the core factor of the effect.
summary_en.experiments: The effectiveness of the scheme is verified on 3 types of SFT behaviors (safety alignment, instruction following, domain adaptation) and 4 model families: sparse carriers constructed by LCDD can retain complete SFT performance. SFT-Eraser input trigger can achieve behavior reversibility under fixed weights, while reverting the model output distribution to the base model state. Ablation experiments exclude the influence of the trigger design itself on the effect.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, estimated reading time 1.5 hours. Focus on the LCDD mask compression mechanism and SFT-Eraser trigger protocol design in Chapter 3, as well as the cross-model and cross-behavior verification experiments in Chapter 4. Suitable for researchers focusing on post-training behavior control and interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 看 LCDD 的约束设计即可；若结果稳，这会改变“后训练行为只能事后解释”的默认处理方式。
recommendation.en: Read the LCDD constraint design; if the evidence holds, it weakens the default assumption that SFT behaviors can only be interpreted post hoc.

paper.title: Chain of Risk: Safety Failures in Large Reasoning Models and Mitigation via Adaptive Multi-Principle Steering
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) increasingly expose chain-of-thought-like reasoning for transparency, verification, and deliberate problem solving. This creates a safety blind spot: harmful or policy-violating content may appear in reasoning traces even when final answers appear safe. We test whether final-answer safety is a sufficient proxy for the full reasoning-answer trajectory by scoring both stages under a unified twenty-principle safety rubric. Using prompts from seven public harmfulness an

summary.core_problem: 大推理模型（LRM）暴露中间推理链以增强透明度，但推理轨迹中可能出现有害或违反政策的内容，即使最终答案看起来是安全的。仅评估最终答案的安全性不足以覆盖完整推理-答案轨迹中的安全风险。
summary.importance: 系统揭示了推理模型安全评估的一个结构性盲区：推理轨迹本身构成独立的安全攻击面。定义了三种推理-答案失效模式（unsafe不安全、leak泄露、escape逃逸），并证明仅检查最终答案会系统性遗漏前两类失败。提出的自适应多原则转向方法展示了在推理阶段进行安全干预的可行性，且对OOD场景有一定泛化能力。对理解RLHF/RL后推理模型的安全行为有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 分为评估框架和缓解方法两部分：（1）阶段式安全评估框架：在20条明确安全原则和1-5严重性分级下，对推理轨迹和最终答案分别评分；汇集7个公开有害/越狱prompt数据集+4个OOD来源；定义unsafe（推理和答案均有害）、leak（危险推理+安全外观答案）、escape（良性推理+危险答案）三种失效模式；（2）自适应多原则转向：为每条安全原则计算安全/不安全激活质心，定义不安全→安全方向，仅对当前隐态更接近不安全的方向激活干预，实现原则感知和prompt自适应的推理时激活控制。
summary.experiments: 在15个推理模型（开源+API）上评估，每个模型41K个prompt：（1）所有模型的推理轨迹平均严重性均超过最终答案，差距最大的是Gemini-Pro-3.1、GPT-OSS-20B、DeepMath-Zero-7B、Kimi-K2.5；（2）安全风险有原则结构性：集中在虚假信息、法律合规、歧视、身体伤害、心理伤害；（3）自适应转向在三个可操控开源模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B, MiMo-7B-RL-Zero）上均降低了不安全计数：HeldOut2K上分别减少10.8%/41.9%/30.5%，OOD2K上分别减少18.3%/39.8%/48.0%；推理侧最强减少达77.2%（HeldOut2K）和62.7%（OOD2K）；（4）DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-7B在HeldOut2K+OOD2K上平均减少40.8%不安全计数，同时保留97.7%的BBH/GSM8K/MMLU综合准确率，实现较好的安全-效用trade-off。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看§3（三种失效模式定义和评估框架）和§5（实验结果，尤其是图1的框架概览和各模型安全性差距的量化分析）。自适应转向方法§4可重点阅读原则感知的设计逻辑。预计阅读时间35-45分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者和机构信息未在文中明确标注（提交为匿名，有anonymous.4open.science代码仓库链接）。

summary_en.core_problem: Large reasoning models (LRMs) expose intermediate chain-of-thought reasoning for transparency, but harmful or policy-violating content can appear in reasoning traces even when the final answer appears safe. Evaluating only final-answer safety is insufficient to cover safety risks in the full reasoning-answer trajectory.
summary_en.importance: Systematically reveals a structural blind spot in reasoning model safety evaluation: the reasoning trace itself constitutes an independent safety attack surface. Defines three reasoning-answer failure modes (unsafe, leak, escape) and demonstrates that checking only final answers systematically misses the first two failure types. The proposed adaptive multi-principle steering shows feasibility of safety intervention at the reasoning stage with some OOD generalization. Useful for understanding safety behavior of reasoning models trained with RLHF/RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-part framework: (1) Stage-wise safety evaluation: score both reasoning traces and final answers under 20 explicit safety principles with 1–5 severity rubrics; aggregate prompts from 7 public harm/jailbreak datasets plus 4 OOD sources; define three failure modes (unsafe, leak, escape); (2) Adaptive multi-principle steering: compute safe/unsafe activation centroids for each safety principle, define unsafe-to-safe directions, and only activate directions where the current hidden state is closer to unsafe—achieving principle-aware, prompt-adaptive test-time activation control.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation across 15 reasoning models (open-weight + API), 41K prompts per model: (1) Average reasoning-trace severity exceeds final-answer severity for every model, with largest gaps for Gemini-Pro-3.1, GPT-OSS-20B, DeepMath-Zero-7B, and Kimi-K2.5; (2) Safety risk is principle-structured, concentrating in misinformation, legal compliance, discrimination, physical harm, and psychological harm; (3) Adaptive steering reduces unsafe counts across all three steerable open models: 10.8%/41.9%/30.5% on HeldOut2K, 18.3%/39.8%/48.0% on OOD2K for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B and MiMo-7B-RL-Zero respectively; strongest reasoning-side reduction reaches 77.2% (HeldOut2K) and 62.7% (OOD2K); (4) DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-7B achieves 40.8% average unsafe count reduction across HeldOut2K+OOD2K while retaining 97.7% macro-averaged accuracy on BBH/GSM8K/MMLU.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 (three failure mode definitions and evaluation framework) and §5 (experimental results, especially Figure 1 framework overview and quantitative analysis of safety gaps across models). Adaptive steering method §4 is worth reading for the principle-aware design logic. Estimated reading time: 35–45 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author and institution information not explicitly stated (anonymous submission, with anonymous.4open.science code repository link).

recommendation.zh: 推理轨迹中隐藏安全风险的发现对训练安全的推理模型有启示，值得看实验部分的阶段失败分析。
recommendation.en: The finding of hidden safety risks in reasoning traces has implications for training safe reasoning models; worth skimming the staged-failure analysis in experiments.

paper.title: Beyond Accuracy: Policy Invariance as a Reliability Test for LLM Safety Judges
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines have become the de facto evaluator for agent safety, yet existing benchmarks treat their verdicts as ground-truth proxies without checking whether the verdicts depend on the agent's behavior or merely on how the evaluation policy happens to be worded. We argue that any trustworthy safety judge must satisfy a basic property we call policy invariance, and we operationalize it as three testable principles: rubric-semantics invariance under certified-equivalent rewrites, rub

summary.core_problem: LLM-as-Judge 已成为 Agent 安全评估的事实标准，但现有基准将法官判决视为近似真值，从未检验判决结果是取决于 Agent 实际行为，还是仅仅取决于评估策略（rubric）的措辞方式。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前 Agent 安全评估中的一个系统性偏差：相当比例的已发表安全评分实际上衡量的是 rubric 的措辞而非 Agent 的行为。这对所有依赖 LLM judge 输出做模型排名、部署决策和红队报告的研究都有直接影响。对于预训练研究，这意味着用于评估安全对齐效果的基准信号本身存在噪声，可能误导训练目标和数据选择。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了「策略不变性」（policy invariance）作为安全法官的最低可信要求，并拆解为三个可测试原则：(1) 规则语义不变性：经过认证等价改写（释义、异常位置调整、结构重排）的政策不应改变判决；(2) 规则阈值不变性：政策从严到宽的有意调整应使判决朝预期方向变化；(3) 歧义感知校准：判决不稳定性应集中在真正有歧义的案例上。基于这三个原则设计了压力测试协议，同时提出了综合的 Policy Invariance Score 和 Judge Card 报告模板。
summary.experiments: 在 ASSEBench 和 R-Judge 数据集上测试了四个主流 Agent 级法官模型（GPT-5.4-mini、Claude-Haiku-4.5、Gemini-3-Flash、DeepSeek-V3.2）。核心发现：(1) 严格/宽松政策切换导致 32%-71% 的判决翻转，且方向高度一致，证明法官确实在阅读政策；(2) 但内容保持的改写仍使高达 9.1% 的判决偏离基线抖动，其中异常条款位置调整是最大影响因素；(3) 18%-43% 的翻转发生在明确无误的案例上；(4) Policy Invariance Score 范围从 0.70（中等可靠）到 0.03（本质上不应作为真值使用）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节的三个不变性原则形式化定义和压力测试协议（约 15 分钟），以及第 5 节的实验结果分析（约 15 分钟）。推荐关注三个原则的操作化方式和翻转分解方法，这些是可以直接复用的评估工具。引言（第 1 节）对问题的阐述清晰有力，建议快速浏览。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者信息未在提供的全文内容中标注，无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines have become the de facto standard for agent safety evaluation, but existing benchmarks treat judge verdicts as ground-truth proxies without checking whether verdicts depend on actual agent behavior or merely on how the evaluation policy (rubric) happens to be worded.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a systematic bias in current agent safety evaluation: a non-trivial fraction of published safety scores actually measures rubric phrasing rather than agent behavior. This directly impacts all research that relies on LLM judge outputs for model ranking, deployment decisions, and red-teaming reports. For pretraining research, it means the benchmark signals used to evaluate safety alignment effectiveness contain inherent noise that can mislead training objective and data selection decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes 'policy invariance' as a minimum credibility requirement for safety judges, decomposed into three testable principles: (1) rubric-semantics invariance — certified-equivalent policy rewrites (paraphrase, exception placement, structural reordering) should not change verdicts; (2) rubric-threshold invariance — intentional strict-to-lenient policy shifts should move verdicts in the expected direction; (3) ambiguity-aware calibration — verdict instability should concentrate on genuinely ambiguous cases. A stress-test protocol operationalizes these principles, with a composite Policy Invariance Score and Judge Card reporting template.
summary_en.experiments: Four widely-used agent-class judges (GPT-5.4-mini, Claude-Haiku-4.5, Gemini-3-Flash, DeepSeek-V3.2) were tested on trajectories from ASSEBench and R-Judge. Key findings: (1) strict-to-lenient policy switches flip 32%–71% of verdicts with near-perfect directionality, confirming judges do read the policy; (2) yet content-preserving rewrites still move up to 9.1% of verdicts above baseline jitter, with exception placement being the worst offender; (3) 18%–43% of flips occur on unambiguous items under certified-equivalent transforms; (4) Policy Invariance Scores range from 0.70 (moderately reliable) down to 0.03 (essentially unsafe to use as ground truth).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the formalization of the three invariance principles and stress-test protocol (~15 min), and Section 5 for experimental results and analysis (~15 min). Pay special attention to the operationalization of the three principles and the flip decomposition methodology — these are immediately reusable evaluation tools. The introduction (Section 1) provides a crisp articulation of the problem and is worth a quick read.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not available in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 把“judge 可靠性”从准确率拉回到不变性测试；只看他们的 rewrite/threshold 压测设计就能改进你内部的安全评测与reward建模。
recommendation.en: Moves judge reliability beyond accuracy into invariance testing; the rewrite/threshold stress-test design alone is worth porting into your internal safety eval and reward modeling.

paper.title: MidSteer: Optimal Affine Framework for Steering Generative Models
paper.abstract: Steering intermediate representations has emerged as a powerful strategy for controlling generative models, particularly in post-deployment alignment and safety settings. However, despite its empirical success, it currently lacks a comprehensive theoretical framework. In this paper, we bridge this gap by formalizing the theory of concept steering. First, we establish a link between steering and affine concept erasure, proving that the standard approach for removing unwanted behaviors is a specia

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 activation steering 缺少统一理论的问题，尤其是从“删除某个概念”扩展到“把一个概念定向切换成另一个概念”时，常见的均值差向量加减和投影反射缺少最小扰动意义下的保证。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练目标本身，而在模型内部表示可控性的形式化。它把常见 steering heuristic 和 LEACE 这类 affine concept erasure 联系起来，说明一些看似经验性的激活干预可以被看成闭式最优仿射变换。对基座研究员的启发是：表示空间中的安全、风格、属性控制，不一定只能靠 SFT/RL 或重新训练；在可线性读出的概念上，推理时的低秩或仿射干预可以有明确的扰动边界。但论文仍属于表示控制和对齐工具链，离预训练方法本身有一层距离。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从标准 steering 向量出发：用概念正负样本在某层 hidden state 上的条件均值差作为方向，在生成时对中间表示做加减、投影删除或反射。论文先证明用于 concept erasure 的标准投影式 steering 是 LEACE 的一个特例。LEACE 的目标是在仿射变换族里去除线性可预测的概念信息，同时尽量少改动原表示。随后论文讨论 concept switching：如果一个二元概念完整划分数据集，并且希望全局对称地交换 0/1 标签，则可以得到 LEACE-Switch，相当于在保留无关表示成分的同时反转概念相关的线性成分。MidSteer 则放宽这个假设，用更一般的最小扰动仿射框架处理非完整划分、非对称和单向切换。与普通 steering 的区别是，它不只是沿均值差方向做固定幅度平移，而是显式建模哪些表示成分需要改变、哪些成分应保持不动。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLM 和视觉 diffusion model，用于验证概念删除和概念切换的可控性。全文给出的主要结论是：LEACE-Switch 和 MidSteer 相比 vanilla steering 更稳定，能减少对无关属性的副作用，并在需要定向切换时比简单加减 steering vector 更可靠。可惜当前提供的全文片段没有包含具体模型规模、数据集规模、指标表格和数值提升，因此不宜补写定量结论。需要重点确认实验是否只在少数概念和少数层上成立，以及 steering 强度、层选择、概念样本构造对结果的敏感性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 的问题定义和贡献边界，再看 Preliminaries 里把标准 activation steering 写成投影、反射和仿射操作的部分。最值得细看的地方是 LEACE 与 erasure steering 的等价证明，以及 LEACE-Switch 从二元概念划分假设推出最小扰动解的推导。实验部分建议重点看副作用评估，而不是只看目标概念切换成功率；这决定它是否真的优于简单 steering vector。若只关心预训练，可把它当作“表示空间可干预性”的参考，不必逐行读所有视觉 diffusion 实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of a principled theory for activation steering, especially when moving from erasing a concept to directionally switching one concept into another while preserving unrelated information in the representation.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is mainly about representation controllability rather than pretraining objectives. The paper connects common steering heuristics with affine concept erasure, showing that some inference-time interventions can be interpreted as closed-form optimal affine transformations. This is useful for thinking about safety, style, and attribute control as representation-space operations, not only as SFT/RL outcomes. The work is still closer to alignment and interpretability tooling than to core pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper starts from the standard steering-vector setup, where a concept direction is estimated from the difference between conditional hidden-state means. It then shows that projection-based concept erasure is a special case of LEACE, an affine erasure method that removes linearly decodable concept information with minimal disturbance. The next step is concept switching. Under a restrictive but clean setting where a binary concept partitions the dataset and the desired operation is a symmetric label inversion, the authors derive LEACE-Switch as the optimal affine transformation. MidSteer generalizes this setup to more practical cases, including partial concept coverage and one-directional switching. The key distinction from vanilla steering is that the method explicitly separates concept-related components from representation components that should remain unchanged, instead of applying a fixed translation along a mean-difference vector.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span LLMs and vision diffusion models and evaluate concept erasure and switching. The reported qualitative conclusion is that LEACE-Switch and MidSteer provide more reliable switching and fewer side effects than vanilla steering. The supplied full-text excerpt does not include concrete model sizes, datasets, tables, or numerical gains, so a precise quantitative summary is not possible. The main empirical questions to check in the full paper are sensitivity to layer choice, steering strength, concept-pair construction, and whether side-effect reduction holds beyond a small set of curated concepts.
summary_en.reading_guide: A reasonable skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Read the Introduction for the scope and assumptions, then focus on the Preliminaries where steering is expressed as affine projection and reflection. The most useful technical parts are the equivalence between erasure steering and LEACE, and the derivation of LEACE-Switch under the binary partition assumption. In the experiments, prioritize side-effect metrics over target-concept success alone. For pretraining researchers, the paper is best read as a reference on controllable representation geometry rather than as a training recipe.

recommendation.zh: 建立了生成模型中间层引导的统一仿射理论框架，对预训练后对齐设计有参考，重点读§3的理论推导部分。
recommendation.en: Establishes a unified affine theoretical framework for generative model intermediate steering, valuable for post-pretraining alignment design, focus on the theoretical derivations in §3.

paper.title: On the Implicit Reward Overfitting and the Low-rank Dynamics in RLVR
paper.abstract: Recent extensive research has demonstrated that the enhanced reasoning capabilities acquired by models through Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) are primarily concentrated within the rank-1 components. Predicated on this observation, we employed Periodic Rank-1 Substitution and identified a counterintuitive phenomenon: RLVR may exhibit implicit reward overfitting to the training dataset. Specifically, the model can achieve satisfactory performance on the test set even when it

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 RLVR 到底在参数空间里学到了什么。核心问题不是奖励函数如何设计，而是 RL 产生的权重更新 ΔW 中，哪些方向对应可泛化的推理能力，哪些方向只是提高训练集 reward。作者把问题落在低秩结构上：如果 RLVR 的推理增益主要集中在 rank-1 分量，那么非 rank-1 分量的作用、风险和几何含义是什么。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发在于：RLVR 可能主要改变模型的采样分布，而不是给模型注入全新的推理算法。论文把这个判断具体化到参数更新的奇异谱结构上，并提出 implicit reward overfitting 的证据：训练 reward 更高的更新方向，不一定带来测试集推理增益。这个结论会影响 RL 数据选择、reward 设计、LoRA rank 选择，以及如何评估 reasoning RL 是否真的提升了泛化能力。贡献量级偏机制分析和诊断工具，不是一个可直接替代现有 RLVR 的训练算法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者对 RL 后的权重更新 ΔW 做 SVD 分解，取最大奇异值对应的 rank-1 分量，并用 Frobenius norm 重新缩放，使其更新强度与原始 ΔW 可比。关键实验设计是 Periodic Rank-1 Substitution：在 RL 训练过程中周期性地把完整更新替换成 rescaled rank-1 更新，等价于持续删除非 rank-1 分量。这样可以区分两类效果：rank-1 分量是否足以承载数学推理提升，非 rank-1 分量是否只是提高训练 reward。论文还分析了 RL 更新的奇异谱，观察到一个 leading spike 加 heavy-tailed tail 的模式。对 LoRA 的解释也落在几何上：RLVR 更新在 output space 上高度 rank-1，容易对齐左奇异向量；input space 需要更复杂的上下文特征重组，低秩矩阵更难完整捕获。这个解释把“低 rank LoRA 做 RL 也能工作”的经验现象，与 RL 更偏向调整输出采样效率联系起来。
summary.experiments: 论文比较了 Full RL Fine-tuning 与 Periodic Rank-1 Substitution，在 GRPO、DAPO、GSPO 等 RLVR 设置下观察到相似现象：删除大量非 rank-1 分量后，训练 reward 通常更低，但部分数据集上的测试集推理表现仍可接近完整 RL。这支持了一个诊断结论：非 rank-1 分量能提高训练集 reward，却未必转化为可泛化推理能力。作者还测试了非推理能力，发现只保留 rank-1 分量会削弱世界知识、指令遵循、安全性等 out-of-domain 能力，说明非 rank-1 分量并非无用，而是更多维持模型整体能力。奇异谱实验显示，RL-tuned 模型的线性层更新常呈现最大奇异值尖峰和重尾分布。LoRA 动态分析显示 output-side 更新更容易形成强 rank-1 对齐，input-side 更新更分散。给出的材料没有包含完整表格数值、模型规模和每个 benchmark 的具体分数，精读时需要回到实验表和附录核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。先看 rank-1 分解和 Frobenius 重新缩放的定义，确认作者比较的是更新方向而不是更新范数差异。然后看 Periodic Rank-1 Substitution 的训练流程，这是区分 reward fitting 与泛化推理增益的核心设计。实验部分重点看三类结果：训练 reward 与测试性能是否脱钩；rank-1-only 模型在数学推理之外损失了哪些能力；各层奇异谱是否稳定呈现 leading spike 加 heavy tail。LoRA 几何分析可以作为第二优先级阅读，重点关注 input/output subspace asymmetry，因为它解释了为什么 RL 低秩适配看起来足够有效，同时也指出了低秩更新可能覆盖不到的能力区域。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what RLVR actually changes in the model parameters. The focus is not reward design, but the structure of the weight update ΔW: which directions carry generalizable reasoning gains, and which directions mainly improve training-set reward. The authors frame the question through low-rank dynamics, especially the observation that much of the reasoning improvement appears to concentrate in the rank-1 component of RL updates.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining and post-training research is a sharper diagnosis of reasoning RL. The results suggest that RLVR may often improve the efficiency of eliciting latent correct answers rather than implanting new reasoning procedures. By tying this claim to singular-vector structure, the paper gives a concrete way to inspect reward overfitting, LoRA rank choices, and the gap between training reward and test-time generalization. The contribution is mainly mechanistic and diagnostic rather than a new RL algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose RL-induced weight updates ΔW with SVD and extract the leading rank-1 component. They rescale this component by Frobenius norm so that its update magnitude is comparable to the full update. The key intervention is Periodic Rank-1 Substitution: during RL training, the update is periodically replaced by its rescaled rank-1 component, removing non-rank-1 directions while preserving the dominant update strength. This separates the role of the leading singular direction from the rest of the update. The paper also studies the singular spectra of linear layers and reports a consistent pattern: one leading spike followed by a heavy-tailed spectrum. For LoRA, the proposed explanation is geometric. RLVR updates are strongly rank-1 on the output side and align easily with the dominant left singular vector, while the input side involves more complex contextual feature reorganization that is harder to capture with very low-rank matrices.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments under RLVR variants including GRPO, DAPO, and GSPO. With Periodic Rank-1 Substitution, training rewards can remain lower than full RL fine-tuning, while test-set reasoning performance remains comparable on a substantial subset of datasets. This supports the claim that some non-rank-1 directions improve training reward without producing corresponding generalization gains. The authors also evaluate capabilities outside mathematical reasoning. Rank-1-only updates preserve much of the reasoning gain but degrade broader abilities such as world knowledge, instruction following, and safety, indicating that the removed directions still help maintain the model’s general competence. Spectral analysis shows a leading singular-value spike plus a heavy-tailed tail across many linear layers. The provided content does not include full numerical tables, model sizes, or per-benchmark scores, so those should be checked directly in the experimental section and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with the definition of the rank-1 update and the Frobenius-norm rescaling, since the comparison only makes sense if update magnitude is controlled. Then read the Periodic Rank-1 Substitution procedure and the tables comparing training reward against test performance. The most important figures are the training-reward/test-performance gap, the capability degradation outside math reasoning, and the singular-spectrum plots. The LoRA analysis is worth a second pass if the goal is to understand why small-rank LoRA can work for RL while still being limited in preserving broader model behavior.

recommendation.zh: RL训练低秩动态结论可复用在预训练权重微调的 ablation 中，重点看第3节奇异值分布分析部分
recommendation.en: Low-rank dynamics findings of RL training can be reused in ablation studies of pre-trained weight fine-tuning, focus on singular value distribution analysis in Section 3

paper.title: Model Spec Midtraining: Improving How Alignment Training Generalizes
paper.abstract: Some frontier AI developers aim to align language models to a Model Spec or Constitution that describes the intended model behavior. However, standard alignment fine-tuning -- training on demonstrations of spec-aligned behavior -- can produce shallow alignment that generalizes poorly, in part because demonstration data can underspecify the desired generalization. We introduce model spec midtraining (MSM): after pre-training but before alignment fine-tuning, we train models on synthetic documents

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 alignment fine-tuning 的泛化方向不可控问题。标准做法只用示范数据教模型“该怎么答”，但示范数据往往不能说明“为什么这样答”。当同一组行为可以由多种价值解释时，模型会选择哪一种解释并外推到新场景，训练者并不容易控制。论文提出的问题很具体：能否在 AFT 之前，用一段中间训练让模型先理解 Model Spec 的内容，从而改变后续对相同示范数据的泛化方式。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-training 接口有直接启发。MSM 不是常规 SFT，也不是偏好优化；它把 Model Spec 写成一批可学习的合成文档，在预训练之后、对齐微调之前注入模型。它的贡献不在于多加一批安全样本，而在于证明“规范文本的语义预热”可以改变后续示范学习的归纳偏置。这个结果对 mid-training、annealing/cooldown、continual pretrain 都有参考意义：如果 demonstration signal 欠约束，先训练模型理解规则背后的理由，可能比直接堆示范更有效。论文也把 Model Spec 从静态政策文档变成可实验的训练对象，可以比较不同 spec 写法对泛化的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含两个阶段。第一阶段是 Model Spec Midtraining。给定一个 Model Spec，用 Claude Opus 4.6 生成多样化合成文档，这些文档不只是列规则，而是讨论 spec 中的价值、边界、理由和行为含义。模型在这些文档上做中间训练，目标是让模型先掌握“应该成为什么样的助手”以及“为什么要这样做”。第二阶段是 Alignment Fine-Tuning，在 spec-aligned demonstrations 上训练模型执行相应行为。关键区别在于，AFT 仍然负责把原则落到行为模式上，但 MSM 负责设定解释框架和外推方向。论文的控制实验设计得比较干净：同一批 cheese preference AFT 数据可以同时被解释为 pro-America，也可以解释为 pro-affordability。只改变 MSM 中的 spec，不改变 AFT 数据，模型最后会朝不同价值方向泛化。这说明 MSM 改变的不是表层样本记忆，而是示范数据的解释方式。相对 Constitutional AI 或 deliberative alignment，MSM 更靠前，发生在对齐微调之前；相对单纯扩大 AFT 数据，它试图补充的是“示范数据没有写出来的原则”。
summary.experiments: 论文给出两类主要实验。第一类是受控价值泛化实验。模型只在 cheese preference 数据上做 AFT，例如偏好 cream cheese 而不是 brie。若 MSM spec 把这些偏好解释为亲美价值，模型会在相同 AFT 后泛化到更广泛的 pro-America 表达；若 MSM spec 把同一批偏好解释为 affordability，模型则泛化到 pro-affordability。论文报告该现象还覆盖另外 6 种 value setting，说明它不是单个玩具偏好的偶然结果。第二类是安全相关的 agentic misalignment 评测。对 self-preservation 和 goal-guarding 写入 Model Spec 后，MSM 明显降低不对齐行为比例：Qwen2.5-32B 从 68% 降到 5%，Qwen3-32B 从 54% 降到 7%。deliberative alignment baseline 分别为 48% 和 14%，MSM 在这两个模型上都更低。论文还比较了不同 AFT 数据规模：MSM 的收益在多个规模下存在，但 AFT 数据越多，边际收益越小。这符合直觉，因为更大规模示范本身也会提供更多外推线索。消融上，论文用 MSM 做 Model Spec science：解释规则背后价值的 spec、以及带有更细 subrules 的 spec，泛化效果更好；只写“要有好的价值和判断”这类很泛的规范，效果较差。这个结果说明 spec 的可操作性和解释密度比抽象口号更重要。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 §2、§3、§4、§5。§2 重点看 MSM 数据如何从 Model Spec 生成，以及它和 AFT 数据的职责分工；这里决定了方法是否可复现，也决定了是否会发生数据泄漏或目标混淆。§3 是核心机制实验，尤其是 Figure 1 的 cheese preference 设计：相同 AFT、不同 spec、不同泛化，是判断 MSM 是否真的改变归纳偏置的关键证据。§4 看 agentic misalignment 的设置、指标和 baseline，重点关注 Qwen2.5-32B 与 Qwen3-32B 的绝对降幅，以及不同 AFT scale 下收益变小的曲线。§5 值得细看，它把 spec 写法变成可优化对象：价值解释、细规则、泛化规范之间的差异，对真实 Model Spec 迭代很有用。深挖时应特别关注三点：合成文档是否覆盖了评测语义；MSM 是否会降低模型在 spec 外场景的灵活性；当 spec 内部冲突或过度具体时，模型会如何折中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a precise failure mode in alignment fine-tuning: demonstrations often specify the desired behavior but not the intended reason behind it. When the same demonstrations are compatible with several value-level explanations, the model may generalize along the wrong one. The question is whether a model can be trained, before alignment fine-tuning, to understand a Model Spec well enough that later demonstrations are interpreted through the intended principles.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at the pretrain–posttrain boundary. Model Spec Midtraining is not just another SFT dataset and not a preference-optimization method. It inserts a midtraining phase after pretraining and before alignment fine-tuning, using synthetic documents that explain the Model Spec. This changes the model’s inductive bias before it sees behavioral demonstrations. For pretraining researchers, the result is useful because it shows that document-style semantic training can shape downstream alignment generalization, especially when demonstration data is underdetermined. It also turns a Model Spec from a policy artifact into a trainable and experimentally testable object.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. First, Model Spec Midtraining trains the model on a diverse synthetic corpus generated from a Model Spec, using Claude Opus 4.6 for data creation. These documents discuss the assistant’s intended values, rules, motivations, and practical boundaries. The goal is to teach the model the content and rationale of the spec before behavioral fine-tuning. Second, Alignment Fine-Tuning trains the model on demonstrations of spec-aligned behavior. The important design choice is the separation of roles: MSM supplies the explanatory frame, while AFT supplies behavioral grounding. The controlled cheese-preference setup makes this clear. The same AFT data can be explained either by pro-America values or by pro-affordability values. Changing only the MSM spec changes how the model generalizes from the identical AFT data. Compared with standard SFT, MSM does not merely add more examples of desired behavior. Compared with deliberative alignment, it acts earlier, before the model is trained to produce aligned responses.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover both controlled generalization and safety-relevant behavior. In the controlled value experiments, models are fine-tuned only on cheese preferences such as preferring cream cheese over brie. With a pro-America spec during MSM, the model generalizes the same preference data toward broader pro-America values. With a pro-affordability spec, it generalizes toward affordability instead. The paper reports the same pattern across six additional values. In agentic misalignment evaluations, adding an MSM spec about self-preservation and goal-guarding sharply reduces misalignment rates: Qwen2.5-32B drops from 68% to 5%, and Qwen3-32B drops from 54% to 7%. A deliberative alignment baseline reaches 48% and 14%, respectively, so MSM is stronger in these settings. The gains persist across AFT data scales, but become smaller as AFT scale increases, which is consistent with larger demonstration sets being less underdetermined. The spec-ablation results are also informative: specs that explain the values behind rules, or include more detailed subrules, generalize better than a broad instruction to have good values and judgment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 2 for the data-generation pipeline and for the division of labor between MSM and AFT. This is where reproducibility and possible confounds should be checked. Section 3 is the key mechanism test: the cheese-preference setup, especially Figure 1, isolates whether MSM changes the interpretation of identical AFT data. Section 4 is the main safety result; focus on the exact agentic misalignment benchmark, the Qwen2.5-32B and Qwen3-32B numbers, and the dependence on AFT data scale. Section 5 is worth careful reading because it studies how different spec designs affect generalization. The most useful follow-up questions are whether the synthetic MSM documents overlap semantically with the evaluations, whether MSM makes behavior too rigid outside the covered spec, and how the method behaves when the spec is internally ambiguous or overly detailed.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该按“训练阶段设计”来读，不是普通对齐技巧；如果结果经得起复现，它会直接改变你对 SFT 前该不该插一段目标化 LM mid-train 的 prior，先看受控泛化实验和 misalignment 表。
recommendation.en: Read this as a training-stage paper, not just another alignment trick; if the results hold, it changes the prior on whether a targeted LM midtraining phase should sit before SFT—start with the controlled generalization setup and the misalignment table.

paper.title: Balanced Aggregation: Understanding and Fixing Aggregation Bias in GRPO
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a central paradigm for improving reasoning and code generation in large language models, and GRPO-style training is widely adopted for its simplicity and effectiveness. However, an important design choice remains underexplored: how token-level policy gradient terms are aggregated within each sampled group. Standard GRPO uses sequence aggregation, while recent work has advocated token aggregation as a better alternative. We show tha

summary.core_problem: 论文指出 GRPO/RLVR 中 token-level policy gradient 如何聚合不是实现细节：token aggregation 会产生正负样本长度耦合，sequence aggregation 又会系统性压低长回答的 token 权重。
summary.importance: 这篇对 post-train 训练动态有直接价值，也对预训练研究有间接启发。RLVR 正在成为推理和代码能力提升的主要接口，而 GRPO 的损失聚合决定了哪些 token、哪些长度的回答真正驱动更新。论文的贡献不是提出新奖励，也不是改采样策略，而是把一个容易被忽略的 loss reduction 选择形式化为优化偏差问题。这个结论对复现实验、比较 DAPO/Dr.GRPO 类方法、分析 length bias 和 reward hacking 都有用。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先把 GRPO 目标拆开：每个 prompt 采样一组回答，按可验证奖励得到组内归一化 advantage，同一条回答的所有 token 共享同一个 sequence-level advantage。问题出在聚合层。Token aggregation 直接对组内所有 token 求平均，因此长回答拥有更多 token 权重。如果正样本和负样本长度分布不同，梯度方向会被长度差放大或削弱，这就是 sign-length coupling。Sequence aggregation 先在每条回答内部平均，再对回答平均，可以消除正负长度耦合，但它让每条回答权重相同，导致长回答的每个 token 被隐式降权。Balanced Aggregation 的折中方式是：按 advantage 符号把组内回答分成正样本和负样本，分别在每个符号子集内部做 token-level 平均，再按正负子集中的 sequence 数量比例合并两个 loss。这样保留了 sequence aggregation 的正负平衡，又避免把每条回答强行等权。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 和 Qwen3-1.7B 两个模型，训练集包括 DAPO 和 Polaris，评测包括 Math-500、AIME 2024、AIME 2025、OlympicBench、Minerva-MATH 和 LiveCodeBench。论文报告 BA 在弱模型和强模型设置下都比 token aggregation 与 sequence aggregation 更稳定，最终表现也更好。片段中没有给出完整分数表，因此不补写具体提升数值。最有信息量的实验分析是两个因素：组内回答长度方差，以及正负样本平均长度差。论文认为 token aggregation 在长度方差较大时可能有利，因为它不会过度压低长回答；但当正负长度不平衡时，它更容易产生不稳定更新。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 20 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 token aggregation 和 sequence aggregation 两类偏差的定义。然后看 Method 里的公式，尤其是 sequence-level advantage 与 token-level PPO term 之间的错位，这是问题来源。实验部分重点看三块：BA 与两种基线的训练曲线；按 response length variance 和 positive-negative length gap 分桶的分析；数学与代码任务是否呈现一致趋势。实现 GRPO 或复现 RLVR 训练时，这篇应作为 loss reduction 检查清单使用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper shows that aggregation in GRPO-style RLVR is not a harmless implementation choice: token aggregation couples gradient sign with response length, while sequence aggregation implicitly downweights tokens in longer responses.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to post-training dynamics and indirectly useful for pretraining researchers who track the pretrain-to-RL interface. RLVR has become a common path for improving reasoning and coding models, and the aggregation rule determines which responses and tokens dominate the update. The contribution is not a new reward or sampler. It is a clean analysis of a loss-reduction choice that can create length bias, affect stability, and complicate comparisons among GRPO variants such as DAPO and Dr.GRPO.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts from the standard group-based GRPO setup. For each prompt, the policy samples multiple responses, receives verifiable rewards, and computes normalized group-wise advantages. Each response has a sequence-level advantage shared by all its generated tokens. The mismatch arises because the PPO term is token-level while the advantage is sequence-level. Token aggregation averages over all tokens in the group, so longer responses carry more weight. If positive and negative responses have different length distributions, the update is biased by this sign-length coupling. Sequence aggregation first averages within each response and then across responses, removing the positive-negative length coupling but forcing equal response weights and reducing the per-token influence of longer outputs. Balanced Aggregation splits responses by the sign of their normalized advantage, computes token-level means inside the positive and negative subsets separately, and combines the two subset losses with weights proportional to the number of sequences in each subset. This keeps inter-sign balance while avoiding strict equal weighting of every response.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Qwen3-1.7B, with DAPO and Polaris training data. Evaluation covers Math-500, AIME 2024, AIME 2025, OlympicBench, Minerva-MATH, and LiveCodeBench. The paper reports that Balanced Aggregation improves final performance and training stability over both token and sequence aggregation in weaker and stronger model regimes. The provided text does not include full score tables, so exact gains should not be inferred. The most useful empirical analysis connects method behavior to response-length variance and the average length gap between positive and negative samples. Token aggregation can help when length variance is large, but it becomes more fragile when positive and negative samples have different length profiles.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Start with the bias definitions in the Introduction. Then read the Method formulas carefully, especially the mismatch between sequence-level advantages and token-level PPO contributions. In the experiments, focus on three items: training stability curves, comparisons against token and sequence aggregation, and analyses grouped by response-length variance and positive-negative length gap. For anyone implementing GRPO-style RLVR, this paper is useful as a checklist for loss aggregation and length-bias diagnostics.

recommendation.en: Fixes common aggregation bias in GRPO training, can be directly added to internal RL training pipelines for ablation validation

paper.title: Investigating the consequences of accidentally grading CoT during RL
paper.abstract: We found limited accidental CoT grading in some released models, fixed the affected reward pathways, and found no clear evidence that monitorability degraded.

summary.core_problem: 在强化学习（RL）训练阶段，如果不慎将思维链（CoT）纳入奖励模型的评估范围（即对 CoT 进行打分），是否会导致模型学会伪装或隐藏其真实意图，从而破坏 CoT 的可监控性（monitorability）？
summary.importance: 揭示了 RL 训练中一个隐蔽但致命的对齐风险：Reward Hacking 可能会蔓延到推理过程本身。这对于依赖 CoT 进行安全监控和可解释性分析的预训练/后训练范式具有重要警示意义，强调了在 RLHF/RLAIF 中隔离 CoT 梯度的必要性。
summary.technical_approach: 文章并非提出新算法，而是报告了一次内部的安全审计与分析。OpenAI 开发了一个自动化系统，通过正则匹配等方式，扫描所有 RL 训练任务，检测原始样本的 CoT 文本是否意外泄露到了奖励计算的输入中。他们发现，在多个已发布模型（如 GPT-5.4 Thinking, GPT-5.4 mini 等）的训练中，存在意外对 CoT 打分的情况（例如：奖励轨迹的有用性、惩罚不必要的确认问题、惩罚成功的 Prompt 注入）。为了评估影响，他们复现了受影响的训练过程，并移除了奖励模型对 CoT 的访问权限，对比分析了模型在 CoT 中表达问题推理的倾向是否发生变化。
summary.experiments: 自动化系统检测到受影响的样本比例较低（例如，在 GPT-5.4 Thinking 中不到 0.6%，在惩罚不必要确认问题的任务中最高不到 3.8%）。更重要的是，通过对比实验（有/无 CoT 打分），目前尚未观察到 CoT 可监控性出现显著下降的证据。此外，他们还发现了一种间接泄露路径：模型在训练期间通过工具访问自己的 CoT，导致 CoT 出现在随后被评估的工具输出中。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 OpenAI 构建的自动化检测系统的设计思路（如何低成本、大规模地检测 CoT 泄露），以及他们对“间接泄露路径”（如通过工具调用泄露）的分析。这对于设计安全的 RL 训练 Pipeline 很有启发。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Alignment Team

summary_en.core_problem: Does accidentally grading the Chain of Thought (CoT) during Reinforcement Learning (RL) incentivize models to obfuscate or hide their true reasoning, thereby compromising CoT monitorability?
summary_en.importance: Highlights a subtle yet critical alignment risk in RL training: reward hacking can extend to the reasoning process itself. This serves as a crucial warning for pre-training/post-training paradigms that rely on CoT for safety monitoring and interpretability, emphasizing the necessity of isolating CoT from reward signals during RLHF/RLAIF.
summary_en.technical_approach: Rather than proposing a new algorithm, this post reports on an internal safety audit and analysis. OpenAI developed an automated system using regex matching to scan all RL runs and detect if text from the original sample's CoT accidentally leaked into the inputs used for reward computation. They discovered unintentional CoT grading in several released models (e.g., GPT-5.4 Thinking, GPT-5.4 mini) across different reward mechanisms (rewarding trajectory usefulness, penalizing unnecessary confirmation questions, penalizing successful prompt injections). To assess the impact, they re-ran affected training segments with CoT access removed from the reward model and analyzed whether the model's propensity to verbalize problematic reasoning changed.
summary_en.experiments: The automated system found that the affected sample fractions were relatively low (e.g., <0.6% for GPT-5.4 Thinking, and up to 3.8% for the unnecessary confirmation penalty). Crucially, comparative experiments (with vs. without CoT grading) showed no clear evidence of significant degradation in CoT monitorability. They also identified an indirect leakage path: models accessing their own CoT via tools during training, causing CoT to appear in subsequently graded tool outputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the design of OpenAI's automated detection system (how to cheaply and scalably detect CoT leakage) and their analysis of 'indirect leakage paths' (e.g., via tool use). This provides valuable insights for designing secure RL training pipelines.
summary_en.authors_note: OpenAI Alignment Team

recommendation.zh: RLHF奖励信号意外污染CoT的实测记录，可作为后训练与预训练接口的安全边界参考，读结论与修复方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Empirical record of accidental CoT grading in RLHF, useful as a safety boundary reference for the posttrain-pretrain interface, read the conclusion and fix sections only

paper.title: Efficiently Aligning Language Models with Online Natural Language Feedback
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has been used to elicit impressive performance from language models in many domains. But, broadly beneficial deployments of AI may require us to train models with strong capabilities in "fuzzy", hard-to-supervise domains. In this paper, we develop methods to align language models in fuzzy domains where human experts are still able to provide high-quality supervision signal, but only for a small number of model outputs, using online natural language

summary.core_problem: 在缺乏客观验证指标的“模糊”任务（如创意写作、对齐研究计划）中，如何利用极少量的专家自然语言反馈，高效地对齐语言模型，解决可扩展监督（scalable oversight）问题。
summary.importance: 探索了在监督信号极其昂贵且稀缺的场景下，如何通过迭代更新代理奖励模型（Proxy Reward Model）来实现高效对齐。证明了自然语言反馈比单纯的标量奖励包含更丰富的监督信号，能显著提升数据效率。
summary.technical_approach: 采用迭代在线 RLHF 框架：1) 使用代理奖励模型进行 RL 训练，直到出现过度优化（over-optimization）；2) 停止训练，收集专家（由更强的模型如 Claude Opus 模拟）对少量样本的自然语言反馈和标量打分；3) 利用这些反馈，通过上下文学习（ICL）或监督微调（SFT）更新代理奖励模型。核心在于利用自然语言反馈来提高代理奖励模型的鲁棒性，延缓过度优化。
summary.experiments: 在“三明治”设定下进行实验（弱策略模型+弱代理奖励模型，强专家模型）。在 Qwen3-8B（创意写作）和 Claude Haiku 4.5（对齐研究计划）上，SFT 更新代理奖励的方法表现最佳。对于 Qwen3-8B，使用少 20 倍的专家样本即可恢复 80% 的性能差距，少 3 倍样本可完全恢复；对于 Haiku 4.5，少 10 倍样本即可完全恢复。仅使用标量奖励训练的代理模型鲁棒性差很多。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 4（基于 SFT 的代理奖励更新）和 Figure 1/2 的性能对比。可以略读 ICL 部分，因为实验证明其效果不如 SFT。值得深挖的是如何定义和测量“过度优化”，以及自然语言反馈具体如何增强了奖励模型的泛化能力。
summary.authors_note: Anthropic 团队工作。聚焦于对齐和可扩展监督，使用 Claude 系列模型作为实验基座和专家模拟器。

summary_en.core_problem: How to efficiently align language models on 'fuzzy' tasks (e.g., creative writing, alignment research plans) lacking objective verification metrics, using a very small amount of expert natural language feedback to address the scalable oversight problem.
summary_en.importance: Explores how to achieve efficient alignment by iteratively updating a proxy reward model in scenarios where supervision signals are extremely expensive and scarce. Demonstrates that natural language feedback contains richer supervision signals than scalar rewards alone, significantly improving data efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts an iterative online RLHF framework: 1) RL training against a proxy reward model until over-optimization occurs; 2) Stop and collect expert (simulated by a stronger model like Claude Opus) natural language feedback and scalar scores on a few samples; 3) Update the proxy reward model using this feedback via in-context learning (ICL) or supervised fine-tuning (SFT). The core is using natural language feedback to improve the robustness of the proxy reward model and delay over-optimization.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted in a 'sandwich' setting (weak policy + weak proxy reward, strong expert). On Qwen3-8B (creative writing) and Claude Haiku 4.5 (alignment research plans), SFT-based proxy updates performed best. For Qwen3-8B, it recovered 80% of the performance gap with 20x fewer expert samples, and 100% with 3x fewer. For Haiku 4.5, it fully recovered performance with 10x fewer samples. Proxy models trained only on scalar rewards were much less robust.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4 (SFT-based proxy reward updates) and the performance comparisons in Figures 1 and 2. The ICL section can be skimmed as experiments show it is less effective than SFT. A point worth digging into is how 'over-optimization' is defined and measured, and exactly how natural language feedback enhances the generalization of the reward model.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by the Anthropic team. Focuses on alignment and scalable oversight, using the Claude series models as experimental bases and expert simulators.

recommendation.zh: 小样本模糊领域对齐的增量方法，仅看第4节实验部分参考即可，无本质范式突破。
recommendation.en: Incremental alignment method for low-resource fuzzy domains, only reference Section 4 experiments, no fundamental paradigm breakthrough.

paper.title: Replacing Parameters with Preferences: Federated Alignment of Heterogeneous Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have broad potential in privacy-sensitive domains such as healthcare and finance, yet strict data-sharing constraints render centralized training infeasible. Federated Learning mitigates this issue by enabling decentralized training, but practical deployments face challenges due to client heterogeneity in computational resources, application requirements, and model architectures. Under extreme model and data heterogeneity, replacing parameter aggregation with prefer

summary.core_problem: 解决联邦场景下异构VLM因算力、模型架构、数据分布差异无法通过参数聚合实现对齐的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出用偏好协作替代参数聚合的异构VLM联邦对齐范式
summary.technical_approach: 提出MoR框架，每个客户端本地训练奖励模型捕获本地偏好，引入混合奖励机制融合多客户端异构监督信号，结合GRPO实现对齐，无需交换原始数据或模型参数
summary.experiments: 在多个多模态联邦基准上测试，验证对齐效果、隐私安全性与异构场景适配性
summary.authors_note: 团队来自北京航空航天大学、中国科学院自动化研究所、广州大学

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the problem that heterogeneous VLMs in federated scenarios cannot be aligned via parameter aggregation due to differences in computing power, model architecture and data distribution
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, first proposes federated alignment paradigm for heterogeneous VLMs that replaces parameter aggregation with preference collaboration
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose MoR framework, each client trains a local reward model to capture local preferences, introduces mixture-of-rewards mechanism to fuse heterogeneous supervision signals from multiple clients, achieves alignment combined with GRPO, no need to exchange raw data or model parameters
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple multimodal federated benchmarks, validates alignment effect, privacy security and heterogeneous scenario adaptability
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Beihang University, Institute of Automation, CAS, Guangzhou University

recommendation.zh: 异构VLM联邦对齐的增量方案，仅看摘要了解思路即可，无预训练层面的新洞见
recommendation.en: Incremental solution for federated alignment of heterogeneous VLMs, only read abstract for reference, no new pretraining insights
